data.home-action-ai-05-arab-00-01|text: A monoman comedian just like me—Oyama Love-san. I want to work with her! Any offers like that!?
data.home-action-ai-05-arab-00-cos-01|text: This costume is dancer-style. It was really easy to dance in, both in the village and on stage!
data.home-action-ai-05-arab-00-cos-02|text: When I hear a samba whistle, I can't help but start dancing. That whistle is dangerous...
data.home-action-ai-05-arab-00-cos-03|text: Um, I'd love to try belly dancing or tango someday!
data.home-action-ai-05-casl-04-01|text: I studied a ton about glamping! Ask me anything!
data.home-action-ai-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: I want to go barbecue again. Next time we could invite Haruko-san and everyone from LizNoir too, it'd be fun as a big group.
data.home-action-ai-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: Canoeing was a great core workout! It even trained my abs...!
data.home-action-ai-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: Where would you like to go on the next day off? Please don't hold back!
data.home-action-ai-05-chna-01-01|text: Now that I've learned pro wrestling, I feel like I can overcome any adversity!
data.home-action-ai-05-chna-01-cos-01|text: I've been doing Bulgarian squats! My thighs are super buff now!
data.home-action-ai-05-chna-01-cos-02|text: Thanks to practicing pro wrestling moves, my abs look even better! Want to touch them?
data.home-action-ai-05-chna-01-cos-03|text: The aesthetics of taking hits... It's part of pro wrestling's art. I won't dodge attacks either!
data.home-action-ai-05-fest-00-01|text: The fans are happy, and I think this looks great too, so I'm glad we chose this outfit!
data.home-action-ai-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: Look at this skirt! I can really feel the legacy of the old costume...!
data.home-action-ai-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: Cool costumes look hard to move in, but this one lets me work out just fine!
data.home-action-ai-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: With a mindset of becoming the dream rather than just dreaming, I'll give it my all today!
data.home-action-ai-05-fest-03-01|text: Aoi-san and I are about to go dance at that park!
data.home-action-ai-05-fest-03-cos-01|text: When I wear this outfit, fighting spirit surges through me. I'm ready to battle anytime!
data.home-action-ai-05-fest-03-cos-02|text: I've always loved LizNoir's costumes, but the recent ones are too cool! I have to keep up!
data.home-action-ai-05-fest-03-cos-03|text: I've relied on Kokoro for a long time now. It's kind of embarrassing, so it's a secret.
data.home-action-ai-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: Look, this outfit feels so LizNoir! I still can't believe I get to wear it.
data.home-action-ai-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: My back always straightens when I wear this! Sigh... To think I'd wear the same outfits as Rio-san...
data.home-action-ai-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: These earrings are different from Rio-san's and Aoi-san's. A design just for me—amazing...
data.home-action-ai-05-kait-00-01|text: Don't forget about the reward! Promise you won't take your eyes off me and LizNoir!
data.home-action-ai-05-kait-00-cos-01|text: Actually, since then I've been singing The Last Chance alone at karaoke too, secretly.
data.home-action-ai-05-kait-00-cos-02|text: I like this costume—it has a cool LizNoir design. Does it suit me?
data.home-action-ai-05-kait-00-cos-03|text: Watching Rio-san and Aoi-san's backs, sometimes it doesn't feel real. I always saw them on screen.
data.home-action-ai-05-miku-01-01|text: At our family shop, we launched a research-inspired miso ramen. It was a huge hit!
data.home-action-ai-05-miku-01-cos-01|text: This outfit is snow-themed. How is it? Does it suit me?
data.home-action-ai-05-miku-01-cos-02|text: This costume is really pretty. But since it's white, I have to be careful not to stain it.
data.home-action-ai-05-miku-01-cos-03|text: I'll work harder and harder so I can visit our Hokkaido fans again!
data.home-action-ai-05-mizg-01-01|text: Do you think this swimsuit suits me? Really? Really really? Like, for real for real?
data.home-action-ai-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: I knew this already...but this outfit is pretty revealing, right? Does it suit me? Ugh, complicated.
data.home-action-ai-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: Is it weird for me to be here in this outfit...? Have I become a strange girl?
data.home-action-ai-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: This reminds me of Okinawa. Do I look more grown-up than back then? Say yes!
data.home-action-ai-05-mizg-02-01|text: Could we... play with a plastic pool or water guns in the dormitory yard?
data.home-action-ai-05-mizg-02-cos-01|text: This outfit really shows off my muscles. You planned it that far...!
data.home-action-ai-05-mizg-02-cos-02|text: Overdoing anything isn't good. So I only push my limits the day before a day off.
data.home-action-ai-05-mizg-02-cos-03|text: Energy drinks are fine, but how about protein? I recommend a whey and soy mix!
data.home-action-ai-05-rock-00-01|text: Am I looking cool like Rio-san and the others?
data.home-action-ai-05-rock-00-cos-01|text: This outfit has that sharp LizNoir feel to it. I really like it!
data.home-action-ai-05-rock-00-cos-02|text: I need to train more and more to match such a cool costume!
data.home-action-ai-05-rock-00-cos-03|text: I-Is it my imagination... but I seem to have a lot of belly-baring outfits...
data.home-action-ai-05-tact-00-01|text: The arcade is popular in LizNoir right now, and Rio-san comes along too!
data.home-action-ai-05-tact-00-cos-01|text: Kokoro sniped me with a rubber band just now. I still need more training!
data.home-action-ai-05-tact-00-cos-02|text: I played an FPS game with Aoi-san, but she moves on instinct so she never hits!
data.home-action-ai-05-tact-00-cos-03|text: Commander! Give the order! Ahaha... I've actually been hooked on soldier play since then.
data.home-action-ai-05-vlnt-00-01|text: I want to make everyone shine. Like red ginger on tonkotsu ramen.
data.home-action-ai-05-vlnt-00-cos-01|text: Valentine's wasn't sweet after clashing honestly with Kokoro, but I gained so much from it!
data.home-action-ai-05-vlnt-00-cos-02|text: This outfit uses Kokoro's ideas. It feels like I'm wearing my best friend's feelings!
data.home-action-ai-05-vlnt-00-cos-03|text: Aoi-san said the choreography I made felt great to dance to. What kind words I received!
data.home-action-ai-05-wedd-00-01|text: The wedding cake was pancakes, so now I desperately want shortcake.
data.home-action-ai-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: I never thought I could be a bride... Does it suit me? Ehehe.
data.home-action-ai-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: Even someone energetic and muscular like me—don't I look delicate in a wedding dress?
data.home-action-ai-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: At my wedding, I want to serve ramen somehow! Like... ramen jelly?
data.home-action-ai-05-yukt-00-01|text: Rio-san in a yukata was so beautiful...! I wanted to take photos too!
data.home-action-ai-05-yukt-00-cos-01|text: I love my usual style of costumes too, of course, but a yukata every now and then is nice.
data.home-action-ai-05-yukt-00-cos-02|text: Eating ramen in a yukata taught me just how important the sash really is!
data.home-action-ai-05-yukt-00-cos-03|text: The fireworks were so pretty... Next time, I want all of LizNoir to liven up a fireworks show!
data.home-action-ai-2nd-anniv-01|text: I-I wasn't doing anything! I'll do the number of sit-ups the manager said, so forgive me!
data.home-action-ai-2nd-anniv-02|text: Kokoro~ I can't keep this secret anymore~. When I see the manager, my heart races...
data.home-action-ai-2nd-anniv-03|text: Sigh... The more I try to keep it secret, the more I want to talk... Huh!? M-Manager...
data.home-action-ai-basic-01|text: Good work! Today was... long-distance swimming, right? ...No?
data.home-action-ai-basic-02|text: I found shortcake in the fridge... I'm fighting myself. Want it... but I'll gain weight...
data.home-action-ai-basic-03|text: Today I'm focusing on lower body training. I split it by day, you know?
data.home-action-ai-basic-04|text: I love helping at my family's shop, and I'm confident about draining water!
data.home-action-ai-basic-05|text: I'm always nervous before a live~ But I've practiced a lot. I won't lose~
data.home-action-ai-basic-06|text: I'm here thanks to my dad. I want to eat his ramen again after so long...
data.home-action-ai-basic-07|text: Aoi-san goes to the same school but I never see her! Kokoro says she lives as a different person at school...
data.home-action-ai-basic-08|text: Kokoro's always been like that. But when it's just the two of us versus everyone, it feels a bit different...
data.home-action-ai-basic-09|text: Yu-chan is super popular at school too~. It's educational, seeing what an idol is like!
data.home-action-ai-basic-10|text: As someone who was a LizNoir fan, I still can't believe this situation! I have to be more LizNoir-like!
data.home-action-ai-basic-51|text: I ate garlic dumplings with ramen for lunch... Is it okay... do I smell...?
data.home-action-ai-basic-52|text: I went to Yu-chan's recommended ramen shop on my day off! The twilight-toned tonkotsu soup was great.
data.home-action-ai-basic-53|text: How do I get a figure like Yu-chan's? Just working out doesn't seem enough...
data.home-action-ai-birthday-ai-01|text: Everyone celebrated so much for me, I'm so... happy! I'll repay you on stage!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-aoi-01|text: It's Aoi-san's birthday! What can I do... what can I do... What should I do!?
data.home-action-ai-birthday-chs-01|text: I dashed over to congratulate Chisa-san and she ran away... Why!?
data.home-action-ai-birthday-hrk-01|text: It's Haruko-san's birthday! Everyone from Sunny Peace has prepared a special gift!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-kan-01|text: kana-san asked me, 'You have a birthday present ready, right?'... The pressure was intense.
data.home-action-ai-birthday-kkr-01|text: It's Kokoro's birthday, so today I'll be honestly fooled! No usual comebacks needed!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-kor-01|text: It's Fran-san's birthday. Same zodiac as Aoi-san— do they have things in common?
data.home-action-ai-birthday-ktn-01|text: Have you seen Kotono-san!? I want to congratulate her but haven't been able to meet her yet!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-mei-01|text: I tried to chase Mei-san to say happy birthday but lost in a sprint...!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-mhk-01|text: It's miho-san's birthday, so I prepared five kilos of protein! She trains in the pool, I hear.
data.home-action-ai-birthday-mna-01|text: Mana-san... a legendary idol. I used to watch her too! Happy birthday.
data.home-action-ai-birthday-ngs-01|text: It's Nagisa-san's birthday! Do you know her favorite food? I'll dash out and buy it!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-rei-01|text: It's Rei-san's birthday! I just congratulated her and she blushed a little!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-rio-01|text: I worried so much about a birthday present for Rio-san that it's already today... What do I do...
data.home-action-ai-birthday-rui-01|text: I gave Rui-san fitness gear for her birthday and she was happy...!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-ski-01|text: It's Saki-san's birthday! I'll do my best to pick a book that matches her taste!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-skr-01|text: It's Sakura-chan's birthday! I hear she's been focusing on training lately, so I'll give her something!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-smr-01|text: For Sumire-chan's birthday, I thought about an acting contest... but I'd lose for sure, so I didn't!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-suz-01|text: Today is Suzu-chan's bir— her birth festival, I hear! I just heard from her directly!
data.home-action-ai-birthday-szk-01|text: Shizuku-san's birthday, so I went to greet her and ended up learning idol basics instead...
data.home-action-ai-birthday-yu-01|text: I congratulated Yu-chan on her birthday and got such a elegant reply! Real ojou-sama!
data.home-action-ai-halw-01|text: If there are no treats, be prepared!
data.home-action-ai-newyeve-01|text: For New Year's, ramen over soba!
data.home-action-ai-trust-01-01|text: I know it's healthy! Lots of fiber, low fat! But mushrooms just... won't work...
data.home-action-ai-trust-01-02|text: I miss our shop's ramen. I tried to recreate it here but it's so hard...
data.home-action-ai-trust-01-03|text: Thank you always! The manager is amazing. I can't even track my own schedule...
data.home-action-ai-trust-02-01|text: Sorry to bother you! Kokoro's not here today... Please train with me!
data.home-action-ai-trust-02-02|text: My dad raised me alone. When he's happy, it makes me so happy too!
data.home-action-ai-trust-02-03|text: Good work. Shall I clean your room, Manager? ...I love cleaning.
data.home-action-ai-trust-03-01|text: I'm terrible with darkness... Just between us, I can't sleep without the lights on...
data.home-action-ai-trust-03-02|text: U-Um! If {user}-san doesn't mind, would you like to go eat cake together?
data.home-action-ai-trust-03-03|text: How do you fall in love!? Kokoro said a girl in love becomes beautiful, so...
data.home-action-ai-trust-04-01|text: C-Could you come to my family's home? My dad wants to see {user}-san's face...
data.home-action-ai-trust-04-02|text: I know it's wrong. But I can't hold back these feelings... Lend me the studio key!
data.home-action-ai-trust-04-03|text: Um... do you dislike girls with muscles? ...I mean, what do male fans think.
data.home-action-aoi-05-arab-00-01|text: Where should our next tour go? Asia, Europe, South America -- let's hit it all. Yeah, that sounds good.
data.home-action-aoi-05-arab-00-cos-01|text: Hey, you know that flowy thing dangling from the wrist of this costume? What's it called?
data.home-action-aoi-05-arab-00-cos-02|text: Foreign movies are pretty cool. I wonder if I'll get acting offers. I'd gladly take one now.
data.home-action-aoi-05-arab-00-cos-03|text: Wanna dance with me as a break from work? Just a little bit's fine, right? You won't even do this much for me?
data.home-action-aoi-05-casl-04-01|text: Where should we go today. What do you mean? ...That's obviously about our date.
data.home-action-aoi-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: I made this shirt myself. I was particular about the design and the logo text. It's my battle outfit.
data.home-action-aoi-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: You know what the text on my shirt means? Nah, if you don't, that's fine.
data.home-action-aoi-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: What time does work end today? When it's done, let's go for a night walk with me.
data.home-action-aoi-05-circ-00-01|text: Kotono's acting was pretty good. Though I heard she rode the bike backwards.
data.home-action-aoi-05-circ-00-cos-01|text: The highlight of this costume is probably the check pattern on the arms and waist. Take a look.
data.home-action-aoi-05-circ-00-cos-02|text: Won't my stomach get cold? Nah, my stomach's tough.
data.home-action-aoi-05-circ-00-cos-03|text: Acting jobs are nice once in a while. I've always wanted to try swinging guns or swords.
data.home-action-aoi-05-fest-00-01|text: Even things you're not interested in can turn out to be surprisingly fun once you try. Didn't know that.
data.home-action-aoi-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: This outfit feels kinda itchy... but if you say it suits me, I'll put up with it.
data.home-action-aoi-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: You really think this costume suits me? Can you say it while looking me in the eye? Here, look closely.
data.home-action-aoi-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: Hey, any job recommendations? If you say I should do it, I will. I trust you.
data.home-action-aoi-05-fest-03-01|text: Before I knew it, my dancing might have gotten heavy. When you dance, it needs to be free.
data.home-action-aoi-05-fest-03-cos-01|text: I've got a spare sword. We can do sword fighting like before. Rio told me not to, though.
data.home-action-aoi-05-fest-03-cos-02|text: This costume will surely become something special for us. ...So I'll take care of it.
data.home-action-aoi-05-fest-03-cos-03|text: The cheers and heat from that time became a fire in me. The fans were believing in us and waiting, I suppose.
data.home-action-aoi-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: I've gotten used to it now, but I'm still bad with skirts. They don't suit me much. Don't they?
data.home-action-aoi-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: I don't really have opinions on costumes. If it's easy to dance in, that's enough. Rio doesn't seem to think that way.
data.home-action-aoi-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: Do you actually wear gloves normally? The whole 'fashion' thing just doesn't make sense to me.
data.home-action-aoi-05-kait-00-01|text: Rio and I come up with the choreography, but someday I'd like all four of us to do it. Maybe in the near future.
data.home-action-aoi-05-kait-00-cos-01|text: This is easy to move in. Could I use it as practice wear? ...Nah, that won't work. Rio wouldn't let it slide.
data.home-action-aoi-05-kait-00-cos-02|text: Rio won't let me take my clothes off or change in front of people. She's so naggy. What's that even called?
data.home-action-aoi-05-kait-00-cos-03|text: Even in white it still feels LizNoir. I don't care about clothes, but I've gotten a little interested. A little.
data.home-action-aoi-05-miku-01-01|text: I got tickets to Miku's live. If you're free this Sunday, wanna come with me?
data.home-action-aoi-05-miku-01-cos-01|text: I went to the arcade for the first time in a while. I played Miku's songs and got the high score.
data.home-action-aoi-05-miku-01-cos-02|text: Hokkaido was cold, though. It's the kind of place where zero degrees feels warm...
data.home-action-aoi-05-miku-01-cos-03|text: Miku can go anywhere, so I feel like she might just pop up again out of the blue.
data.home-action-aoi-05-mizg-01-01|text: When it's hot, just take stuff off. {user}, maybe you should try working in a swimsuit too.
data.home-action-aoi-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: I don't hate swimsuits. They're cool, comfy, easy to move in. Maybe I'll do lessons in one too.
data.home-action-aoi-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: Outdoor summer lives are surprisingly great. Under the sun, you can really see the fans' smiles.
data.home-action-aoi-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: Playing in water is just splashing it around, so why does it get everyone so hyped?
data.home-action-aoi-05-past-00-01|text: The fight with Rio when we debuted? Well, the mature me managed to calm the crying Rio down.
data.home-action-aoi-05-past-00-cos-01|text: We discussed and decided on this costume with Rio. In that sense, it's a memorable piece.
data.home-action-aoi-05-past-00-cos-02|text: It was nice that we could wear the old costumes with just some adjustments. Makes me feel like I haven't grown, though. Frustrating.
data.home-action-aoi-05-past-00-cos-03|text: I owe Saegusa-san a lot, but the fact that she abandoned us once... that leaves complicated feelings.
data.home-action-aoi-05-vlnt-00-01|text: More than I expected, everyone liked the chocolate. I guess my feelings got through.
data.home-action-aoi-05-vlnt-00-cos-01|text: So this is a Valentine's costume. For me, if it's easy to dance in, that's fine.
data.home-action-aoi-05-vlnt-00-cos-02|text: Shizuku treasures my chocolate so much she won't eat it. I want her to eat it.
data.home-action-aoi-05-vlnt-00-cos-03|text: Ai even cared so much about the calories of the gateau chocolat I gave her that she skipped her usual workout.
data.home-action-aoi-05-wdnc-00-01|text: Hey, wanna go back to that underground arena? We might find some amazing raw talent.
data.home-action-aoi-05-wdnc-00-cos-01|text: Hey, 'hou-ren-so' isn't about vegetables, right? ...Why are you making that face?
data.home-action-aoi-05-wdnc-00-cos-02|text: Hey, Makibishi Maru. Hello, Makibishi Maru. Hey, are you listening? Makibishi Maru.
data.home-action-aoi-05-wdnc-00-cos-03|text: My grandma's words always find their way naturally into my heart. I wonder why.
data.home-action-aoi-05-wedd-00-01|text: I've finally gotten used to walking in a dress. Maybe I could wear one normally too.
data.home-action-aoi-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: A dress isn't really my thing, but with everyone praising me this much, I might get a little full of myself.
data.home-action-aoi-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: You forgot to eat dinner again? If that keeps up, you'll make your future wife worry.
data.home-action-aoi-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: You say a dress isn't armor? Then try lacing yourself up in a corset. You'll understand how I feel.
data.home-action-aoi-05-yukt-00-01|text: Lately I've started thinking school classes are actually fun. Just like you said, everything is experience.
data.home-action-aoi-05-yukt-00-cos-01|text: This costume is surprisingly easy to move in despite how it looks.
data.home-action-aoi-05-yukt-00-cos-02|text: Oops, sorry. Did the sleeve hit you?
data.home-action-aoi-05-yukt-00-cos-03|text: Hey, wanna play basketball after this? What, you want to play in that outfit? If you prefer, sure.
data.home-action-aoi-2nd-anniv-01|text: I want you to forget what Kokoro said to you. What are you talking about? If you don't remember, then it's nothing.
data.home-action-aoi-2nd-anniv-02|text: I think I'm the type who expresses gratitude pretty directly. So...? Do my feelings always get through?
data.home-action-aoi-2nd-anniv-03|text: For some reason, Rio can't be honest when it comes to you. Is that what they call tsundere?
data.home-action-aoi-basic-01|text: Ah, good work. Today's schedule? Yeah, like I'd know that.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-02|text: I'm stepping out for a bit. Planning to dance around there. Is that okay?
data.home-action-aoi-basic-03|text: Any good games lately? I already cleared the one you recommended before.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-04|text: My special skill? Besides dance? Ah, the profile column... The only skill I can call my own is dance.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-05|text: Tomorrow's a live. Well, live or street, what I do is the same. Just give the best performance.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-06|text: I'm thinking of expanding my baking repertoire. Any recommendations?
data.home-action-aoi-basic-07|text: This DM thing -- a fan says she wants to visit the agency... Oh. That won't work.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-08|text: Rio told me to get on SNS, but then she complains about which photos I post. So many demands.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-09|text: Rei was like the old Rio. Seemed kind of restless. Now it's fun to watch.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-10|text: No matter which agency I'm at, I'm Aoi Ikawa of LizNoir. Honestly, I think freelance would be fine too.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-51|text: They say idols should go to school, but why? I still don't get the reason.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-52|text: Ai is kind and a good kid. But you absolutely can't make her mad. She'd knock you out in one punch.
data.home-action-aoi-basic-53|text: Cleaning with a toothbrush takes a lot of time and effort. Ever tried it?
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-ai-01|text: Ai asked me to teach her my secret training methods as a present. I don't have any, though.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-aoi-01|text: It's the first time so many people have wished me a happy birthday. Feels kind of ticklish.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-chs-01|text: The Sunny Peace crew went pretty wild for Chisa's birthday celebration.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-chs-02|text: It's Chisa's birthday, so maybe I'll watch a horror movie with her. Dog movies are way more terrifying for me, though.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-hrk-01|text: It's Hiroko's birthday. Wonder what she'd like as a gift. She seems to have a lot of hobbies.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-kan-01|text: kana's birthday, huh. She's pretty good at dancing, so I'd like to dance with her sometime. Alright, I'll ask her.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-kkr-01|text: Today's Kokoro's birthday. She was dropping hints for a week before, so there's no way I'd forget.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-kor-01|text: fran's stock went up, I hear. I could hear cheering so I thought they were celebrating her birthday.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-ktn-01|text: Kotono, it's her birthday today. The Moon Tempest gang was hyped. Nice vibe.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-mei-01|text: Today's Mei's birthday. Everyone was calling out to her. As expected of an idol.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-mhk-01|text: It was miho's birthday. IIIX doesn't celebrate together, so I didn't notice at all.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-mna-01|text: Ah, right. Today's Nagasa Mana's birthday. My memories with her are few, but all of them are vivid.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-ngs-01|text: It's Nagisa's birthday. Maybe I'll go perform a blessing dance.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-rei-01|text: Today's Rei's birthday. Alright, I'll challenge her to a dance battle. A surprise dance.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-rio-01|text: I tried baking Rio a birthday cake. It was quite a hassle, but well, it's a celebration.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-rui-01|text: It's Rui's birthday. Probably a hot pot party. Maybe I'll try one with LizNoir too.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-ski-01|text: It's Saki's birthday. I asked her about it earlier and she replied really politely. Proper manners, you could say.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-skr-01|text: Sakura's birthday, huh. I want to celebrate something for her, but I wonder what would make her happy.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-smr-01|text: Apparently it's Sumire's birthday. Even among middle schoolers, there's such a big difference from Kokoro.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-suz-01|text: Apparently today's Suz's birthday. Maybe I'll have a tree-climbing contest in her honor.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-szk-01|text: It's Shizuku's birthday. I was going to tell her some idol industry behind- the-scenes stories I heard ages ago... but I forgot.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-user-01|text: Ah... before I forget, happy birthday.
data.home-action-aoi-birthday-yu-01|text: I heard today is Yu's birthday. If it's cheesecake, I happened to make one yesterday. Maybe I'll go give it to her.
data.home-action-aoi-christ-01|text: I'll probably spend Christmas with my family... It's noisy though.
data.home-action-aoi-halw-01|text: Pumpkin sweets are everywhere this time of year... You don't have any?
data.home-action-aoi-newy-01|text: New Year's sounds have a nice rhythm. It makes me restless...
data.home-action-aoi-newyeve-01|text: If I danced to the temple bell... Yeah, that'd be annoying.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-01-01|text: Hey, hey. I heard a dog barking outside just now... It's not coming in, right?
data.home-action-aoi-trust-01-02|text: The arcade is fine. Nobody notices me when I'm lost in a game, and I can focus.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-01-03|text: Sorry, I don't really understand what you go through, but you seem to have it tough. Thanks.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-02-01|text: I have a favor. Something only you can do. Protect me from the dogs that have been appearing on my way home lately.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-02-02|text: We only have brothers at home. My parents say my personality is because of that, but I don't think it's related.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-02-03|text: Come shopping with me again? ...Not to carry bags. I just want you to choose with me.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-03-01|text: I go eat pancakes with Rio, but honestly I can't tell the shops apart. ...I won't tell her that.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-03-02|text: You appeared in my dream yesterday. I wonder why. I forgot what happened in it, but it didn't feel bad.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-03-03|text: Starting tomorrow it's an overnight, right? ...Can I share a room with you? Sorry, kidding.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-04-01|text: Do you like girls with long hair? ...Yeah, I wonder why I asked. No particular reason.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-04-02|text: I don't know why, but when I'm with you, I feel a sense of calm. It's different from when I'm with my brother.
data.home-action-aoi-trust-04-03|text: Manager, when's your next day off? I want you to take me somewhere fun again.
data.home-action-cca-05-goch-00-01|text: The Rabbit House uniform is so cute, right! I love it too~!
data.home-action-cca-05-goch-00-cos-01|text: An idol wearing the same uniform and working at the same shop... This isn't a dream, is it!?
data.home-action-cca-05-goch-00-cos-02|text: Chino-chan is so reliable that sometimes I end up being the imouto instead~. It's our secret, okay?
data.home-action-cca-05-goch-00-cos-03|text: I bet Chisa-chan and Chiya-chan would totally get along! They both love scary stories!
data.home-action-cca-basic-01|text: Welcome! Welcome to Rabbit House! Ehehe, force of habit.
data.home-action-cca-basic-02|text: Shizuku-chan taught me so carefully during vocal practice. She's so kind and cute and dazzling...!
data.home-action-cca-basic-03|text: The coffee Chino-chan made is really delicious! I want everyone at Hoshimi Pro to try it.
data.home-action-cca-basic-04|text: Suzu-chan said she'd show me around Hoshimi City! I'm so excited I can't sleep~!
data.home-action-cca-basic-05|text: Kokoro-chan is so cute~! Cocoa and Kokoro have similar names, couldn't we be sisters!?
data.home-action-cca-basic-06|text: The Rabbit House uniform is so cute, right! I love it too~!
data.home-action-cca-goch-01-cos-01|text: Going around the Christmas market is so much fun! It sends my spirits through the roof!
data.home-action-cca-goch-01-cos-02|text: I'm so happy Chisa-chan knitted me gloves~! And she even knitted a pair for my friend too!
data.home-action-cca-goch-01-cos-03|text: For everyone working hard at the Christmas live, here's a care package of limited menu items from Rabbit House!
data.home-action-cca-goch-02-03-cos-01|text: Pajama parties are so fun! Next time let's each invite friends and have a big one!
data.home-action-cca-goch-02-03-cos-02|text: ...Ah! Did you just call me onee-chan? You did, right? Right?
data.home-action-char-stm-april-24-0401-01-01: For Uototto Pro, to become BIGGYO, everyone work hard gyo-gyo~!
data.home-action-char-stm-april-24-0401-01-02: Just like Sakura-gyo wanted to perform with me, I also wanted to perform with Sakura-gyo!
data.home-action-char-stm-april-24-0401-01-03: Wear the GYOGYO hat and your popularity will rise like a conger eel for sure~!
data.home-action-char-stm-april-24-0401-01-04: The ocean covers seventy percent of the Earth's surface, gyo! To conquer the sea is to be a true idol, gyo!
data.home-action-char-stm-april-24-0401-01-05: Now, everyone dance too, gyo! Always by everyone's side~ Popping up with a gyo-gyo~
data.home-action-char-stm-april-24-0401-01-06: I'll specially teach you how to make a GYOGYO hat, gyo. First soak cloth in my dashi broth...
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-01-01|text: Hawa!? Eh? Eh? Must be my imagination~
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-01-02|text: Ha! Who? Someone's here? A delivery maybe?
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-01-03|text: Wa!? Eh? Senpai? Did they come back?
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-02-03|text: Ah, here's a rice ball for the desk~
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-02-03-new|tex: Ah, here's a rice ball for the desk~
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-01|text: Ah, senpai! A request for Tsukisto just came in!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-02|text: Ah, senpai! A request for SunaPi just came in!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-03|text: Ah, senpai! A request for TriAile just came in!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-04|text: Ah, senpai! A request for LizNoir just came in!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-05|text: Ah! Listen, senpai! SunaPi shoot date decided!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-06|text: Hmm, good timing! Tsukisto live getting great reviews!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-07|text: Ah, good work-desu! LizNoir MV shoot was perfect!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-08|text: Ah, senpai senpai! Today's TriAile live battle was absolutely amazing~!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-09|text: Aaah, sen-pai~! Good work on the business trip!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-03-10|text: Hmm, perfect timing~! Booked the recording studio!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-04-01|text: Aaah! Such amazing photos! This is too much~
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-04-02|text: Haa~... this live is precious no matter when I watch it~
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-04-03|text: Fufu... ah, they're all too good... Such a feast for the eyes~
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-04-04|text: Ah~ that was a great live~ I must help everyone more!
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-04-05|text: Hoo~ such amazing steering... I have much more to learn...
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-default-03|te: Ah, here's a rice ball for the desk~
data.home-action-char-stm-basic-default-03-ne: Ah, here's a rice ball for the desk~
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-ai-01|text: Ah, senpai, have you seen Omiyama-san? Today's her birthday so I'll go say congrats too~
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-aoi-01|tex: Ah, senpai, good work-desu! Today's Ikawa-san's birthday~! He's a bit embarrassed, it's sweet~
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-chs-01|tex: Ah, good work! Today's Shiraishi-san's birthday! I wonder what Saki-san will give~
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-hrk-01|tex: Ah, senpai! Something good happened! I joined the SunaPi gang in celebrating Saeki-san's birthday!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-kkr-01|tex: Ah, senpai, there you are! Akasaki-san was looking for you! She said she needs more presents!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-ktn-01|tex: Ah, good work! Today's Nagase-san's birthday~! Ibuki-san's been cheerful since morning!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-mei-01|tex: Right, senpai, senpai! Today's Hayasaka-san's birthday! The office is full of happy vibes~!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-ngs-01|tex: Oh, good timing! Today's Ibuki-san's birthday! I wonder if the gift will be Nagase-san's secret info?
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-rei-01|tex: Ah, senpai! Listen! The birthday present for Ichinose-san was a huge hit~!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-rio-01|tex: Oh, sen-pai! Today's Kanzaki-san's birthday, so LizNoir everyone seems excited!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-rui-01|tex: Hmm, good work, senpai! Today's Tendo-san's birthday! 1111 is so Tendo-san-like, right!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-ski-01|tex: Ah, senpai! What did you get for Saki-san's birthday present? I was torn but went with a book!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-skr-01|tex: Oh, senpai! Do you know what day it is~? That's right! Our Kawasaka-san's birthday!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-smr-01|tex: Hmm, good work! Today's Okuyama-san's birthday! I'll go congratulate her later too!
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-suz-01|tex: Ah, you met Narumiya-san? You better congratulate her or she'll be mad~ Being lovable is amazing~
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-szk-01|tex: Ah, senpai senpai! Did you celebrate Hodo-san's birthday? She was shaking with joy... So cute...
data.home-action-char-stm-birthday-yu-01|text: Ah, senpai! Today's Suzumura-san's birthday! TriAile everyone seems to be celebrating!
data.home-action-chk-05-sush-00-01|text: From zero to one! Aqours! Shine!
data.home-action-chk-05-sush-00-cos-01|text: To sing on the same stage as the most radiant idols ever... This is a miracle!
data.home-action-chk-05-sush-00-cos-02|text: Sunny Peace was born in a town overlooking the sea. I can't help but feel a kinship~.
data.home-action-chk-05-sush-00-cos-03|text: I've got to keep working hard to shine as bright as the idols at Hoshimi Pro!
data.home-action-chk-basic-01|text: Let's all shine our brightest today too!
data.home-action-chk-basic-02|text: Sakura-chan from SunaPi and Kotono-chan from Tsukisto! Haa~ they're always so cute~!
data.home-action-chk-basic-03|text: Oh right, I brought mikan from Uchiura. Gotta hand them out at Hoshimi Pro.
data.home-action-chk-basic-04|text: A lesson room...? The office has a room like that too...?
data.home-action-chk-basic-05|text: Ugh, I better start writing lyrics soon or Riko-chan will be mad at me.
data.home-action-chk-basic-06|text: From zero to one! Aqours! Shine!
data.home-action-chk-sush-01-cos-01|text: What should I get for Riko-chan and You-chan? Something that'd make them happy...
data.home-action-chk-sush-01-cos-02|text: Merry Christmas! Let's have a blast today!!
data.home-action-chk-sush-01-cos-03|text: To think I'd spend Christmas with everyone at Hoshimi...
data.home-action-chk-sush-02-03-cos-01|text: I was so surprised when Riko-chan transferred in~.
data.home-action-chn-05-goch-00-01|text: When Cocoa-san sees someone younger, she immediately tries to be their onee-san. She's hopeless.
data.home-action-chn-05-goch-00-cos-01|text: I just want to pet the rabbits more, so why do they run when I approach? I cannot accept this.
data.home-action-chn-05-goch-00-cos-02|text: My mother made this uniform. She made it a different color so I could work alongside my friends.
data.home-action-chn-05-goch-00-cos-03|text: If you'd like, please come drink coffee I've brewed. I'll be waiting at Rabbit House.
data.home-action-chn-basic-01|text: Why not take a little break? I'll go brew us a special blend.
data.home-action-chn-basic-02|text: Tippy is not for sale. ...I suppose it can't be helped. You may pet him once.
data.home-action-chn-basic-03|text: For Sumire-san I'll make a special coffee with plenty of sugar and milk.
data.home-action-chn-basic-04|text: Since standing on stage, more people have started calling out to me. It's a bit embarrassing...
data.home-action-chn-basic-05|text: I received photos of Sumire-san's onee-sans the other day. They were very mature...
data.home-action-chn-basic-06|text: When Cocoa-san sees someone younger, she immediately tries to be their onee-san. She's hopeless.
data.home-action-chn-goch-01-cos-01|text: Sniff sniff... this sweet scent... Hot chocolate, isn't it. I'd like to drink it with everyone.
data.home-action-chn-goch-01-cos-02|text: When it snows, cats curl up in the kotatsu... What do rabbits do, I wonder?
data.home-action-chn-goch-01-cos-03|text: Having gained more friends is... my best Christmas present.
data.home-action-chn-goch-02-03-cos-01|text: I told Chisa-san about Chiya-san's Ripper Rabbit story and she seemed delighted.
data.home-action-chn-goch-02-03-cos-02|text: I gave Sumire-san a Cocoa-scented bath bomb as a present. She seems to have liked it.
data.home-action-chs-05-alic-00-01|text: The tea party is ready. Please, come this way. Would you like sugar in your tea?
data.home-action-chs-05-alic-00-cos-01|text: In the movie she grows and shrinks, but I wonder what material her clothes are made of...?
data.home-action-chs-05-alic-00-cos-02|text: Shizuku-chan and Suzu-chan were amazed saying 'Even though we both have Alice themes, the vibes are totally different.'
data.home-action-chs-05-alic-00-cos-03|text: My onee-chan loves analyzing things, so after watching a movie she always has lots on her mind.
data.home-action-chs-05-casl-04-01|text: Shopping for clothes together, chatting a lot, watching a movie. Even small things make me so happy.
data.home-action-chs-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Since joining Sunny Peace I've had so many experiences, and I feel like I've become someone who can pull off these clothes.
data.home-action-chs-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: 'Franken Mountains' was really great...! A solid 10 out of 10 scary!
data.home-action-chs-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: After watching the director's new film, I feel even more motivated about auditions.
data.home-action-chs-05-chia-00-01|text: When I showed this outfit to my onee-chan, the next day it was her phone wallpaper.
data.home-action-chs-05-chia-00-cos-01|text: The skirt is a bit short, so I'm a little embarrassed...
data.home-action-chs-05-chia-00-cos-02|text: When cheering for someone, I feel like we become one, and it makes me so happy.
data.home-action-chs-05-chia-00-cos-03|text: There's nothing better than our cheering helping someone do their best!
data.home-action-chs-05-chsk-00-01|text: {user}-san. We've become the best sister unit... right?
data.home-action-chs-05-chsk-00-cos-01|text: This outfit came together thanks to {user}-san's amazing support!
data.home-action-chs-05-chsk-00-cos-02|text: Sumire-chan said she'd like Chisa-chan to design TriAile's costumes too!
data.home-action-chs-05-chsk-00-cos-03|text: The Shiraishi Sisters Win trended on SNS~ I was so happy!
data.home-action-chs-05-fest-00-01|text: It's been a while performing with my onee-chan. I have to do my best...!
data.home-action-chs-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: I designed it imagining the sea of Hoshimi City. Does it suit me...?
data.home-action-chs-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: If seeing this outfit makes people remember our live, that would make me so happy.
data.home-action-chs-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: I'd be happy if this outfit stays in everyone's memory.
data.home-action-chs-05-fest-03-01|text: Being with Suzu-chan makes me feel positive too. I hope we can do something together again.
data.home-action-chs-05-fest-03-cos-01|text: The other day I stayed over at Suzu-chan's room and we fell asleep cuddled in the same bed.
data.home-action-chs-05-fest-03-cos-02|text: I couldn't do the prank well so I'm practicing looking angry... ...grrrr!
data.home-action-chs-05-fest-03-cos-03|text: I made plans to go out with Suzu-chan on my day off. I wonder where we'll go~.
data.home-action-chs-05-flow-00-01|text: Ghosts are best enjoyed in movies, I think.
data.home-action-chs-05-flow-00-cos-01|text: This outfit is cute and lovely, but... me as a flower fairy is embarrassing...
data.home-action-chs-05-flow-00-cos-02|text: My onee-chan saw a prank show and told me Chisa's easy to trick, so be careful.
data.home-action-chs-05-flow-00-cos-03|text: Mei-chan was talking to thin air. Was that a prank too, I wonder?
data.home-action-chs-05-hruh-00-01|text: Actually, I can shoot beams from my eyes! Ah, that face means you don't believe me? I-I can really shoot them!
data.home-action-chs-05-hruh-00-cos-01|text: If I could go to school with aliens and people from the future, every day would be exciting and fun.
data.home-action-chs-05-hruh-00-cos-02|text: Haruhi-san can be a bit reckless, but she always suggests fun things.
data.home-action-chs-05-hruh-00-cos-03|text: I made their school uniform. Wearing it brings back those memories so vividly.
data.home-action-chs-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: It's cute no matter when I wear it. I want to try making a costume like this on my own someday...!
data.home-action-chs-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: Wearing this gives me energy! It makes me feel like I can do my best at my first job!
data.home-action-chs-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: I love this costume. It's packed with happy moments and regrets alike.
data.home-action-chs-05-maid-00-01|text: You useless manager! Hurry up and go buy a mille-crepe!
data.home-action-chs-05-maid-00-cos-01|text: Playing a bossy, mean girl despite being a servant... It was tough but surprisingly popular.
data.home-action-chs-05-maid-00-cos-02|text: Eh? Based on kana-san!? N-No, I didn't! I don't think she's a bad person!
data.home-action-chs-05-maid-00-cos-03|text: If the role won't come to me, I'll go get it myself. Sometimes you need brute force!
data.home-action-chs-05-mizg-04-01|text: I brought the water guns we used at the beach back to the office. Now we can play anytime!
data.home-action-chs-05-mizg-04-cos-01|text: This swimsuit-style outfit matches what my onee-chan wore. Maybe I'll take a two-shot next time~.
data.home-action-chs-05-mizg-04-cos-02|text: Someday I want to be able to swim in the sea with everyone!
data.home-action-chs-05-mizg-04-cos-03|text: If I go to the sea every year, someday I might even see a real umi-bozu... a real sea!
data.home-action-chs-05-pajm-00-01|text: Would my bangs look more mature if I styled them up? But showing my forehead is kind of embarrassing...
data.home-action-chs-05-pajm-00-cos-01|text: Working hard is important, but taking it step by step at your own pace matters too.
data.home-action-chs-05-pajm-00-cos-02|text: I'm the second shortest in Hoshimi Pro. Maybe I look childish because I'm short...
data.home-action-chs-05-pajm-00-cos-03|text: Everyone from Slix is so mature and cool. I wonder if I can be like that someday.
data.home-action-chs-05-rock-00-01|text: It was tough, but the time I spent challenging Rei-chan's dance part is my precious treasure.
data.home-action-chs-05-rock-00-cos-01|text: This costume is a lifetime memory for me. Because it was a live I had the courage to challenge.
data.home-action-chs-05-rock-00-cos-02|text: I had training from Sunny Peace's oni instructor Rei-chan again! It's so motivating...!
data.home-action-chs-05-rock-00-cos-03|text: Shizuku-chan always watches videos of my solo parts. She says she's happy every time.
data.home-action-chs-05-seik-00-01|text: Lately Kokoro-chan has been trying to make me do a thousand sit-ups...
data.home-action-chs-05-seik-00-cos-01|text: May the angel's song filled with sincerity bring you blessings... I love those words.
data.home-action-chs-05-seik-00-cos-02|text: Rui-san and Rio-san would look good in this outfit too, don't you think? I'd love for them to try.
data.home-action-chs-05-seik-00-cos-03|text: Wearing this kind of outfit makes me feel like my heart becomes pure...! I'll pray for everyone's happiness!
data.home-action-chs-05-yukt-00-01|text: I told my onee-chan I was going to a summer festival and she made me pack a thermos, bug spray, bandages, and a child GPS...
data.home-action-chs-05-yukt-00-cos-01|text: Summer means yukata, right? I only wear it once or twice a year but I want a new one every time.
data.home-action-chs-05-yukt-00-cos-02|text: Why don't we all wear yukata and set off fireworks in the dorm yard? Let's make summer memories together.
data.home-action-chs-05-yukt-00-cos-03|text: It feels strange to sing on the Hoshimi Festival stage that my family used to visit.
data.home-action-chs-2nd-anniv-01|text: D-Don't look over here! Why? If you ask... then it's even worse!
data.home-action-chs-2nd-anniv-02|text: Are you hiding something? T-That kind of probing won't uncover anything. Don't underestimate me...
data.home-action-chs-2nd-anniv-03|text: Wah wah wah! I'm making sure {user}-san can't talk!
data.home-action-chs-basic-01|text: Oh, good work! I'll be careful not to mess up and cause trouble...!
data.home-action-chs-basic-02|text: I'm making a shopping bag for my onee-chan, but it's taking longer than expected and I'm sleep- deprieved...!
data.home-action-chs-basic-03|text: Watching horror movies relaxes me. But everyone gets scared and I have no one to talk to about it.
data.home-action-chs-basic-04|text: Shizuku-chan's clothes tore spectacularly the other day so I sewed them up and she was so surprised!
data.home-action-chs-basic-05|text: I get nervous the day before a live... But I used to start shaking even earlier, so maybe I've grown a little?
data.home-action-chs-basic-06|text: Talking about myself for work is really hard. I still can't chat much at school either.
data.home-action-chs-basic-07|text: My onee-chan tried to go out wearing a T-shirt that says 'Hope' so I hurriedly restyled it...!
data.home-action-chs-basic-08|text: Once Shizuku-chan enters the idol shop, she won't move for two hours. So I do my shopping after.
data.home-action-chs-basic-09|text: Sakura-chan is a bundle of energy. Whether backstage or at a live, she's always sharing that energy.
data.home-action-chs-basic-10|text: If I didn't have the current Sunny Peace members, I think I would've given up. They encourage me so much!
data.home-action-chs-basic-51|text: The fallen warriors march~ Fufu, I've been loving this hand ball song lately.
data.home-action-chs-basic-52|text: I was making a cat with wool felting, but someone saw the unfinished head and screamed...
data.home-action-chs-basic-53|text: Takoyaki parties are so much fun! Want to have one together sometime?
data.home-action-chs-birthday-ai-01|text: I just saw Ai-chan and told her happy birthday, and that her hard work inspires me.
data.home-action-chs-birthday-aoi-01|text: I heard it's Aoi-san's birthday. I need to go congratulate him... where could he be...?
data.home-action-chs-birthday-chs-01|text: I got to have such a wonderful birthday experience... Everyone's kindness makes me so happy!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-chs-02|text: Ehehe, birthdays are exciting. You're allowed to get yourself a present too, right~.
data.home-action-chs-birthday-hrk-01|text: It's Haruko-san's birthday... So I'm giving her the present everyone picked!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-kan-01|text: kana-san said she wants something that'll go viral on SNS for her birthday. Hmm... a ghost video?
data.home-action-chs-birthday-kkr-01|text: It's Kokoro-chan's birthday... I bought pudding from that famous shop!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-kor-01|text: Fran-san's birthday party sounds like it'll have lots of stylish people...! I kind of admire that.
data.home-action-chs-birthday-ktn-01|text: I haven't given Kotono-chan her present yet... Today seems busy for her.
data.home-action-chs-birthday-mei-01|text: I just told Mei-chan happy birthday at the dorm! She looked so happy...
data.home-action-chs-birthday-mhk-01|text: miho-san wasn't excited at all despite it being her birthday... She's so grown-up...!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-mna-01|text: It's Mana-san's birthday... She's someone unforgettable for Hoshimi Pro, for all of us.
data.home-action-chs-birthday-ngs-01|text: Nagisa-chan was being congratulated by so many people, and she looked so happy...!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-rei-01|text: Rei-chan, today's your birthday! Shizuku-chan and I have learned so much from you, so we'll celebrate fully!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-rio-01|text: Today's Rio-san's birthday... Right? Maybe my onee-chan and I should go congratulate her...
data.home-action-chs-birthday-rui-01|text: I went to tell Rui-san happy birthday! She was really happy... I'm glad...
data.home-action-chs-birthday-ski-01|text: Today is my onee-chan's birthday! It makes me happy too...!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-skr-01|text: Sakura-chan's birthday celebration was a total success...! Ehehehe.
data.home-action-chs-birthday-smr-01|text: Today is Sumire-chan's birthday... I want to go tell her happy birthday!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-suz-01|text: Suzu-chan, it's your birthday! I hope you stay bright and cheerful forever...!
data.home-action-chs-birthday-szk-01|text: Today is Shizuku-chan's birthday. When you're close, you actually get more stuck on what to give...
data.home-action-chs-birthday-yu-01|text: I heard it's Yu-chan's birthday! She's always so kind to me, so I need to thank her...!
data.home-action-chs-christ-01|text: Let's all eat Christmas cake together...
data.home-action-chs-halw-01|text: Ehehe, I came to collect my treats!
data.home-action-chs-newy-01|text: Happy New Year! I'll do my best this year too.
data.home-action-chs-newyeve-01|text: It's already year-end... What kind of year was it?
data.home-action-chs-trust-01-01|text: I can run faster than before, but if I match Rei-chan's pace I get sore for two days... Secret!
data.home-action-chs-trust-01-02|text: My onee-chan's room is relaxing, Shizuku-chan's room is fun... I might not need my own room.
data.home-action-chs-trust-01-03|text: Even though you're busy, I'm happy you watch our work, lives, and lessons. Please don't overdo it...
data.home-action-chs-trust-02-01|text: It'd be great if the dorm had a sewing machine. I could mend clothes and costumes, and... everyone would be happy, right?
data.home-action-chs-trust-02-02|text: When our parents were away, my onee-chan used to cook. Let's see... like kusaya in sandwich bread...?
data.home-action-chs-trust-02-03|text: The cafe I went to with Sakura-chan and Shizuku-chan was really nice, so I want to go together next time!
data.home-action-chs-trust-03-01|text: Sometimes I can't sleep... and on those nights I stay in my onee-chan's room. But only sometimes, okay?
data.home-action-chs-trust-03-02|text: I put snacks and energy drinks in the fridge... You looked tired, so...
data.home-action-chs-trust-03-03|text: I have a request... Would you see that horror movie that shook all of America with me? No one else will go...
data.home-action-chs-trust-04-01|text: Shall we go clothes shopping? I... really trust {user}-san's sense of style...!
data.home-action-chs-trust-04-02|text: I'd like to talk a bit more... I feel like talking beforehand makes the live go better... A jinx?
data.home-action-chs-trust-04-03|text: If the next live goes well, could I do that thing just once? You know, the hanging-on-your-arm thing...
data.home-action-hrk-05-adlt-00-01|text: Seeing Sakura-chan in an outfit just like mine got me thinking... Wouldn't it be nice to see a more mature Sunny Peace?
data.home-action-hrk-05-adlt-00-cos-01|text: This black dress-style outfit... Maybe it's a bit too grown-up for a seventeen-year-old.
data.home-action-hrk-05-adlt-00-cos-02|text: Other idols aren't rivals— they're partners in boosting the industry. I want to be friends with everyone.
data.home-action-hrk-05-adlt-00-cos-03|text: A junior told me, "Haruko-san, you're refreshingly normal." Is that... a compliment?
data.home-action-hrk-05-casl-04-01|text: Drinking as much as you want without worrying about the last train... Home drinking is wonderful. Add good company and it's perfect.
data.home-action-hrk-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: You need a breather too, don't you? Just say the word and I'll join you for a drink anytime.
data.home-action-hrk-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: When I drink with you, I relax and have such a lovely time that I can't help but keep pouring.
data.home-action-hrk-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: A drink after a job well done is something special. I suppose this is what they call the wine of victory.
data.home-action-hrk-05-chna-00-01|text: Even getting flustered and blushing becomes a talking point... So this kind of appeal works too. Good to know!
data.home-action-hrk-05-chna-00-cos-01|text: Hmm, this outfit really does get people staring, doesn't it? It's a teensy bit embarrassing.
data.home-action-hrk-05-chna-00-cos-02|text: Shizuku-chan came at me with that intense look, saying she wants to photograph me in this again. Can I borrow the meeting room?
data.home-action-hrk-05-chna-00-cos-03|text: Kokoro-chan said this look would fit right in at the supermarket. Do you think she's right?
data.home-action-hrk-05-fest-00-01|text: Wanting to do something for someone is a truly lovely thing. The feelings put into it will surely get across.
data.home-action-hrk-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: Singing is mysterious, isn't it? Feelings I can't express in words somehow find their way through song.
data.home-action-hrk-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: Our special live surprised you, didn't it? Getting everything ready without anyone noticing was no easy feat.
data.home-action-hrk-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: Through all kinds of experiences, every memory here has become a precious treasure.
data.home-action-hrk-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: I loved my solo outfits too, but nothing compares to this... We've come so far together.
data.home-action-hrk-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: Oh no, Haruko, pull yourself together. This outfit brings back so many memories I'm about to burst into tears.
data.home-action-hrk-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: When you think Sunny Peace, you think of this! It's not like it's too cute for Haruko, right~?
data.home-action-hrk-05-idol-03-01|text: If Sunny Peace became the world's best idols, then {user}-kun would be the world's best manager!
data.home-action-hrk-05-idol-03-cos-01|text: Wearing this outfit makes me feel a fire in my chest, like my back straightens with courage!
data.home-action-hrk-05-idol-03-cos-02|text: I know it's a tall order. But I'm certain Sunny Peace can still aim even higher!
data.home-action-hrk-05-idol-03-cos-03|text: If there's anything I can help with for shoots or MVs, just let me know anytime!
data.home-action-hrk-05-link-00-01|text: I want to make Mana-chan proud having played the same role, so I'll work hard at this musical.
data.home-action-hrk-05-link-00-cos-01|text: With the singing and dancing I honed as an idol, I'll see through the lead role in this musical.
data.home-action-hrk-05-link-00-cos-02|text: When Mana-chan tells me "Haruko-chan, you can do it," I actually start believing I can.
data.home-action-hrk-05-link-00-cos-03|text: I've never had great memories with auditions. I wonder how I can pass them.
data.home-action-hrk-05-link-00-cos-b-01|text: For Haruko-chan's birthday, I want to decorate the office secretly. Of course you'll help me, right?
data.home-action-hrk-05-link-00-cos-b-02|text: When I see Haruko-chan looking down, I just want to make her smile. Smiling suits her best, after all.
data.home-action-hrk-05-link-00-cos-b-03|text: I want to practice lines for the next musical. Would you be my scene partner?
data.home-action-hrk-05-link-00_b-01|text: Seeing Haruko-chan working so hard makes me want to push myself harder too. It's motivating.
data.home-action-hrk-05-mizg-01-01|text: Hey hey, you remember our promise? I won't let you say you forgot. You can invite me anytime, you know.
data.home-action-hrk-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: You know, this outfit feels like a good-luck charm to me. Know what I mean~?
data.home-action-hrk-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: Too revealing for an outfit, but not quite a swimsuit either... Hmm, how should I interpret this... Oh well.
data.home-action-hrk-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: H-hey, just to be safe, I want to ask... We're not wearing this for a winter shoot, are we?
data.home-action-hrk-05-mnab-00-01|text: Everyone always believed I could do it. Thank you so much, truly.
data.home-action-hrk-05-mnab-00-cos-01|text: 'voyage' is a song that Mana-chan gave me. I'll sing it with care.
data.home-action-hrk-05-mnab-00-cos-02|text: Next time, I want to encourage others with my singing—just like Mana-chan encouraged me.
data.home-action-hrk-05-mnab-00-cos-03|text: I made this outfit with Kotono-chan's help. It was tough, but I'm so glad we created it.
data.home-action-hrk-05-onep-00-01|text: No matter how dreamy the hot spring, the scale in the changing room brings you right back to reality...
data.home-action-hrk-05-onep-00-cos-01|text: Working hard is important, but sometimes it's good to stop and rest too.
data.home-action-hrk-05-onep-00-cos-02|text: A drink after a bath is the best~ ...Eh? Of course I mean fruit milk!
data.home-action-hrk-05-onep-00-cos-03|text: Why don't you try soaking in a hot spring and relaxing sometimes, {user}-kun?
data.home-action-hrk-05-pair-00-01|text: Tonkatsu monster... Macaron monster... Wota monster... 10-kowai monster... Plump monster... Hmm...
data.home-action-hrk-05-pair-00-cos-01|text: Being in this miniature setting doesn't it make the plumpness stand out even more...?
data.home-action-hrk-05-pair-00-cos-02|text: Rei-chan's feeling better, so let's celebrate! Maybe I'll make some macarons.
data.home-action-hrk-05-pair-00-cos-03|text: Rei-chan was worried about gaining weight during her rest. I totally get that~.
data.home-action-hrk-05-pajm-00-01|text: Getting scouted by my favorite magazine feels like a dream. Pajama-style, that is.
data.home-action-hrk-05-pajm-00-cos-01|text: Loungewear isn't something people see often, which makes it feel all the more special.
data.home-action-hrk-05-pajm-00-cos-02|text: In this outfit, could I join 'Pajama Party' too...?
data.home-action-hrk-05-pajm-00-cos-03|text: I want to be the reliable onee-san, but when I'm with you, I sometimes feel like leaning on someone.
data.home-action-hrk-05-sail-00-01|text: Come by for a meal again anytime. Everyone wants to talk with you more. No need to be shy!
data.home-action-hrk-05-sail-00-cos-01|text: If you get sleepy on the train again, can I borrow your shoulder? Fufu, just kidding... Maybe.
data.home-action-hrk-05-sail-00-cos-02|text: Why not visit the resort once it opens? I think everyone would have a blast.
data.home-action-hrk-05-sail-00-cos-03|text: We had so much fun despite the trouble. I guess it's all about how you look at things.
data.home-action-hrk-05-vlnt-00-01|text: Hey, isn't the skirt too short? Is this what students wear these days?
data.home-action-hrk-05-vlnt-00-cos-01|text: I hope the fans feel that sweet, nostalgic flutter too. Just like I do... Not!
data.home-action-hrk-05-vlnt-00-cos-02|text: If you're a beginner at cooking, I recommend gateau chocolat. It's easy and delicious. Want to make it together?
data.home-action-hrk-05-vlnt-00-cos-03|text: Sailor, blazer—both lovely, but cardigans are nice too. They're all too cute to give up.
data.home-action-hrk-05-wedd-00-01|text: Do you have an ideal partner in mind? Er... don't get the wrong idea. I'm asking everyone else too.
data.home-action-hrk-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: If I fell in love with someone I could never be with, what would happen... What do you think?
data.home-action-hrk-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: Someday I hope I get to marry someone I love and wear a wedding dress of my own.
data.home-action-hrk-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: Because of that drama, fans keep saying 'Marry me!' more and more. It's complicated...
data.home-action-hrk-05-xmas-00-01|text: Hey, let's never forget how it felt when we were handing out flyers together. Both of us.
data.home-action-hrk-05-xmas-00-cos-01|text: How's the outfit? Falling for it? Fufu, you can be honest with me sometimes, you know.
data.home-action-hrk-05-xmas-00-cos-02|text: I'm truly blessed with the people around me. Hoshimi everyone, college friends, and {user}-kun too!
data.home-action-hrk-05-xmas-00-cos-03|text: Hey, did I say anything weird when I was drunk the other day? My memory's all fuzzy...
data.home-action-hrk-2nd-anniv-01|text: At its core, Hoshimi Pro hasn't really changed at all, has it? I've been thinking that lately.
data.home-action-hrk-2nd-anniv-02|text: Hey hey. Eh? Something's off? Nope, nothing like that. Just the usual Haruko.
data.home-action-hrk-2nd-anniv-03|text: Hey hey! Eh? My energy's weird? No it's not! This is just the usual energetic Haruko.
data.home-action-hrk-basic-01|text: Good work~ It's a packed schedule today! You're coming with me, of course?
data.home-action-hrk-basic-02|text: I watched a 'Start 100 Fires' video for camping and Shizuku-chan called it gloomy. Is it gloomy?
data.home-action-hrk-basic-03|text: I put music to some ruins photos and edited them. Shizuku-chan said it was moody... Is it moody?
data.home-action-hrk-basic-04|text: Listen! Since starting dorm life everyone, my recipes have passed 100! Maybe I'll publish a cookbook someday.
data.home-action-hrk-basic-05|text: The next live is on the same day as Tsukisto for the first time in a while! Exciting, but I can't lose!
data.home-action-hrk-basic-06|text: It's my day off. Everyone went to school, and I'm alone in this huge dorm... I drank alone out of loneliness.
data.home-action-hrk-basic-07|text: Thanks for landing me that camping magazine serial! That one really fills me with purpose!
data.home-action-hrk-basic-08|text: Did you know? Rio-san follows big-name actors and famous comedians on SNS. For work reference, of course.
data.home-action-hrk-basic-09|text: Did you know? Ai-chan's body fat percentage. I won't tell you, but she's basically an athlete. Book her accordingly.
data.home-action-hrk-basic-10|text: Uototto-san, idol otaku, horror movies, dance her whole life... It's not just me who's plain, right?
data.home-action-hrk-basic-51|text: I asked everyone in Sunny Peace what club they'd join. Sakura-chan said the Tonkatsu Research Club!
data.home-action-hrk-basic-52|text: I'd love to have a drink with kana-san next! She seems like she knows all the stylish bars.
data.home-action-hrk-basic-53|text: I have no memory of how I got home after drinking with Fran-san... I woke up in my room. Mysterious.
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-ai-01|text: Today's Ai-chan's birthday. What would make her happy? What does Ai-chan even like?
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-aoi-01|text: Aoi-chan's birthday, huh. LizNoir doesn't seem like the type for big celebrations. I wonder what they'll do.
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-chs-01|text: I went all out for Chisa-chan's birthday! Glad she enjoyed it. What a relief!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-chs-02|text: It's Chisa-chan's birthday, so I'm baking a cake. Red strawberry sauce for a horror twist.
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-hrk-01|text: So many people celebrated my birthday, I'm so happy! Hope I didn't use it all up...
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-kan-01|text: kana-san said she wants something that'll trend for her birthday. My homemade pickles won't cut it, huh?
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-kkr-01|text: It's Kokoro-chan's birthday! Be wild, but bloom beautifully and gorgeously!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-kor-01|text: Fran-san wants to appear at Paris Fashion Week. How about real French wine as a birthday gift?
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-ktn-01|text: Today's Kotono-chan's birthday. I wish my age would stop. Then I'd be the youngest!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-mei-01|text: Mei-chan's always cheerful, but today she's extra bright. It is her birthday after all!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-mhk-01|text: How about the two of us buy miho-san some alcohol and invite her to drink? It is her birthday, after all.
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-mna-01|text: Happy birthday, Mana-chan. ...I wish I could say that more, many more times.
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-ngs-01|text: Nagisa-chan, it's your birthday. Since we cook together a lot, maybe I'll give her a recipe book.
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-rei-01|text: Alright, time to get pumped for Rei-chan's birthday prep! Let's do this!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-rio-01|text: Rio-san's birthday, huh. If only she could take it easy today... But that's unrealistic.
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-rui-01|text: I went to give Rui-chan her birthday present and she was practicing on her own. I'm in awe!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-ski-01|text: Today's Saki-chan's birthday. I want her to relax, so I took over her cleaning shift.
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-skr-01|text: All done! What, you ask? The birthday celebration for Sakura-chan, of course!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-smr-01|text: Today's Sumire-chan's birthday. As the onee-san from Tokyo, I have to celebrate properly!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-suz-01|text: Suzu-chan's having a birthday! What would make her happy... Black tea, maybe?
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-szk-01|text: Tonight we feast!! It's Shizuku-chan's birthday! Let's make it grand!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-user-01|text: Today's your birthday, right. Happy birthday!
data.home-action-hrk-birthday-yu-01|text: I went to tell Yu-chan happy birthday earlier. She was pleased and that made me happy too!
data.home-action-hrk-christ-01|text: Christmas, huh... Eh, my birthday's still a ways off!
data.home-action-hrk-halw-01|text: You want me to prank you? ...Just kidding.
data.home-action-hrk-newy-01|text: Happy New Year. Let's keep it up this year too.
data.home-action-hrk-newyeve-01|text: Thanks for this year. See you next year too.
data.home-action-hrk-trust-01-01|text: I get invited to college parties sometimes, but that kind of glittery scene isn't really my thing~
data.home-action-hrk-trust-01-02|text: There's a little izakaya near campus that's easy to drop into alone. Want to go together?
data.home-action-hrk-trust-01-03|text: Thank you for always booking our lives! If there's anything I can do, just say the word!
data.home-action-hrk-trust-02-01|text: Hey, could we make a garden in the Tokyo dorm yard like before? I'll spread the fertilizer too. Please?
data.home-action-hrk-trust-02-02|text: My grandma sent a ton of wine to the dorm! I can't finish it alone. Anyone want to be my drinking buddy?
data.home-action-hrk-trust-02-03|text: Do you like chicken nanban? Everyone at the dorm loved it, so I'll make some for you next time!
data.home-action-hrk-trust-03-01|text: Everyone asked me about my math homework yesterday and I pretended to be busy. Truth is, I can't solve a single one...
data.home-action-hrk-trust-03-02|text: Everyone said to have a party at the dorm, please come. Though maybe it's really just me who wants you there...
data.home-action-hrk-trust-03-03|text: I'm always hiking alone and it's lonely~ I wish someone kind would come along with me~
data.home-action-hrk-trust-04-01|text: I'm thinking of making boxed lunches for a while. You can join if you want, but maybe people will think it's weird?
data.home-action-hrk-trust-04-02|text: Ever since TriAile and LizNoir moved in, things feel distant. Is that really all our bond meant to me?
data.home-action-hrk-trust-04-03|text: I wish you'd call on me sometimes. Even the onee-san gets lonely in front of everyone.
data.home-action-kan-05-buny-00-01|text: Wearing this costume is fine but kana does NOT want to be on set with those losers. Why? Who cares!
data.home-action-kan-05-buny-00-cos-01|text: Why buy the same bag in different colors? To line them up and take photos, obviously.
data.home-action-kan-05-buny-00-cos-02|text: The candy I got in Vegas was a total bust. At least it made good SNS content.
data.home-action-kan-05-buny-00-cos-03|text: kana wants to go to a casino too! Once I clear the age limit, book me another Vegas gig, okay?
data.home-action-kan-05-casl-04-01|text: There is this old geezer who cannot stop trying to contact kana. Ugh, the legwork is such a pain…
data.home-action-kan-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: I wonder if UoUo-san has a lore where they get filleted into sashimi and it's delicious.
data.home-action-kan-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: When kana told fran that {user} bought me a smartphone, she got SO jealous~.
data.home-action-kan-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: I saw that Sunny Peace show. Making Rei cook Chinese food? That is a blasphemy against culinary history…
data.home-action-kan-05-chna-00-01|text: When is Hoshimi Pro's year-end party? I snagged a wig from the shoot, so you can wear it.
data.home-action-kan-05-chna-00-cos-01|text: The costume is cute, sure. But then why does the character setting always get messed up?!
data.home-action-kan-05-chna-00-cos-02|text: When I told fran I was going to be in a live-action manga, she got jealous and asked for the author's autograph.
data.home-action-kan-05-chna-00-cos-03|text: Ha, tou, yaa!! kana's character was supposed to be a martial arts master. Supposed to.
data.home-action-kan-05-fest-02-01|text: My dad? I have not been in touch since he went back. It is lonely but we said goodbye. It is fine.
data.home-action-kan-05-fest-02-cos-01|text: Apparently miho pickles her own nukazuke. Well, she only seems to be friends with fungi anyway.
data.home-action-kan-05-fest-02-cos-02|text: Yamada-san was mumbling in her sleep about hitting a huge bet. Dreams and reality are different.
data.home-action-kan-05-fest-02-cos-03|text: If fran starts asking me to wear her brand to fashion shows, I wonder how much I should charge.
data.home-action-kan-05-idol-00-01|text: kana wants to stand out the most. You will help with that, right? You are the manager after all.
data.home-action-kan-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: Hey hey, got any material? Something that could go viral on SNS… How about you do a naked dance?
data.home-action-kan-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: What are you staring at? If you want to gaze upon the great idol kana, there better be a tip~.
data.home-action-kan-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: miho keeps nagging kana not to eat too many sweets. kana is working hard, that is so mean!
data.home-action-kan-05-idol-03-01|text: Seriously, this office is way too small. Let us move somewhere bigger.
data.home-action-kan-05-idol-03-cos-01|text: Why is kana stuck at the office? Get me more work!
data.home-action-kan-05-idol-03-cos-02|text: Man, kana looks good in literally anything~. You agree right?
data.home-action-kan-05-idol-03-cos-03|text: This costume suits me way too well, huh… Ah, ignore that. It was already obvious anyway.

data.home-action-kor-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Croissants in Japan have this chewy texture. Must be the higher humidity compared to Paris.
data.home-action-kor-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: By the way, are there plans for new Slixx merch? I would like to do some designing again.
data.home-action-kor-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: Brand and design work is important, but I have no intention of neglecting being an idol either.
data.home-action-kor-05-fest-02-01|text: I am working hard to pay it back! So please stop saying debt, debt, debt, debt!
data.home-action-kor-05-fest-02-cos-01|text: I showed the design to Suzu and asked what a kid would think. They got very excited about it.
data.home-action-kor-05-fest-02-cos-02|text: You met kana's father? That is… sorry for you. Dealing with that useless old man.
data.home-action-kor-05-fest-02-cos-03|text: miho has started talking about the past occasionally lately. The problem is her stories go on forever…
data.home-action-kor-05-idol-00-01|text: If there is a good money-making opportunity, tell me first. I will not lead you astray.
data.home-action-kor-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: I do not think just anyone can pull off this costume. You need at least Paris Fashion Week experience.
data.home-action-kor-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: Do I have preferences for how I wear costumes? Of course. I pay attention to my expression so the outfit looks its best.
data.home-action-kor-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: Why am I asking about costumes? Because someone packed my schedule with no time to change, that is why.
data.home-action-kor-05-idol-03-01|text: This office has quite a few valuables, does it not? …Eh? No particular reason.
data.home-action-kor-05-idol-03-cos-01|text: I want to try designing a dress someday. I have plenty of ideas.
data.home-action-kor-05-idol-03-cos-02|text: I am quite good at the way my dress hem flows when I turn. It is a technique I learned from Paris Couture modeling.
data.home-action-kor-05-idol-03-cos-03|text: If a new merch design job comes in, let me handle it! I have been doing my research.
data.home-action-kor-05-mizg-01-01|text: The sea breeze from the boat was amazing. If there is another ocean shoot, definitely count me in. I will perfect my sun protection.
data.home-action-kor-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: A costume you wore not just for the live but also while stranded— that is quite rare.
data.home-action-kor-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: Sumire told me with a smile, 'I know which wild plants are edible too!' What kind of solidarity is that?
data.home-action-kor-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: Do NOT tell anyone about the time I was scared while stranded. Especially not kana!
data.home-action-kor-05-mizg-02-01|text: I get tons of party invites from kana's friends… Of course I turn them all down.
data.home-action-kor-05-mizg-02-cos-01|text: I focused on making costumes that will help fans love Slixx even more.
data.home-action-kor-05-mizg-02-cos-02|text: I never want to be at kana's mercy again… I need to come up with some kind of countermeasure.
data.home-action-kor-05-mizg-02-cos-03|text: Performing live in a costume I designed myself is truly something special.
data.home-action-kor-05-newy-00-01|text: I need to watch the bank operating days around New Year's… lesson learned…
data.home-action-kor-05-newy-00-cos-02|text: kana and miho mocked me, but not posting the video would have been absolutely worse… right…
data.home-action-kor-05-newy-00-cos-03|text: What should I do for the next video? Maybe a survival knowledge wild plants taste test?
data.home-action-kor-05-nurs-00-01|text: I was not particularly popular as a child, so I really looked forward to watching anime.
data.home-action-kor-05-nurs-00-cos-01|text: Respecting the original while ensuring mobility on stage. That is what 2.5D costumes are.
data.home-action-kor-05-nurs-00-cos-02|text: I enjoy watching cosplay, but I never tried it myself. Now I sort of understand the appeal.
data.home-action-kor-05-nurs-00-cos-03|text: Starring in a stage adaptation of a manga I drew myself sounds interesting. Yeah, I can definitely do that!
data.home-action-kor-05-poli-00-01|text: I used a yuzu bath tablet but it was nothing compared to the real yuzu bath at that inn. Only the real thing works.
data.home-action-kor-05-poli-00-cos-01|text: Please do not look at me with dirty eyes. …Being calmly told you are not is also somehow annoying.
data.home-action-kor-05-poli-00-cos-02|text: Intense costume with incredible detail. I want to talk more with the designer next time.
data.home-action-kor-05-poli-00-cos-03|text: I would like to try making Slixx costumes eventually. Those two will complain about it though.
data.home-action-kor-05-xmas-00-01|text: I prefer earning what I want myself rather than having it given as a gift.
data.home-action-kor-05-xmas-00-cos-01|text: Christmas means stollen, right? You have to eat it slowly or you will definitely gain weight…
data.home-action-kor-05-xmas-00-cos-02|text: Just thinking about New Year's is already depressing. It is the money I have to give to relatives' kids…
data.home-action-kor-05-xmas-00-cos-03|text: Because I am the tallest at Hoshimi Pro, I got roped into helping decorate the office tree too.
data.home-action-kor-2nd-anniv-01|text: Matching with others is harder than I expected. Having too much talent makes you oblivious to that.
data.home-action-kor-2nd-anniv-02|text: I do not want to owe anyone anything. You never know when they will call it in. Pay it back when you can.
data.home-action-kor-2nd-anniv-03|text: Have you heard anything from kana? No, if you have not, that is fine. She talks too much, so I worry.
data.home-action-kor-basic-01|text: Good work. Are you coming with today? Let us both do good work.
data.home-action-kor-basic-02|text: My favorite brand released a new piece. Which color should I get… Sigh, I wish I could buy them all.
data.home-action-kor-basic-03|text: No way… I missed the new stock surge. I never thought it would actually happen…
data.home-action-kor-basic-04|text: Can you do something about that outfit? You are my manager, so please be a bit more presentable.
data.home-action-kor-basic-05|text: I do my lessons. Moderately. I do not need to push myself when I have talent.
data.home-action-kor-basic-06|text: Esthetics cannot be expensed? That has to be a joke. At least let me deduct haircuts.
data.home-action-kor-basic-07|text: Is this agency financially stable? May I see the balance sheet? I would hate for it to go under.
data.home-action-kor-basic-08|text: Do not take modeling lightly. The only one here who can do it properly is Rui.
data.home-action-kor-basic-09|text: kana is a brat. Because she keeps picking fights, people think I have a bad mouth too.
data.home-action-kor-basic-10|text: Does getting close make you stronger? I honestly cannot imagine a relationship beyond business partners.
data.home-action-kor-basic-51|text: I am bad at remembering faces. When I was modeling, that was truly painful.
data.home-action-kor-basic-52|text: I do not go to movie theaters much. I prefer lounging at home and watching in peace.
data.home-action-kor-basic-53|text: I was subjected to Suzu's endless Mana Nagase trivia. It was shorter than your lectures, though.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-ai-01|text: Ai is truly loved, isn't she. I said congratulations too. She was terrifyingly happy about it.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-aoi-01|text: Aoi—is that boy really an idol? On his birthday there should be more of a fuss, shouldn't there?
data.home-action-kor-birthday-chs-01|text: Chisa is lucky. Being celebrated like this. The blessing from her sister is especially something.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-hrk-01|text: Seems to be Haruko's birthday. I thought she was older, but I was wrong. I will not tell her, though.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-kan-01|text: kana has been going on about her birthday since morning!! How old is that brat turning anyway?!
