data.home-action-kor-birthday-kkr-01|text: I gave Kokoro a present. She was disgustingly eager for it. At her age I can barely allow it. Barely.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-kor-01|text: You knew it was my birthday. Words alone are fine, but you could also transfer cash.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-ktn-01|text: Kotono's birthday? Huh. Good for her. Though with Christmas it all feels a bit unfortunate.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-mei-01|text: Mei's birthday, is it. Honestly, I am not great with that type… You know what I mean.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-mhk-01|text: miho keeps her usual composed face but I think she is secretly pleased the Hoshimi kids are celebrating for her.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-mna-01|text: So it is Mana Nagase's birthday. Should I say congratulations? I would have liked to meet her once.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-ngs-01|text: Seems to be Nagisa's birthday. I am aware that Kotono is running around frantically at least.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-rei-01|text: Rei is quite composed for her age. I think she could be a bit more excited on her birthday though.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-rio-01|text: It is Rei's birthday, right? That girl has it rough too. I can feel it.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-rui-01|text: It is Rui's birthday, right. I told her congratulations. She looks mature but she is not really.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-ski-01|text: I know it is Saki's birthday. I said happy birthday. …I will say at least that much.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-skr-01|text: It is Sakura's birthday, right? I can hardly miss it being here. No need for me to congratulate her though.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-smr-01|text: Sumire is so pure it is scary. I said happy birthday and she grabbed my hand and thanked me.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-suz-01|text: Seems to be Suzu's birthday. She was staring at me intensely so I gave her the sweets I had.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-szk-01|text: Sakura asked me to give Shizuku some Slixx merch. It is not a big deal or anything.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-user-01|text: Ah, it is your birthday. Happy birthday.
data.home-action-kor-birthday-yu-01|text: I gave Yu a brief congratulation. Hard to pin down, honestly a bit scary. That girl.
data.home-action-kor-christ-01|text: I like illuminations. Most of the time I am working though, so I never get to properly see them.
data.home-action-kor-halw-01|text: Halloween… I hate it. Sorry, but you will have to forgive my low energy today.
data.home-action-kor-newy-01|text: New Year's break sounds nice. I want to try relaxing in Hawaii sometime.
data.home-action-kor-newyeve-01|text: A year feels long yet short. There was a lot that happened. Well, here is to next year.
data.home-action-kor-transit-card-portal-top|: What are you going to do?
data.home-action-kor-trust-01-01|text: You think I must love parties. Wrong. I despise them. I only go for networking.
data.home-action-kor-trust-01-02|text: On days off I am usually home. Manga, movies, games… anime too. Being home makes me happiest.
data.home-action-kor-trust-01-03|text: Are you really a manager? You are nothing like any manager I know. …That is meant as a compliment.
data.home-action-kor-trust-02-01|text: Hey, what percentage does the agency take? Last month's show fee felt a bit low.
data.home-action-kor-trust-02-02|text: My father is Japanese and my mother is German. As a child I resented this look. Now I am grateful.
data.home-action-kor-trust-02-03|text: You have no complaints about our style? No, if not, then fine. Just leave us alone.
data.home-action-kor-trust-03-01|text: Running SNS is hopeless… I just post pre-taken photos pretending it is from that day.
data.home-action-kor-trust-03-02|text: Just confirm the schedule. Send it in a message. And please stop treating me like a child.
data.home-action-kor-trust-03-03|text: There are times I actually practice seriously, you know. Next time you come, time it for one of those.
data.home-action-kor-trust-04-01|text: Not coming to the live? I do not care either way. If the schedule works, I suppose.
data.home-action-kor-trust-04-02|text: You have books on management? I will lend you mine along with my recommendations. …I just do not want the agency to fail.
data.home-action-kor-trust-04-03|text: Pretty eyes? What? What are you talking about? I will not talk to you anymore!
data.home-action-ktn-05-casl-04-01|text: You used to go to karaoke with your onee-chan a lot, right? Is that why you're good at singing? Her influence?
data.home-action-ktn-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: When I mentioned I like people who feel like family, Nagisa got all excited like 'That's me!' Well... she's not wrong.
data.home-action-ktn-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: No matter what happens between us, I want to stay by {user}'s side for a long, long time.
data.home-action-ktn-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: I won't say who exactly... but I love my onii-chan and my onee-chan dearly.
data.home-action-ktn-05-circ-00-01|text: Aoi was surprisingly perfect as the villain. I was amazed. I guess she has that kind of range, too.
data.home-action-ktn-05-circ-00-cos-01|text: Singing and acting are so different, aren't they? When I was practicing lines, I was really embarrassed...
data.home-action-ktn-05-circ-00-cos-02|text: You really haven't told anyone about what happened at the arcade, right? You must never tell anyone...!
data.home-action-ktn-05-circ-00-cos-03|text: Everyone at Hoshimi Pro praised my promotional poster so much. I'm happy but... it's embarrassing.
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-00-01|text: At the New Year's shrine visit, someone pushed my back again. I'm really grateful, you know?
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: This costume has cute details even in places you can't easily see. It really surprised me!
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: Um... do I have... any sparkle? I wonder how {user} sees me...
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: We made a great start to the new year. This year I'll keep running forward with everyone.
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-01-01|text: Just like you listened to my concerns, please feel free to come to me with yours. I'm always here.
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-01-cos-01|text: Sakura keeps inviting me on tonkatsu dates. I have to refuse sometimes or my weight will... ugh.
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-01-cos-02|text: Our joint practice with Sunny Peace is so much fun. The discussions between members are really lively.
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-01-cos-03|text: Slix's live gave me chills down to my core. It was amazing, but... we can't lose to them either!
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-02-01|text: About how to interact with fans during photo ops... should I ask Kokoro for advice...
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-02-cos-01|text: Nagisa praises me every day about performing solo on stage. But she's only seen a little of it.
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-02-cos-02|text: Visiting the gravesite isn't just about talking to my onee-chan... it helps me return to my roots.
data.home-action-ktn-05-fest-02-cos-03|text: After the festival, Suz keeps telling me, 'I want to sing a rain solo too!' at every opportunity.
data.home-action-ktn-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: Seeing the moon charm on my chest makes me feel resolute. I wish they'd make keychains or merch out of it.
data.home-action-ktn-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: It's been a while since we did a live battle in this costume. Please watch us.
data.home-action-ktn-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: The heels are surprisingly high... At first I almost tripped, but now I don't lose my balance anymore.
data.home-action-ktn-05-kiok-00-01|text: When I see Suz and Mei talking about the Moon Tempest album, I get a little worried...
data.home-action-ktn-05-kiok-00-cos-01|text: Standing next to Rio it fits perfectly, but the small details are completely different. Designers are truly amazing.
data.home-action-ktn-05-kiok-00-cos-02|text: This stage was supported by Rio and my sister. And of course by {user} too.
data.home-action-ktn-05-kiok-00-cos-03|text: This costume... what do you think? Wait, no blurting it out right away! I need time to prepare myself...!
data.home-action-ktn-05-mizg-01-01|text: Next time you make a swimsuit-style costume, please ask me first. I might reduce the skin exposure.
data.home-action-ktn-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: Sorry for asking again... this costume really isn't the manager's taste, right?
data.home-action-ktn-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: I understand it's well-designed... I do. But that's separate from whether it's embarrassing!
data.home-action-ktn-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: Wearing this costume reminds me of that live where Moon Tempest took a step forward.
data.home-action-ktn-05-mizg-03-01|text: So that I can be the imouto my onee-chan is proud of, I'll keep moving forward in my own way.
data.home-action-ktn-05-mizg-03-cos-01|text: I never expected I'd end up self-studying for a national exam. It was good motivation.
data.home-action-ktn-05-mizg-03-cos-02|text: Want to try riding a water scooter together next time? It'll be fun, I promise.
data.home-action-ktn-05-mizg-03-cos-03|text: Even in a swimsuit-style costume, I'll stand tall and proud. For the sake of our fans' smiles.
data.home-action-ktn-05-mnab-00-01|text: Please tell me all about your memories with my onee-chan, {user}.
data.home-action-ktn-05-mnab-00-cos-01|text: I thought I was just copying my onee-chan's costume, but what came out was pretty daring...
data.home-action-ktn-05-mnab-00-cos-02|text: Saki's lunchbox? It's delicious. And she calculates the calories perfectly. It's really impressive.
data.home-action-ktn-05-mnab-00-cos-03|text: My onee-chan's face when we rode the roller coaster together back then... it was so funny...
data.home-action-ktn-05-msic-00-01|text: I wonder what my onee-chan would say if she heard my answer song. I hope it would make her happy...
data.home-action-ktn-05-msic-00-cos-01|text: I'm glad we found Mei's souvenir local donuts and Saki's souvenir sweet potatoes.
data.home-action-ktn-05-msic-00-cos-02|text: I just passed miho in the hall. She said 'It was so-so.' ...That's what she said.
data.home-action-ktn-05-msic-00-cos-03|text: I played piano again for the first time in a while and had fun. Someday I'd like to try singing along.
data.home-action-ktn-05-newy-00-01|text: I tried this costume on at the dorm before the shoot, and Nagisa went full photographer mode... took dozens of pictures.
data.home-action-ktn-05-newy-00-cos-01|text: She found out I'm broke, and now Suz has developed this strange sense of camaraderie with me...
data.home-action-ktn-05-newy-00-cos-02|text: At the shrine, Saki was having the most fun of anyone. It surprised me a bit, but she looked so cute.
data.home-action-ktn-05-newy-00-cos-03|text: Mei tends to vanish as soon as you look away... During the trip I had GPS on my phone to track her.
data.home-action-ktn-05-poli-00-01|text: {user}? If you don't rest properly, I might have to arrest you. ...Just kidding.
data.home-action-ktn-05-poli-00-cos-01|text: Since I earned this role, I feel even more attached to this costume. How is it? Does it suit me?
data.home-action-ktn-05-poli-00-cos-02|text: Being handcuffed really is a dire situation... a crisis. I need to be careful...
data.home-action-ktn-05-poli-00-cos-03|text: I'm glad nobody saw me in the handcuffs. They'd definitely tease me about it later.
data.home-action-ktn-05-wedd-00-01|text: I wonder if everyone at Hoshimi Pro will get to wear a dress like this someday. I'm a little excited thinking about it.
data.home-action-ktn-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: Yu said she wanted to wear a dress like this too. Did she tell you something?
data.home-action-ktn-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: Hmm... I wonder if I'll ever get to stand at a wedding venue in something like this... How embarrassing.
data.home-action-ktn-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: I actually bought two wedding feature magazines. It's a secret from everyone.
data.home-action-ktn-05-yukt-00-01|text: I'm bad with horror, but 'Zondeddo Banban' is fine. It's more thrilling than scary.
data.home-action-ktn-05-yukt-00-cos-01|text: Chisa and Aoi are both really good at the gun shooting game. Don't tell me the top two rankings are...
data.home-action-ktn-05-yukt-00-cos-02|text: After that, I went around the festival with the dads. It felt so nostalgic I almost cried.
data.home-action-ktn-05-yukt-00-cos-03|text: Cotton Candy Cowboy... Why does it have such a name... ugh...
data.home-action-ktn-2nd-anniv-01|text: How have you been feeling lately? Please don't catch a cold. ...No particular reason for asking!
data.home-action-ktn-2nd-anniv-02|text: May I borrow the key to the costume storage? I'd like to practice in costume for a change.
data.home-action-ktn-2nd-anniv-03|text: Time really flies, doesn't it? What, why do I suddenly ask that... no, just a passing thought!
data.home-action-ktn-basic-01|text: Good work today, Manager. I've been feeling really well lately. Let's do our best today too.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-02|text: 'Likes cotton candy' written in my profile... is that weird? It doesn't feel like me.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-03|text: Seeing 'Hobby: Idol' written down makes me laugh. But it reminded me how much I care about being an idol.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-04|text: I've really felt my dancing improve lately. I wonder what I'd think if I watched my old dance videos now.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-05|text: The new song's chorus has tricky steps. The next live isn't far away, so I'm going to focus today.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-06|text: I didn't understand what 'cute' meant, but I feel like I'm slowly starting to.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-07|text: Did you turn down the haunted house project!? I really can't do ghosts...
data.home-action-ktn-basic-08|text: I tried keeping a diary like Nagisa and my onee-chan do, but... it doesn't seem to suit me.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-09|text: Sakura's dancing has gotten really good lately. It makes me feel like I can't fall behind.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-10|text: I think we got this far because it's these five people. I'm grateful once again that Moon Tempest is us.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-51|text: Don't you think it would be wonderful if, even in a dream, you could spend time with someone precious once more?
data.home-action-ktn-basic-52|text: Motorcycles and sumo wrestling... there are a lot of interesting things once you learn about them.
data.home-action-ktn-basic-53|text: Reading Nagisa's favorite novels makes me feel embarrassed. I can't read them in public...
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-ai-01|text: I heard it's Ai's birthday. She said she loves shortcake. I wonder if everyone's buying some?
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-aoi-01|text: Aoi, today's your birthday. What would you like... Would snacks be okay?
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-chs-01|text: Today is Chisa's birthday. Saki is super excited about it... I was a little overwhelmed.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-hrk-01|text: Today is Hiroko's birthday. She has a lot of things already, so I wasn't sure what to get.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-kan-01|text: kana lined up presents on her desk and took tons of selfies. Her focus was really intense.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-kkr-01|text: It's Kokoro's birthday. I wonder what she wants... Maybe I should just ask her directly?
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-kor-01|text: When I asked fran what she wanted for her birthday, she said something she could sell for a high price.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-ktn-01|text: It feels a little strange, but birthdays really do make you happy, don't they?
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-mei-01|text: Mei was running through the hall clutching a box of donuts... birthday presents, maybe?
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-mhk-01|text: It's miho's birthday. Would it be complicated for Nagisa Mana's imouto to congratulate her?
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-mna-01|text: Today is my onee-chan's birthday... a special day for me too. It makes me want to return to my roots and do my best.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-ngs-01|text: Today is Nagisa's birthday. I told her 'Let's keep in touch' earlier... was that weird?
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-rei-01|text: It's Rei's birthday. I bought her running shoes but she seems pretty particular about those...
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-rio-01|text: Today is Rio's birthday. We've been through a lot, so I want to properly congratulate her.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-rui-01|text: It's Rui's birthday. I told her I want her to keep teaching me various things.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-ski-01|text: Since she takes care of me so often... I want to celibrate Saki's birthday in a big way.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-skr-01|text: It's Sakura's birthday. I went shopping with Nagisa to pick out a present for her.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-smr-01|text: Today is Sumire's birthday. Being TRI-ALL, I'm sure they'll have a grand celebration.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-suz-01|text: Today is Suz's birthday. We're having a party later. Everything is already prepared.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-szk-01|text: It's Shizuku's birthday, so I want to give her something... idol goods, probably.
data.home-action-ktn-birthday-yu-01|text: I congratulated Yu on her birthday, and she smiled just like always... she was happy, right?
data.home-action-ktn-christ-01|text: Spending Christmas with everyone is nice too.
data.home-action-ktn-newy-01|text: Please continue to guide me this year as well.
data.home-action-ktn-newyeve-01|text: I look forward to working with you next year too, {user}.
data.home-action-ktn-trust-01-01|text: Is this pose cute? I-I'm sorry for surprising you. I've been practicing various things lately...
data.home-action-ktn-trust-01-02|text: We've performed in lots of places, but our debut stage in Hoshimi City is still special.
data.home-action-ktn-trust-01-03|text: I'm where I am because of you, {user}. You get angry sometimes... but I'm grateful.
data.home-action-ktn-trust-02-01|text: I'm happy to get work offers, but live TV and radio make me so nervous. I'd prefer recorded shows.
data.home-action-ktn-trust-02-02|text: Both my parents work in music, so our whole family is involved in it. Blood will tell, I suppose.
data.home-action-ktn-trust-02-03|text: Would you watch the video from our last live with me? I'd like you to point out areas to improve.
data.home-action-ktn-trust-03-01|text: I think I cut my bangs a bit too short. Can you tell? I-It's a secret from everyone!
data.home-action-ktn-trust-03-02|text: When you said we'd split the group, I got upset... I'm sorry about that.
data.home-action-ktn-trust-03-03|text: 'Your smile is your charm,' you say? T-Thank you. You can say things like that so boldly...
data.home-action-ktn-trust-04-01|text: How does one find someone they like... Never mind. It doesn't mean anything!
data.home-action-ktn-trust-04-02|text: Um, if you don't mind, could you help me practice cooking? I'd like you to taste-test...
data.home-action-ktn-trust-04-03|text: C-Could you give me a good luck charm for the next live!? Just something to push me from behind...
data.home-action-mei-05-casl-02-01|text: 'What If I Fell in Love with {user}-san.' It'd make a fun game, don't ya think~?
data.home-action-mei-05-casl-02-cos-01|text: Playing Moshikoi yourself is embarrassing! Mei kinda understands how Rei-chan and the others feel.
data.home-action-mei-05-casl-02-cos-02|text: Mei named the Moshikoi protagonist 'Mei' and now there's two Meis and it's confusing!
data.home-action-mei-05-casl-02-cos-03|text: After Moshikoi came out, lots of people started asking Mei 'Do you have someone you like?'~
data.home-action-mei-05-casl-04-01|text: Mei loves the shrine by the station too~. Surrounded by the sea, it really feels like Hoshimi City!
data.home-action-mei-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Hey, {user}-san, did you maybe carry sleeping Mei princess-style?
data.home-action-mei-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: Being apart helps you understand things too, right? Mei might find a new goal!
data.home-action-mei-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: Hoshimi City has tons of yummy restaurants! Let's go eat together again sometime!
data.home-action-mei-05-fest-00-01|text: Hey, {user}-san. If Mei's in an emergency again, will you carry me princess-style?
data.home-action-mei-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: This outfit's so cute~! Mana-chan would've looked great in it too!
data.home-action-mei-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: If {user}-san's tired, all five of us will give you a massage~
data.home-action-mei-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: The dance school kids wrote us letters! They're coming to visit us at the next live!
data.home-action-mei-05-fest-02-01|text: Kotono-chan's center and Suzu-nyan's center are both really amazing, aren't they?
data.home-action-mei-05-fest-02-cos-01|text: Even as BIG4, Mei's goal doesn't change!
data.home-action-mei-05-fest-02-cos-02|text: It's like outer space, so cool! It's a Tsukisto-style outfit and Mei loves it~.
data.home-action-mei-05-fest-02-cos-03|text: Everyone from Tsukisto said Mei's brightness helped them out and Mei was so happy!
data.home-action-mei-05-hruh-00-01|text: Being with Haruhi-chan makes Mei feel like anything's possible. She's such a mysterious person!
data.home-action-mei-05-hruh-00-cos-01|text: Mikuru-chan wore this outfit too~ And she has a mole in a weird place too!
data.home-action-mei-05-hruh-00-cos-02|text: Mei, BEAM!! Such a cute special move! Mei wishes she had one~.
data.home-action-mei-05-hruh-00-cos-03|text: Yuki-chan is actually not human— she's, um, something-face!
data.home-action-mei-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: Only Mei's right shoulder is out~! It feels special, which is nice~. A bit embarrassing though. Nyahaha.
data.home-action-mei-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: Mei wants to do a live in this outfit again~! I wanna~ Give me work, Manager~.
data.home-action-mei-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: If someone says 'your chest looks a bit tighter' it'd be troublesome, right~? You're blushing~.
data.home-action-mei-05-miku-05-01|text: Let's play tag on the beach next time! Mei will run at full speed so you'll never catch me~.
data.home-action-mei-05-miku-05-cos-01|text: Mei was so happy to work with Miku-chan again~! Saki-chan was having so much fun too!
data.home-action-mei-05-miku-05-cos-02|text: The sun's blazing again this summer! On hot days like this, Mei wants to sing and dance on an outdoor stage~.
data.home-action-mei-05-miku-05-cos-03|text: When we were shooting in swimsuits, Nagisa-chan was worried about her belly, so Mei told her it's cute and squishy~.
data.home-action-mei-05-mizg-01-01|text: Mei's heart was racing so much at the new song reveal~! Mei wants to feel that thrill again~.
data.home-action-mei-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: This outfit is great~. Easy to move in and cool— Mei could wear it every day~.
data.home-action-mei-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: Mei can't go to the convenience store like this... right? Ahaha, good thing Mei asked~.
data.home-action-mei-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: Kotono-chan was super embarrassed in this outfit~! But being embarrassed makes it more embarrassing!
data.home-action-mei-05-mizg-02-01|text: Mei loves summer lives~! Hey, can't we have more summer fests!? Every week's fine~!
data.home-action-mei-05-mizg-02-cos-01|text: Ehehe, this outfit's cute, right~? Easy to dance in too—Mei wants clothes like this for casual wear!
data.home-action-mei-05-mizg-02-cos-02|text: Summer's so refreshing~! Wearing this makes Mei wanna jump outside, it's irresistible~.
data.home-action-mei-05-mizg-02-cos-03|text: Everyone kept buying ice cream so the office freezer was packed~! Let's sneak some together!
data.home-action-mei-05-pair-00-01|text: Wanna go to a haunted house together? Don't worry, even if there's a real ghost, Mei won't tell!
data.home-action-mei-05-pair-00-cos-01|text: Mei wants to do a live with Suzu-nyan again somewhere~. Mei is always ready to go!
data.home-action-mei-05-pair-00-cos-02|text: Because of our dates, Mei can remember Mana-chan in lots of places. That makes Mei really happy.
data.home-action-mei-05-pair-00-cos-03|text: Nyaaan~. This outfit's cat-like and cute~. Mei feels like she can move super fast!
data.home-action-mei-05-rock-00-01|text: For the next live, Mei invited Mom and Dad! Now Mei's super motivated~!
data.home-action-mei-05-rock-00-cos-01|text: This outfit matches Rei-chan's! Of course the singing, dancing, and feelings all match too~!
data.home-action-mei-05-rock-00-cos-02|text: Mei danced in front of a kitty and got praised~! How gratifying, nya~.
data.home-action-mei-05-rock-00-cos-03|text: Did Rei-chan's mom and dad like Mei's dancing too~?
data.home-action-mei-05-vlnt-00-01|text: Putting your feelings into chocolate and telling someone is so romantic, right!
data.home-action-mei-05-vlnt-00-cos-01|text: Thanks to the fluffy knit, Mei is warm even in winter~. Not cold at all!
data.home-action-mei-05-vlnt-00-cos-02|text: Making and giving honmei chocolate makes Mei's heart race so much!
data.home-action-mei-05-vlnt-00-cos-03|text: {user}-san's cat impression was so cute~. Can you do it again next time?
data.home-action-mei-05-wedd-00-01|text: {user}-san, be careful of back pain too! When lifting heavy things, do it slowly~!
data.home-action-mei-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: Mei asked Kotono-chan about wearing a wedding dress and she blushed and ran away. How cute~.
data.home-action-mei-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: Mom and Dad said 'Come visit anytime!' Wanna go together sometime?
data.home-action-mei-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: In Mom and Dad's wedding photo, they both looked nervous and cute, but it was really lovely~.
data.home-action-mei-05-xmas-00-01|text: Mei still has a ticket for the grand prize Antarctica tour... What should Mei do?
data.home-action-mei-05-xmas-00-cos-01|text: Mei loves this outfit! Can Mei wear it after Christmas too!? Right!?!
data.home-action-mei-05-xmas-00-cos-02|text: Hey hey, can Mei go around Hoshimi City in this outfit? Mei wants to show everyone~!
data.home-action-mei-05-xmas-00-cos-03|text: Mei's been hooked on the lottery since then! Let's do it together again!
data.home-action-mei-2nd-anniv-01|text: Mei has to stay quiet. Please, Manager, don't ask anything!
data.home-action-mei-2nd-anniv-02|text: Hmm hmm hmmm~ Hmm hmm hmm~... Is Mei in a good mood? Nope, your imagination! Mei's actually grumpy~! Pout pout!
data.home-action-mei-2nd-anniv-03|text: Ah, Manager! Mei has to run! ...Don't call me back! Mei has a top-secret mission!!
data.home-action-mei-basic-01|text: Manager! Mei's giving it her all again today! So what are we doing~?
data.home-action-mei-basic-02|text: Emergency, emergency~! Mised has new donuts coming out~!
data.home-action-mei-basic-03|text: I wonder if Satomi-chan's kitty is doing okay~? Let's go visit sometime~!
data.home-action-mei-basic-04|text: Hmm hmm hmmm~ Something good happened today~! Rei-chan praised Mei's dancing~!
data.home-action-mei-basic-05|text: Yay! Tomorrow's a live~! Mei's so excited~! Thinking about it keeps Mei up at night~!
data.home-action-mei-basic-06|text: Oh right, a little girl came to the dorm recently! Ah! You can't see her, Manager~.
data.home-action-mei-basic-07|text: Yesterday Mei chased a kitty and got lost~! But Mei just kept walking and found the way home!
data.home-action-mei-basic-08|text: Hey hey, listen listen~! Rei-chan's getting hooked on donuts! 'They're surprisingly good' she says~!
data.home-action-mei-basic-09|text: Ah, {user}-san. Have you seen Suzu-nyan? Where's she hiding, nya~?
data.home-action-mei-basic-10|text: Mei thinks she's Tsukisto's energy person, but lately Suzu-nyan is giving Mei a run for her money~.
data.home-action-mei-basic-51|text: Mised is amazing~! They have donuts shaped like curry bread! It's the invention of the century!
data.home-action-mei-basic-52|text: {user}-san went to the same school as Mei and everyone, right? You're a senpai! Senpai~!
data.home-action-mei-basic-53|text: Mei breaks dishes sometimes~. Hmm, I wonder if diamond plates exist~?
data.home-action-mei-birthday-ai-01|text: It's Ai-chan's birthday~! I wonder if they'll have a LizNoir party~?
data.home-action-mei-birthday-aoi-01|text: Aoi-chan's birthday today, right? Maybe Mei should give him her favorite donuts~.
data.home-action-mei-birthday-chs-01|text: Today's Chisa-chan's birthday~! Saki-chan had a really big plan going on!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-chs-02|text: Mei's thinking of giving Chisa-chan sewing tools~! Like needles and cute fabric!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-hrk-01|text: Haruko-chan's birthday today! Everyone was congratulating her. She's so popular!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-kan-01|text: Today's kana-chan's birthday~! She said she wants to take SNS photos with the Manager~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-kkr-01|text: Today's Kokoro-chan's birthday~! A normal celebration probably wouldn't make her happy~. Ahaha!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-kor-01|text: It's Fran-chan's birthday~! When she was in Paris, did she have fancy parties~?
data.home-action-mei-birthday-ktn-01|text: Mei told them to bring Kotono- chan's birthday cake to the back room~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-mei-01|text: Thanks for the present! Mei ate it all in a flash~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-mhk-01|text: What does miho-chan like~? Donuts would make everyone happy, right~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-mna-01|text: Mana-chaaaan, happy birthday! Can you hear me~? You can, right? Yeah.
data.home-action-mei-birthday-ngs-01|text: Nagisa-chan's birthday today~! Probably out with Kotono-chan~? Mei's gonna celebrate lots too!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-rei-01|text: It's Rei-chan's birthday~! Looks like Sunny Peace is everyone's celebrating too~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-rio-01|text: Ah! Today's Rio-chan's birthday~! The fans are going crazy online~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-rui-01|text: Yu-chan and Sumire-chan were super excited! It's Rui-chan's birthday after all~.
data.home-action-mei-birthday-ski-01|text: It's Saki-chan's birthday! Maybe Mei'll give her a shoulder rub to say thanks for everything~?
data.home-action-mei-birthday-skr-01|text: It's Sakura-chan's birthday!! Let's celebrate! Already did? Well, we can do it again~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-smr-01|text: It's Sumire-chan's birthday~! Alright, Mei's challenging her to a kendama battle~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-suz-01|text: Today's Suzu-nyan's birthday! How wonderful, how wonderful!! Mei's celebrating to the max~!
data.home-action-mei-birthday-szk-01|text: It's Shizuku-chan's birthday~! Let's celebrate, celebrate~! How about tossing her in the air~?
data.home-action-mei-birthday-yu-01|text: Today's Yu-chan's birthday~! Mei'll go congratulate her later~!
data.home-action-mei-christ-01|text: Chicken, cake, presents— Mei's so excited~.
data.home-action-mei-halw-01|text: Mei gets candy but also does tricks~!
data.home-action-mei-love-01-true-01|text: Let's wear yukata and go to the fireworks together! Playing Moshikoi made Mei wanna go~.
data.home-action-mei-love-01-true-02|text: Oh no, oh no! Saki-chan got mad and said Mei's Moshikoi is too stimulating~.
data.home-action-mei-love-01-true-03|text: There are so many kinds of 'like.' Mei loves {user}-san too, but what kind of like is this?
data.home-action-mei-newy-01|text: Happy New Year~! Hey, can Mei get otoshidama?
data.home-action-mei-newyeve-01|text: A year goes by so fast~. Ah! Mei hasn't done the big cleaning!
data.home-action-mei-trust-01-01|text: Mei can't memorize the lyrics! Unless Mei moves around, they just won't stick~.
data.home-action-mei-trust-01-02|text: Wanna go back to the Hoshimi dorm after a while? There are so many memories, Mei gets nostalgic sometimes~.
data.home-action-mei-trust-01-03|text: Manager! Thanks for everything! Yeah yeah, you gotta say these things properly~.
data.home-action-mei-trust-02-01|text: I wonder if there's work with kitties~? Sounds fun, right? Mei wants to~ It'd be great~.
data.home-action-mei-trust-02-02|text: Come to think of it, could Mei's grandma and mom see Mana-chan too~? Mei's curious~.
data.home-action-mei-trust-02-03|text: Ah, perfect timing! There's a kitty meeting tonight— wanna come along~?
data.home-action-mei-trust-03-01|text: Mei has a mole in a weird spot— is that okay? Yeah, right! Thanks!
data.home-action-mei-trust-03-02|text: You went to eat with Sakura-chan the other day, right~! Mei wants to go too~! Mei wants fish~.
data.home-action-mei-trust-03-03|text: Ah, going to the convenience store? Then Mei's coming too! It's a secret date, right? Nyahaha.
data.home-action-mei-trust-04-01|text: Your chest looks a bit tighter again... Hey, don't stare~! Mei's embarrassed too~!
data.home-action-mei-trust-04-02|text: Mei saw it on TV, but what's kissing like? If you know, can you tell Mei?
data.home-action-mei-trust-04-03|text: Being with {user}-san is always so much fun! Please stay with Mei from now on too!
data.home-action-mhk-05-casl-04-01|text: I should have taken a photo of your clueless sleeping face. Could have used it for something later.
data.home-action-mhk-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Touring historical sites every once in a while is nice. Vienna interests me personally.
data.home-action-mhk-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: I brought Greek souvenirs for Kotono and the others. For fran and kana? Don't be absurd.
data.home-action-mhk-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: You say my casual clothes are stylish? Why thank you. I always choose outfits that are camera-ready.
data.home-action-mhk-05-chna-00-01|text: Come to think of it, kana was in a movie wearing a similar costume. Getting dropped in holes—it was a masterpiece.
data.home-action-mhk-05-chna-00-cos-01|text: Perhaps Taiwan will host a live battle like Japan's someday. I look forward to it.
data.home-action-mhk-05-chna-00-cos-02|text: I hear Taiwan has many healthy food options too. I'd like to visit with a calm mind someday.
data.home-action-mhk-05-chna-00-cos-03|text: I am not bragging, but I do have confidence that this sort of costume suits me.
data.home-action-mhk-05-circ-00-01|text: Next time you collapse, I will call an ambulance. I have no desire to endure that nerve-shredding driving again.
data.home-action-mhk-05-circ-00-cos-01|text: A commercial with an autonomous driving car would be nice next. I could just sit there and filming would be over.
data.home-action-mhk-05-circ-00-cos-02|text: Ever since appearing in a sports car commercial, I have started watching motorsport programs.
data.home-action-mhk-05-circ-00-cos-03|text: Mei suddenly told me 'you can't be here.' I have no idea what she meant.
data.home-action-mhk-05-fest-02-01|text: Not bad for something fran made. Then again, one must separate the work from the artist.
data.home-action-mhk-05-fest-02-cos-01|text: kana is stress-shopping herself silly. Please leave her alone for a while.
data.home-action-mhk-05-fest-02-cos-02|text: fran was dozing off the other day so I mimicked a ghost's voice by her ear. She shot right up.
data.home-action-mhk-05-fest-02-cos-03|text: Taiwan was truly wonderful. I want to go back someday. I wish I could have gone with a friend, though.
data.home-action-mhk-05-idol-00-01|text: I already have the Hoshimi kids' weaknesses figured out. Want to test me? Silly question. We are rivals.
data.home-action-mhk-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: Isn't it strange… When I lose a contact lens, I always lose both at the same time.
data.home-action-mhk-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: I make sure to keep up with daily training so this costume suits me properly.
data.home-action-mhk-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: A new costume? In due time… This one fits the concept well enough, so I rather like it.
data.home-action-mhk-05-idol-03-01|text: I drifted all the way to Hoshimi Production… If this is fate, it is rather ironic.
data.home-action-mhk-05-idol-03-cos-01|text: How is the new song being received? Great? …Yes, naturally. Next, I will aim even higher.
data.home-action-mhk-05-idol-03-cos-02|text: fran was desperately trying to fish a coin out of a floor crack. Still in this costume, mind you.
data.home-action-mhk-05-idol-03-cos-03|text: Please let me clean the costume storage room next time. That way of storing things will damage the fabric.
data.home-action-mhk-05-mizg-01-01|text: I applied sunscreen properly but I still ended up a little red.
data.home-action-mhk-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: It is not that I cannot swim. I just do not want others seeing me swim.
data.home-action-mhk-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: I found a swimsuit from when I went to the beach with a friend years ago, buried in the closet. …I will keep this safely stored.
data.home-action-mhk-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: I tripped during a live broadcast and am truly relieved I did not drop my contacts on the beach.
data.home-action-mhk-05-newy-00-01|text: If we are wearing kimono-style costumes, we should have styled our hair in traditional Japanese form.
data.home-action-mhk-05-newy-00-cos-01|text: The biggest drawback of a large vehicle is fitting into parking lots. Every single time, the nerves…
data.home-action-mhk-05-newy-00-cos-02|text: New Year's? I spent it relaxing in the kotatsu watching TV. Well, familiar faces were on screen too.
data.home-action-mhk-05-newy-00-cos-03|text: I am thinking about what game to do on the official channel next… How about Russian roulette?
data.home-action-mhk-05-pajm-00-01|text: Today is my salon day. Getting two millimeters off my bangs and adjusting the back volume.
data.home-action-mhk-05-pajm-00-cos-01|text: I am not great with people seeing me let my guard down.
data.home-action-mhk-05-pajm-00-cos-02|text: This outfit is made from pleasant fabric, so it feels quite comfortable to wear.
data.home-action-mhk-05-pajm-00-cos-03|text: Perhaps occasionally relaxing in something this casual is not so bad.
data.home-action-mhk-05-poli-00-01|text: A hot spring every now and then is not bad. If you know any other good ones, do tell.
data.home-action-mhk-05-poli-00-cos-01|text: Given this sort of costume, perhaps I should just arrest whoever annoys me.
data.home-action-mhk-05-poli-00-cos-02|text: Now that the new costume is ready, we need to refine the performance… Yes, for a perfect stage.
data.home-action-mhk-05-poli-00-cos-03|text: The leg slit on this—is it alright? I do not think it will matter on stage, though…
data.home-action-mhk-05-wedd-00-01|text: You probably cannot get married either, so you might as well learn to cook a little.
data.home-action-mhk-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: Pure white lace with plenty of frills… so unlike Slixx that even I find it amusing.
data.home-action-mhk-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: If there were no work, there would have been no occasion to wear a real dress like this.
data.home-action-mhk-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: fran will not stop complaining about wanting to design a wedding dress, so humor her at least.
data.home-action-mhk-05-xmas-00-01|text: To think I would spend Christmas at Hoshimi Production. I truly never imagined it.
data.home-action-mhk-05-xmas-00-cos-01|text: I have not had Christmas cake in ages. This season does not put me in a festive mood.
data.home-action-mhk-05-xmas-00-cos-02|text: What do I want for Christmas? Disposable hand warmers. Essential for winter outdoor stages.
data.home-action-mhk-05-xmas-00-cos-03|text: Winter is the season for sweet rice wine, though in haiku 'amazake' is actually a summer word.
data.home-action-mhk-2nd-anniv-01|text: You go this far for a mere business partner. …No, I am talking about myself.
data.home-action-mhk-2nd-anniv-02|text: Haruko and I may be more alike than we seem. I am feeling uncharacteristically sentimental.
data.home-action-mhk-2nd-anniv-03|text: Even complex feelings that cannot be put into words can be expressed through performance. I believe so.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-01|text: Good work today. Today's schedule? I already have it all memorized, no need to tell me.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-02|text: Amazake has benefits like improved circulation and fat breakdown, great for beauty too… Ahem, said too much.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-03|text: Could you compile the VENUS Program results and notable live performances? Studying them is my daily habit.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-04|text: I do not need a bento for the next location. I bring my own to manage my nutrition.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-05|text: Today's meeting is for the live, right? fran and kana are late? Let us start without them.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-06|text: I went swimming. Do I look like I am good? Actually, not really. They said I look like I am drowning again.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-07|text: Yesterday's schedule you gave me had errors. You need to be more careful, or I will have a problem.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-08|text: Everyone at Hoshimi Pro gets along well, do they not? It looks a bit fun… No, never mind.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-09|text: Those two are talented but impossible to handle… What, they were fighting again? Good grief, truly.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-10|text: Coming to Hoshimi Pro has made me reconfirm Slixx's challenges. I suppose I should have realized from the start.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-51|text: There are many minors at this agency. You should hold an alcohol awareness seminar sooner rather than later.
data.home-action-mhk-basic-52|text: Even at the gym I end up teaching others and cannot do my own training at all. Sigh…
data.home-action-mhk-basic-53|text: Haruko kept pestering me about what books I read. Well, I do read historical novels from time to time.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-ai-01|text: It seems to be Ai's birthday. Quite rare to see someone so excited about their own birthday.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-aoi-01|text: Apparently it is Aoi's birthday. That boy has not changed a bit from his usual. I wonder if he is alright.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-chs-01|text: It seems to be Chisa's birthday. Saki looked quite happy about it. Those sisters are always close.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-hrk-01|text: I heard it is Haruko's birthday. She seems to have many hobbies, so everyone will struggle with gifts.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-kan-01|text: Sorry that kana is making a fuss at the office because it is her birthday. I will scold her later.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-kkr-01|text: Kokoro just subtly hinted for a present. Fearless—that is what youth is, I suppose.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-kor-01|text: I have been working with fran for about two years, but this is the first time we properly celebrated.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-ktn-01|text: Today seems to be Kotono's birthday. Should I prepare something? As a Slixx group effort, right?
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-mei-01|text: I hear it is Mei's birthday. She was happily eating donuts just now.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-mhk-01|text: Hoshimi Pro really is close-knit. Having my birthday celebrated is new—my old agency never did that.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-mna-01|text: It seems to be Mana Nagase's birthday. Well, there is nothing I can particularly say about it…
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-ngs-01|text: It seems to be Nagisa's birthday. Everyone celebrating together— very Hoshimi Pro of them.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-rei-01|text: It seems to be Rei's birthday. That girl was working a part-time job while performing. I do not dislike that.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-rio-01|text: It is Rei's birthday, so there was tension in LizNoir. Is she really that frightening?
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-rui-01|text: It seems to be Rui's birthday. I passed along a word in the hall and she looked happy. Perhaps I should have given a gift.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-ski-01|text: It is Saki's birthday, so her imouto Chisa looked pleased. Not that it has anything to do with me.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-skr-01|text: It seems to be Sakura's birthday. It would be strange to prepare something… I will pass.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-smr-01|text: I hear it is Sumire's birthday. The three of Triel get along so well, they must be throwing a party.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-suz-01|text: It seems to be Suzu's birthday. She was begging for presents but did not come to me about it.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-szk-01|text: It is Shizuku's birthday, so Hashimoto- san asked me for old ⅢX merch. Apparently she is quite the otaku.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-user-01|text: Happy birthday. I figured I should at least say it.
data.home-action-mhk-birthday-yu-01|text: It seems to be Yu's birthday. Sumire was at the studio carrying bags, so I asked her about it.
data.home-action-mhk-christ-01|text: The grand prix was around this time too. Idols always seem to be working on Christmas.
data.home-action-mhk-halw-01|text: The office was noisy this morning and I realized it is Halloween… Are you not going to dress up?
data.home-action-mhk-newy-01|text: Kotatsu, drinks, variety shows. That is the essence of New Year's. You think that is surprisingly normal?
data.home-action-mhk-newyeve-01|text: An idol cannot rest even on New Year's Eve. Do not mind me. I just composed a haiku.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-01-01|text: My gaze looks scary? I lost my contacts. I have to squint to see… Apologies.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-01-02|text: I used to get approached by TV people too. But lately, perhaps because I look desperate, it has decreased.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-01-03|text: I am beginning to understand, just a little, why you were able to lead Mana Nagase and so many popular idols.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-02-01|text: This place is surprisingly well- equipped for its size. All it needs is a sauna. Please arrange that.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-02-02|text: Personal friends? I do not see many of them. Rather, I have few… Please do not ask awkward questions.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-02-03|text: You do not need to accompany us for our work. Well, if you insist on coming, I will not stop you.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-03-01|text: Oh, Kotono. Good— Ah, wrong person? I dropped my contacts and her hair color is similar, so I…
data.home-action-mhk-trust-03-02|text: Are you angry? Yes, I am in a bad mood today. No point hiding it from you at this point. Excuse me.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-03-03|text: You would not know about the group I was in either… If you are interested, I can lend you some footage.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-04-01|text: Sigh… fran and kana are in foul moods today… I feel like going somewhere far. Shall we get a meal?
data.home-action-mhk-trust-04-02|text: During lessons I feel like someone is peeking at me, but when I look there is no one there. Probably a Hoshimi kid.
data.home-action-mhk-trust-04-03|text: Please correct Kotono's fingertip angle by two centimeters. In the VENUS Program, they notice that level of detail.
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-00-cos-01|text: When I put on this outfit, it flips a switch inside me. Like my uniform, I guess?
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-00-cos-02|text: It's a wonderful outfit, right? I really love it too. I hope you'll come to love it!
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-00-cos-03|text: The arm parts and the skirt seem to use amazing techniques. I don't really understand the details though.
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-01-cos-01|text: Such a cute outfit, right! It's packed with retro-future inspired motifs.
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-01-cos-02|text: The speakers are part of the outfit too! Let's deliver the best songs together!
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-01-cos-03|text: This year's Magical Mirai has really lovely costumes too. Thanks to everyone who listens!
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-05-cos-01|text: Matching swimwear-style outfits with Tsukisto everyone, I'm happy! I'll keep wearing them with care.
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-05-cos-02|text: If I did a free research project... I think I'd research the charm of Tsukisto!
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-05-cos-03|text: I can't forget that summer sea. The sound of the ripples was so soothing.
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-06-cos-01|text: The memories I made with everyone at Tsukisto, I'll treasure them always.
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-06-cos-02|text: Summer festivals have so many food stalls, don't they? Let's all go again someday.
data.home-action-mku-05-miku-06-cos-03|text: Singing outside with all your heart is so much fun! I want to sing with Nagisa-chan and everyone again~!
data.home-action-mku-basic-01|text: Good work! Are you busy again today? Let's do our best together!
data.home-action-mku-basic-02|text: So many people let me sing. That truly makes me happy. That's why every day is so fun!
data.home-action-mku-basic-03|text: There are all kinds of people here. I've never talked to so many before, it's so much fun!
data.home-action-mku-basic-04|text: I heard there's someone who's really good at dancing. I wish they'd teach me!
data.home-action-mku-basic-05|text: The live is almost here! I'll make it a wonderful one, so look forward to it! I hope Hoshimi Pro comes to watch too.
data.home-action-mna-05-idol-00-01|text: Idols and managers are fated to be together, you know! Just making sure you remember!
data.home-action-mna-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: It really does look great, right? Did you get lost staring at it? I love it too~
data.home-action-mna-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: This outfit fits so well I could wear it at home. Guess I would get scolded for that though~
data.home-action-mna-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: Being able to see my outfit this up close is totally {user}-kun's privilege. Be grateful!
data.home-action-mna-05-link-00-01|text: {user}-san, do you ever have your onee-chan appear in your dreams?
data.home-action-mna-05-link-00-cos-01|text: There's quite an age gap between me and my onee-chan, so I got hand-me-downs but not matching outfits.
data.home-action-mna-05-link-00-cos-02|text: Are my onee-chan's old costumes still in the office storage? I want to take a proper look someday.
data.home-action-mna-05-link-00-cos-03|text: My onee-chan loves fashion, which is great, but shopping with her takes forever. It was exhausting...
data.home-action-mna-basic-01|text: Good work! I'm feeling great today, body and mood! Let's do our best!
data.home-action-mna-basic-02|text: A single spice can totally change a curry's impression. So deep... just like idols!
data.home-action-mna-basic-03|text: Lately I really feel from the heart that I'm glad I chose the idol path. I'm so happy.
data.home-action-mna-basic-04|text: Singing is always fun, but when I sang lyrics I wrote myself, it was deeply moving.
data.home-action-mna-basic-05|text: The live is coming up~! It's going to be so fun! Can't wait to see everyone~!
data.home-action-mna-basic-06|text: {user}-kuun. I really wanna go for a drive~. Let's go somewhere on our next day off!
data.home-action-mna-basic-07|text: I used to go to karaoke a lot. Maybe that was my first step towards becoming an idol.
data.home-action-mna-basic-08|text: Going to festivals with my imouto is such a nice memory. I hope my lives become that for fans too.
data.home-action-mna-basic-09|text: Haruko-chan is amazing at singing and dancing, so I wonder why she can't win in live battles...
data.home-action-mna-basic-10|text: LizNoir's performances are incredible! So intense and passionate... I won't lose either!
data.home-action-mna-birthday-mna-01|text: It's my birthday~!! Did you remember? I'm really looking forward to presents~
data.home-action-mna-trust-01-01|text: I don't really have anything I'm bad at. Open mind to everything! That's the kind of idol I want to be.
data.home-action-mna-trust-01-02|text: I want to do a live on that hilltop stage again. The sea breeze and smell are so refreshing. Ahh, I wanna go!
data.home-action-mna-trust-01-03|text: Thank you for always supporting me! I'll pay it back many times over! Just wait a little longer, okay?
data.home-action-mna-trust-02-01|text: Haa~ I worked too hard at lessons. I wonder if someone kind will walk me home... I'm so frail~
data.home-action-mna-trust-02-02|text: When I entered entertainment, my parents started supporting me, but my imouto's still not so sure~
data.home-action-mna-trust-02-03|text: Eh? You noticed I changed my makeup? {user}-kun, you've grown a bit. Hehehe.
data.home-action-mna-trust-03-01|text: My diary? How about... no~! It's a secret~. {user}-kun, it's not nice to pry into a maiden~
data.home-action-mna-trust-03-02|text: I'm going shopping on my next day off. Wanna come? If you do, I'll pick out clothes for you!
data.home-action-mna-trust-03-03|text: If we weren't idol and manager, I wonder what we'd be like... Hehe.
data.home-action-mna-trust-04-01|text: I had some really delicious sweets in Tokyo the other day. My imouto turned me down, so I'll take you instead.
data.home-action-mna-trust-04-02|text: {user}-kun, you've become so much more reliable than when you first started managing! I'm counting on you!
data.home-action-mna-trust-04-03|text: Right now I'm reading a manga about forbidden love~. It's great. ...Want to borrow it if you're interested?
data.home-action-ngs-05-akma-00-01|text: {user}-san's hand was so warm. Let me practice with you again secretly.
data.home-action-ngs-05-akma-00-cos-01|text: If I could become a real little devil, I could see {user}-san's blushing face lots~!
data.home-action-ngs-05-akma-00-cos-02|text: When we all wore the horn headbands, Kotono-chan got embarrassed and it was so cute!
data.home-action-ngs-05-akma-00-cos-03|text: {user}-san! Let's do a fake date again! If it's fake, we can do it as many times as we want~
data.home-action-ngs-05-casl-02-01|text: I wrote too many lines for the sleepover date scene. This is what "the pen runs away" means.
data.home-action-ngs-05-casl-02-cos-01|text: Marrying a childhood friend is rare in real life, but it's so lovely.
data.home-action-ngs-05-casl-02-cos-02|text: Because we worked together, Rei-chan and I feel even more like comrades now.
data.home-action-ngs-05-casl-02-cos-03|text: At the dorm, Rio-san was playing my game with a serious face... What was she feeling?
data.home-action-ngs-05-casl-04-01|text: Do you remember how to pick peaches? If you forgot, I'll teach you step by step~
data.home-action-ngs-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Yamanashi had such a relaxing atmosphere. It was wonderful. I'd love to live there~.
data.home-action-ngs-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: Near the park we visited, there were lots of old burial mounds. Saki-chan talked passionately about them.
data.home-action-ngs-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: When I told Kotono-chan and the others about the trip, they were surprised I ate so much. Did I really?
data.home-action-ngs-05-fest-02-01|text: I'm glad I could state my goals clearly on the music show. Kotono-chan blushed and turned red, though~.
data.home-action-ngs-05-fest-02-cos-01|text: Kotono-chan on the special was so fresh yet so decisive where it counted... She was amazing~!
data.home-action-ngs-05-fest-02-cos-02|text: Kotono-chan's hand on stage was wet and cold, yet strong... It lit a fire in my heart.
data.home-action-ngs-05-fest-02-cos-03|text: During the live, I'm looking forward to mixing this new outfit with the old ones. Ehehe.
data.home-action-ngs-05-flow-00-01|text: You want to see a song centered on me? It's like a dream! I'm starting to get a little image!
data.home-action-ngs-05-flow-00-cos-01|text: The outfit is full of cosmos flowers. The flower language is a maiden's sincerity, so I'll sing from the heart!
data.home-action-ngs-05-flow-00-cos-02|text: I made a promise to go shopping with Kotono-chan for the limited sweets I got!
data.home-action-ngs-05-flow-00-cos-03|text: The setlist for the next live... I can't wait to see Kotono-chan's wonderful expressions!
data.home-action-ngs-05-frut-00-01|text: Plums and peaches are peaches... Whoever invented this tongue twister must love peaches.
data.home-action-ngs-05-frut-00-cos-01|text: The food truck lets us interact closely with customers, so it's really fun!
data.home-action-ngs-05-frut-00-cos-02|text: This time for sure! I have to come up with a special menu for Kotono-chan!
data.home-action-ngs-05-frut-00-cos-03|text: Thanks to the one-day manager experience, I feel a little more grown-up. I'd like to try it again!
data.home-action-ngs-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: The lace on the shoulders is so beautiful. Everyone has their own personality, and I love that.
data.home-action-ngs-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: When I wear this outfit, I remember our debut live. I'll never forget the view that day.
data.home-action-ngs-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: The waistline has a beautiful silhouette, so I have to stay slim... It'd be bad if I couldn't fit. Ehehe.
data.home-action-ngs-05-link-00-cos-b-01|text: Did you hear I was acting spoiled to Nagisa? Honestly...
data.home-action-ngs-05-link-00-cos-b-02|text: It's a secret from Nagisa, but lately she reminds me of my onee-chan somehow.
data.home-action-ngs-05-link-00-cos-b-03|text: I'm not alone anymore. I've realized anew that it's okay to rely on everyone more.
data.home-action-ngs-05-link-00_b-01|text: Is it okay if I lean on you too, {user}-san? N-nothing... Ahaha...
data.home-action-ngs-05-maid-01-01|text: Fufu, I can make lovey-dovey omurice too~! I'll make some for you next time!
data.home-action-ngs-05-maid-01-cos-01|text: Moe moe kyuun! Fufu, how was that? Did I add enough love?
data.home-action-ngs-05-maid-01-cos-02|text: I practiced using a maid cafe romance novel as reference... How is it? Am I cute?
data.home-action-ngs-05-maid-01-cos-03|text: Aah... Kotono-chuwan's maid outfit... It's really the best~ Burned into my eyes~
data.home-action-ngs-05-mizg-01-01|text: The summer MV turned out amazing! That's because Tsukisto has grown, isn't it!
data.home-action-ngs-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: This outfit reminds me of that MV shoot... Um, sorry for the trouble back then!
data.home-action-ngs-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: The first time we wore this, Kotono-chan was so embarrassed... It was adorable!
data.home-action-ngs-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: Sunny Peace's summer outfit was cute too, but I actually prefer this one~.
data.home-action-ngs-05-mizg-02-01|text: You haven't told anyone about the Hoshimi Pro diet operation, right? It's embarrassing, so never tell!
data.home-action-ngs-05-mizg-02-cos-01|text: In the morning, seeing a cutting board piled with peach peels gave me chills! Being too hungry is scary.
data.home-action-ngs-05-mizg-02-cos-02|text: It's still a bit embarrassing, but being able to wear this outfit is thanks to everyone working together.
data.home-action-ngs-05-mizg-02-cos-03|text: There were so many photos of Kotono-chan in this outfit on SNS! Treasure photos! I'm so jealous!
data.home-action-ngs-05-vlnt-00-01|text: The Valentine's chocolate section is so fun, but it's packed with people... It's a battlefield...
data.home-action-ngs-05-vlnt-00-cos-01|text: I may have tasted too much of the chocolate for Kotono-chan... Ugh. ...More training time.
data.home-action-ngs-05-vlnt-00-cos-02|text: This outfit designed by Mei-chan feels like Mei-chan's casual clothes. I feel like I became Mei-chan.
data.home-action-ngs-05-vlnt-00-cos-03|text: If Saki-chan showed up on a date in something this cute... I'd probably propose.
data.home-action-ngs-05-wedd-00-01|text: Someday I want to wear a lovely wedding dress like this and hear the bells of blessing~...
data.home-action-ngs-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: Have you read the original novel of 'Tact of Love'? I'll lend you all the volumes!
data.home-action-ngs-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: The carillon bell in the original has a legend: the two who ring it will be united forever.
data.home-action-ngs-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: I hope my character finds happiness in a side story~...
data.home-action-ngs-05-xmas-00-01|text: How long did you believe in Santa? I did... Until about fifth grade...
data.home-action-ngs-05-xmas-00-cos-01|text: Wearing this outfit makes me feel like a real Santa and my spirits rise.
data.home-action-ngs-05-xmas-00-cos-02|text: The date planning was fun. If there's another, please call me. I think I can be bolder next time!
data.home-action-ngs-05-xmas-00-cos-03|text: Since then, fans keep asking for love advice and it's troubling. I've never been on a date, you know?
data.home-action-ngs-05-yukt-00-01|text: That surprise... Whenever I remember it, I'm so happy my chest feels all fluttery.
data.home-action-ngs-05-yukt-00-cos-01|text: When I took everyone from Tsukisto to that cafe, the peach pancakes were a huge hit!
data.home-action-ngs-05-yukt-00-cos-02|text: "A list of Kotono-chan's cute habits nobody knows." I'll tell you secretly next time~.
data.home-action-ngs-05-yukt-00-cos-03|text: Every summer event brings new outfits and memories... Isn't that just wonderful?
data.home-action-ngs-2nd-anniv-01|text: Hmm, what should I do... What order is best... Eh? It's nothing~
data.home-action-ngs-2nd-anniv-02|text: Can I ask you something... What live moved you the most, Manager?
data.home-action-ngs-2nd-anniv-03|text: ...Prying isn't admirable. Like Satomi-san over there, with a pure heart, please!
data.home-action-ngs-basic-01|text: Good work. Thank you for yesterday! Let's do our best today too.
data.home-action-ngs-basic-02|text: I've been so busy lately that I fall asleep writing my diary at night. Ehehe.
data.home-action-ngs-basic-03|text: Listen. Today Kotono-chan went to the wrong practice room in a panic. It was so cute.
data.home-action-ngs-basic-04|text: The other day, I made sweets on a whim and it happened to be exactly what Kotono-chan wanted!
data.home-action-ngs-basic-05|text: The day before a live makes me fidgety. Maybe I'll try the tea Haruko-senpai taught me about.
data.home-action-ngs-basic-06|text: Hey, {user}-san! Can I ask you something? Do you have someone you like~?
data.home-action-ngs-basic-07|text: The peach jelly in the fridge... Did you buy it for me? Ehehe, thank you~
data.home-action-ngs-basic-08|text: Kotono-chan has been making more friends at school too. Becoming an idol really changed her.
data.home-action-ngs-basic-09|text: The cake shop Yu-chan told me about was so delicious. I have to be careful or I'll gain weight.
data.home-action-ngs-basic-10|text: Don't you feel like we're somehow disorganized yet somehow together?
data.home-action-ngs-basic-51|text: Nagi-nagi magical~ kurukuru-pon! I cast a spell to make you crave peaches! Fufu, let's go buy some!
data.home-action-ngs-basic-52|text: {user}-san, want to read my 'Daily Kotono-chan Observation Diary'? I'll lend it to you.
data.home-action-ngs-basic-53|text: Kotono-chan noticed I changed my fabric softener. She said it smells nice... I'll use this forever.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-ai-01|text: It's Ai-chan's birthday~. She works so hard, I want to tell her that!
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-aoi-01|text: Today is Aoi-chan's birthday! I need to go say happy birthday later!
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-chs-01|text: It's Chisa-chan's birthday! Everyone at Sunny Peace said they'd give her an amazing experience~.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-chs-02|text: Since it's Chisa-chan's birthday, I want to give her clothes. She'd style them so well~.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-hrk-01|text: Haruko-senpai, today is your birthday! I hope you can relax today~.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-kan-01|text: After celebrating kana-san's birthday, she invited me to take a photo together! Ehehe.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-kkr-01|text: Kokoro-chan, today is your birthday. Maybe she's secretly waiting for congratulations... Just kidding!
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-kor-01|text: It's Fran-san's birthday. I want to celebrate, but even asking the IIIX members, nobody knows where she is...
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-ktn-01|text: Today is Kotono-chan's birthday! I'm more excited than for my own!
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-mei-01|text: Mei-chan, today's her birthday, but she was at triple her usual tension! Ahaha.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-mhk-01|text: I said happy birthday to miho-senpai and she looked puzzled. Did she forget her own birthday?
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-mna-01|text: Today is Mana-san's birthday... I remember when everyone at Hoshimi Pro celebrated together.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-ngs-01|text: They're throwing a birthday party for me at the dorm~! I can't wait!
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-rei-01|text: I told Rei-chan happy birthday and she looked a bit embarrassed. That's her charm.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-rio-01|text: Today is Rio-senpai's birthday! Maybe sweets would make her happy?
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-rui-01|text: It's Rui-senpai's birthday~ Since it's TriAile, maybe they'll celebrate with a hot pot?
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-ski-01|text: It's Saki-senpai's birthday. I think polishing the dorm to a sparkle would be the best present.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-skr-01|text: It's Sakura-senpai's birthday! Kotono-chan and I went shopping for Uototto-san's new goods.
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-smr-01|text: TriAile all had the day off today. Is it for Sumire-chan's birthday celebration?
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-suz-01|text: It's Suzu-chan's birthday! She said "Call it a birth festival!" but...
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-szk-01|text: Today is Shizuku-chan's birthday! I congratulated her and she was really embarrassed! So cute~!
data.home-action-ngs-birthday-yu-01|text: It's Yu-chan's birthday, so I went to chat! We ended up talking forever... Ahaha.
data.home-action-ngs-christ-01|text: Please look forward to the Christmas party~
data.home-action-ngs-halw-01|text: I want to make lots of sweets for everyone to eat.
data.home-action-ngs-love-01-true-01|text: My If Love character was more pushy than I expected! I have to learn from her.
data.home-action-ngs-love-01-true-02|text: Should I wake you up every morning, {user}-san? Fufu, just kidding.
data.home-action-ngs-love-01-true-03|text: I want to write a novel too. Theme: a forbidden love between an idol and her manager! Kyaa~!
data.home-action-ngs-newyeve-01|text: What kind of year was it for you, {user}-san?
data.home-action-ngs-trust-01-01|text: I'm not good at dieting... I know I gain weight easily so I have to be careful, but...
data.home-action-ngs-trust-01-02|text: Wrapping myself in blankets and reading old diaries calms me. Sometimes I can't sleep though...
data.home-action-ngs-trust-01-03|text: Since coming to this office, you sometimes look more reliable than before. Thank you always.
data.home-action-ngs-trust-02-01|text: Working alone is nice, but I'd like to try working with just Kotono-chan too. Fufu.
data.home-action-ngs-trust-02-02|text: My parents love Kotono-chan too... Our families even had a BBQ together before.
data.home-action-ngs-trust-02-03|text: I baked cookies for everyone but made too many. Would you like one?
data.home-action-ngs-trust-03-01|text: Lately I've been writing little stories... It's embarrassing, but would you read one?
data.home-action-ngs-trust-03-02|text: Was it you, {user}-san, who brought the towel I left at the studio? Please just tell me next time!
data.home-action-ngs-trust-03-03|text: I have a few new pen candidates but I can't decide... Could you come shopping with me?
data.home-action-ngs-trust-04-01|text: Um! Could you stay after lesson today? Ah, don't expect anything weird, okay?
data.home-action-ngs-trust-04-02|text: Would I... not do? It's a line from a drama I'm hooked on. Did I surprise you?
data.home-action-ngs-trust-04-03|text: I'm thinking of growing my hair a little... {user}-san, which do you prefer?
data.home-action-rei-05-casl-02-01|text: Dating sims are surprisingly interesting. If only the heroine weren't me, I could enjoy it more freely...
data.home-action-rei-05-casl-02-cos-01|text: Please don't show anyone my survey on views about love. It's embarrassing.
data.home-action-rei-05-casl-02-cos-02|text: Hearing my own voice come from the game feels quite strange.
data.home-action-rei-05-casl-02-cos-03|text: Do wonderful encounters really happen at part-time jobs? It didn't seem likely at Takemiya...
data.home-action-rei-05-casl-04-01|text: Riding the Ferris wheel at night and watching fireworks together— it's an unforgettable memory.
data.home-action-rei-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Ferris wheels move so slowly, yet why do they make your heart race so much?
data.home-action-rei-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: We held the meeting in a hotel conference room. It was so lavish I was nervous.
data.home-action-rei-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: An idol who makes adults and children smile alike—a theme park of an idol. That fits Sunny Peace.
data.home-action-rei-05-chia-00-01|text: Cheering feels wonderful. As a member of Sunny Peace, I'll cheer for our fans with everything.
data.home-action-rei-05-chia-00-cos-01|text: Our first national tour... With everyone in Sunny Peace, every day was fun and flew by.
data.home-action-rei-05-chia-00-cos-02|text: Nagisa gave me a stack of romance novels as reference for dating advice. Will this really help?
data.home-action-rei-05-chia-00-cos-03|text: I feel a connection between supermarket hawking and being an idol. The key is appeal and a smile!
data.home-action-rei-05-fest-00-01|text: Before becoming an idol, I used to dance outside to save on studio fees.
data.home-action-rei-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: The dance battle was inspiring. I want to keep challenging new things going forward.
data.home-action-rei-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: I like idol-style dance. But I'm still not used to being called cute...
data.home-action-rei-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: I learned at Hoshimi Pro that dance has something more important than just technique.
data.home-action-rei-05-fest-01-01|text: I'd like to do call-outs for sales at Takemiya again. The supermarket would panic? I see.
data.home-action-rei-05-fest-01-cos-01|text: Look at this skirt. It's like a real wave, isn't it? It's so refreshing, I love it.
data.home-action-rei-05-fest-01-cos-02|text: Oh, did I bump into you? This outfit has a big ribbon on the back, so I need to be careful...
data.home-action-rei-05-fest-01-cos-03|text: ...Troubled about something? This time, rely on me from the start, okay?
data.home-action-rei-05-hruh-00-01|text: Wearing this uniform makes me feel like searching for aliens, time travelers, or espers.
data.home-action-rei-05-hruh-00-cos-01|text: Aliens abduct cows, don't they? I read that in a magazine the other day.
data.home-action-rei-05-hruh-00-cos-02|text: I don't want to know the future. The future is uncertain, and that's what makes it full of possibility.
data.home-action-rei-05-hruh-00-cos-03|text: If you could have a superpower, what would it be? I'd choose... the ability to eat without gaining weight...
data.home-action-rei-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: At first I thought it was too cute, but now it feels very natural. I like it.
data.home-action-rei-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: Saying I'm the one who suits this outfit best... Is that too conceited?
data.home-action-rei-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: The next live uses this outfit. Wearing it makes me feel like I can win. It's strange.
data.home-action-rei-05-mizg-02-01|text: I'm grateful. ...That's what I said. Don't make me say the whole thing. It's about the summer fest.
data.home-action-rei-05-mizg-02-cos-01|text: I've gotten somewhat used to it, but please don't stare for more than a second when I'm in this outfit.
data.home-action-rei-05-mizg-02-cos-02|text: {user}-san, please stop looking at me with those eyes! I'll call the police for real!
data.home-action-rei-05-mizg-02-cos-03|text: You wear a suit even to summer lives, don't you, {user}-san? You should buy a swimsuit.
data.home-action-rei-05-mizg-03-01|text: I think you should train more, {user}-san. You won't survive on a deserted island like that.
data.home-action-rei-05-mizg-03-cos-01|text: The breathtaking nature we saw on location... It was so beautiful I wished everyone could see it in person.
data.home-action-rei-05-mizg-03-cos-02|text: I watched the horror movie Chisa recommended... It was a grueling two hours—worse than island survival.
data.home-action-rei-05-mizg-03-cos-03|text: Camp cooking is mysterious. It's nothing fancy, but eating together makes it taste incredible.
data.home-action-rei-05-newy-00-01|text: This year's goal: thorough self-management! And one more dont mess up app settings!
data.home-action-rei-05-newy-00-cos-01|text: Since it's a kimono-style outfit, I'd like to express 'wa' in the dance as well.
data.home-action-rei-05-newy-00-cos-02|text: To think being able to wear this outfit smoothly would bring such happiness! I won't make that mistake again!
data.home-action-rei-05-newy-00-cos-03|text: Otokku! Ima da ke otokku! Burning off calories from all the snacks I ate at yesterday's recording!
data.home-action-rei-05-onep-00-01|text: I want my dance to naturally bring smiles, like those night cherry blossoms.
data.home-action-rei-05-onep-00-cos-01|text: Why are you staring? There are no cherry petals on me today.
data.home-action-rei-05-onep-00-cos-02|text: The outfit design is lovely. It's called a fishtail, and it really shines during dance.
data.home-action-rei-05-onep-00-cos-03|text: Back when I worked at the supermarket, my smile probably wasn't natural. Sales might've been better.
data.home-action-rei-05-pair-00-01|text: I always do flexibility and stretching carefully. I don't want to get hurt and trouble everyone.
data.home-action-rei-05-pair-00-cos-01|text: Having companions who support each other is wonderful. Being part of Sunny Peace, I feel that daily.
data.home-action-rei-05-pair-00-cos-02|text: So Haruko-san's dream destination was ruins. Something felt like it might come out...
data.home-action-rei-05-pair-00-cos-03|text: I can't do it quite like Haruko-san, but I want to help everyone in my own way.
data.home-action-rei-05-rock-00-01|text: Thanks to that, some confidence has returned. If there's work that uses my dancing, please call me.
data.home-action-rei-05-rock-00-cos-01|text: I like this design. But with long waits, it gets a bit cold. Fufu.
data.home-action-rei-05-rock-00-cos-02|text: I borrowed a dance video Aoi recommended. But it's on VHS... The office doesn't have a deck, does it?
data.home-action-rei-05-rock-00-cos-03|text: It's quite revealing, so could you please not stare? I'll call the police.
data.home-action-rei-05-sail-00-01|text: Lately, Haruko-san and I have been growing flowers in the dorm garden. You can come see them sometime.
data.home-action-rei-05-sail-00-cos-01|text: Sunflowers really suit Sunny Peace. They were on my swimsuit-style outfit as an accessory too.
data.home-action-rei-05-sail-00-cos-02|text: Dressed in this lovely outfit that rivals the flowers, I'll bloom to my fullest.
data.home-action-rei-05-sail-00-cos-03|text: I gave Chisa the spiritual magazine I bought as a souvenir and she was happy. Though she looked puzzled.
data.home-action-rei-05-wdnc-00-01|text: Lying isn't good, but lying to protect yourself can't be helped... No, I'm talking about myself.
data.home-action-rei-05-wdnc-00-cos-01|text: I recently realized I'm surprisingly good at disguises. Nobody notices at all.
data.home-action-rei-05-wdnc-00-cos-02|text: I like frilly outfits, but this kind of danceable costume really suits me.
data.home-action-rei-05-wdnc-00-cos-03|text: Post-apocalyptic punk idol Makibishi-maru with Suzuki... Thinking back, that's a really strange name...
data.home-action-rei-05-wedd-00-01|text: This time it was a misunderstanding that caused a fuss, but having so many people celebrate a wedding is truly happy.
data.home-action-rei-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: The ones I want to walk through time with... Right now, it's everyone in Sunny Peace.
data.home-action-rei-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: How does it feel to wear a wedding dress? Let me see... I thought it was hard to dance in.
data.home-action-rei-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: During the wedding dress shoot, everyone congratulated me and I felt rather complicated...
data.home-action-rei-2nd-anniv-01|text: I'm heading to practice. What kind? Ah, er, just regular self-training with nothing special.
data.home-action-rei-2nd-anniv-02|text: Why are you fidgeting? Don't say nonsense! I'm not fidgeting at all!
data.home-action-rei-2nd-anniv-03|text: Can I borrow the studio key tonight? Don't ask questions. And don't come watch.
data.home-action-rei-basic-01|text: Good work. Please come watch today's practice. The new choreography is flawless.
data.home-action-rei-basic-02|text: Haruko-san says fruit is good for your skin, so we've been eating it together. I wonder if it works.
data.home-action-rei-basic-03|text: Dance is my strength at work and my hobby. Is that okay? Should I pick up other hobbies?
data.home-action-rei-basic-04|text: Running lets me empty my mind. Focusing purely on a goal suits my personality.
data.home-action-rei-basic-05|text: Please watch the next live battle with ease. I'm in good form and confident. I'll definitely win.
data.home-action-rei-basic-06|text: On the way home from school, Suzu from the middle school often chases me screaming. They say we're sisters...
data.home-action-rei-basic-07|text: Test results? Around 80 average, I think. Because I don't want makeup exams cutting into practice.
data.home-action-rei-basic-08|text: Watching Haruko-san makes me wonder if femininity is needed. Her level of thoughtfulness is just different.
data.home-action-rei-basic-09|text: Yesterday Rio-san, Aoi, and I trained together and I got worked over hard. It was motivating but I'm wrecked...
data.home-action-rei-basic-10|text: If we were a dance-loving group, we'd probably fight all the time. I'm glad I'm in Sunny Peace after all.
data.home-action-rei-basic-51|text: Haruko-san always makes extras of her lunch and brings portions for us too.
data.home-action-rei-basic-52|text: If Saki and I formed a unit, would it be called 'Kusaya Macaron'...?
data.home-action-rei-basic-53|text: Even with cards, doesn't it feel bad to lose? That's why I end up staying up late...
data.home-action-rei-birthday-ai-01|text: Today is Ai's birthday. I'll try inviting her to train together.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-aoi-01|text: It's Aoi's birthday. I saw him earlier and we talked about continuing to push each other.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-chs-01|text: Chisa's birthday plan... Was it a success? I want to improve the precision next time.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-chs-02|text: For Chisa's present, I prepared some scary stories. I hope I can tell them well.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-hrk-01|text: Today is Haruko-san's birthday. I want to thank her for always looking out for us.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-kan-01|text: Sakura and the others were noisy, and it turned out to be kana-san's birthday. Should I go too...
data.home-action-rei-birthday-kkr-01|text: It's Kokoro's birthday. As a gift, I'll give her a special training menu.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-kor-01|text: Today is Fran-san's birthday. IIIX doesn't seem to know each other's birthdays. How like them.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-ktn-01|text: Kotono's birthday... What should I get her? Actually, maybe I should ask someone first...
data.home-action-rei-birthday-mei-01|text: I congratulated Mei and she was happier than I imagined and hugged me...
data.home-action-rei-birthday-mhk-01|text: I gave miho-san a birthday present. I ran into her during self-training before and got advice.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-mna-01|text: Today is Mana-san's birthday. I feel an even stronger desire to stand at the top.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-ngs-01|text: It's Nagisa's birthday. I gave her a present earlier. I'm glad she was happy.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-rei-01|text: Being celebrated this much makes me think birthdays are nice.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-rio-01|text: By the way, today is Rio-san's birthday. She gives me dance training, so I should celebrate.
