data.home-action-rei-birthday-rui-01|text: It's Rui's birthday, so I went to congratulate her. We ended up dancing together a bit.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-ski-01|text: Today is Saki's birthday. I wish she could at least relax on her birthday.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-skr-01|text: Sakura was wonderfully surprised by the birthday celebration.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-smr-01|text: Since it's Sumire's birthday, the three from TriAile have been absent since morning.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-suz-01|text: Suzu, today is her birthday. It was even noisier than usual... Well, it's just for today.
data.home-action-rei-birthday-szk-01|text: It's Shizuku's birthday. She's a Sunny Peace comrade, so I'll give it my all to celebrate!
data.home-action-rei-birthday-yu-01|text: It's Yu's birthday. TriAile's three will probably be very excited. They have a strong bond.
data.home-action-rei-christ-01|text: Be careful not to eat too much cake!
data.home-action-rei-halw-01|text: Gotta exercise if I eat sweets!
data.home-action-rei-love-01-true-01|text: Please don't confuse the game me with the real me. That's a character named Rei Ichinose!
data.home-action-rei-love-01-true-02|text: If I ever get with someone I like, would we live together like in the game...?
data.home-action-rei-love-01-true-03|text: How was the romance with me? It's about the game! Eh? It was cute...? I-I see...
data.home-action-rei-newy-01|text: Please continue to treat me well this year.
data.home-action-rei-newyeve-01|text: It was a great year spending time with {user}-san and everyone.
data.home-action-rei-trust-01-01|text: Is my way of speaking still too harsh? Shizuku and Chisa sometimes make subtle faces and it bothers me...
data.home-action-rei-trust-01-02|text: The dorm feels more comfortable than before. At first I really didn't like it. This stays between us.
data.home-action-rei-trust-01-03|text: If I hadn't become an idol, I wonder if I'd have just danced obsessively. I'm... grateful, even now.
data.home-action-rei-trust-02-01|text: It's not dissatisfaction, but I'd be happier with work that uses my dancing rather than variety shows...
data.home-action-rei-trust-02-02|text: Should I go home sometimes... Everyone goes home occasionally, so I've been thinking about it.
data.home-action-rei-trust-02-03|text: Want to go running together? You haven't come to watch practice lately. Call me if you have time.
data.home-action-rei-trust-03-01|text: It's a secret. Even after coming to Tokyo, the part-timers from Takemiya sometimes invite me for meals...
data.home-action-rei-trust-03-02|text: Usually you seem unreliable, but watching you work, I can think you're impressive. Just a little.
data.home-action-rei-trust-03-03|text: Sumire said it too, but actually, sometimes I see my brother in you, {user}-san.
data.home-action-rei-trust-04-01|text: I think this is rare for me, and I'd appreciate it if you didn't pull away. Shall we eat macarons?
data.home-action-rei-trust-04-02|text: Please take me for a meal... No, forget it. I was just copying Mei and Nagisa.
data.home-action-rei-trust-04-03|text: I'm glad you called out to me. I actually like these kinds of exchanges.
data.home-action-rik-05-sush-00-01|text: If we get to do another live, I need to work hard so I can show them how much I've grown.
data.home-action-rik-05-sush-00-cos-01|text: Every time I come to Tokyo there are so many new volumes of "that" series... I need to gather more info.
data.home-action-rik-05-sush-00-cos-02|text: Shizuku-chan's action was unexpected... Ah, what should I do, my face gets hot just remembering!
data.home-action-rik-05-sush-00-cos-03|text: Having them sing our own songs is truly such a wonderful thing.
data.home-action-rik-basic-01|text: With everyone's feelings as one, I'll do my best again today!
data.home-action-rik-basic-02|text: Every song from everyone at Hoshimi Production is lovely.
data.home-action-rik-basic-03|text: I suppose everyone from SunaPi ran along the beach too.
data.home-action-rik-basic-04|text: Haruko... san... Hmm... Calling her -chan takes courage...
data.home-action-rik-basic-05|text: I want to go out with Shizuku-chan again.
data.home-action-rik-basic-06|text: If we get to do another live, I need to work hard so I can show them how much I've grown.
data.home-action-rik-sush-01-cos-01|text: It's so sparkling and the scenery outside is beautiful.
data.home-action-rik-sush-01-cos-02|text: A truly wonderful Christmas! Today might become unforgettable!
data.home-action-rik-sush-01-cos-03|text: Everyone's Christmas costumes look really good on them.
data.home-action-rik-sush-02-03-cos-02|text: I always look forward to the outfits You-chan makes.
data.home-action-rio-05-casl-02-01|text: I'm looking forward to the next ranking. My, are you feeling like marrying me too?
data.home-action-rio-05-casl-02-cos-01|text: Don't doze off during work. Keep overtime reasonable and go home early to rest sometimes.
data.home-action-rio-05-casl-02-cos-02|text: For some reason, people often say I suit mature romance. Despite having no such experience...
data.home-action-rio-05-casl-02-cos-03|text: What do people expect from me if they want to marry me? Could it be... they want to be scolded?
data.home-action-rio-05-casl-04-01|text: We've known each other a long time, but you haven't changed much. ...In a good way, of course.
data.home-action-rio-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: I quite like this outfit because it's easy to move in. Tell me what you think too.
data.home-action-rio-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: H-Hey... Don't stare so much at my stomach area.
data.home-action-rio-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: You say such suggestive things sometimes. How many girls have you misled?
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-00-01|text: That cocktail earlier was wonderful. The taste and presentation were both professional. Truly inspiring.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: Perhaps I should make my dance movements a bit larger. Factoring in the skirt's design makes the costume really shine.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: Aoi wore Kokoro's costume by mistake. Obviously the size was wrong, but it was so short I couldn't help laughing.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: Lately, Ai has started speaking up in meetings. I suppose she's getting used to LizNoir.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-01-01|text: A middle school friend told me she watched the show. Being called the Star of Okayama was embarrassing.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-01-cos-01|text: I can finally stand on the stage I always dreamed of. It took a long time, but I'm happy.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-01-cos-02|text: Fans who watched the documentary have been visiting our family's cafe. Mother is delighted.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-01-cos-03|text: Don't try filming while walking again, alright? Even if the footage is good, I'll be worried sick.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-03-01|text: Kotono found her own path too. We both struggled a lot, but I'm proud to stand beside her.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-03-cos-01|text: Hey, what was I called... Final boss? Was it? Hmph. So that's how you see me.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-03-cos-02|text: Neither Aoi nor I wanted to show weakness to our juniors. But if they see us as equals, we must trust them.
data.home-action-rio-05-fest-03-cos-03|text: Even seeing the current me, she'd pretend not to be interested. But that's exactly why we're eternal rivals.
data.home-action-rio-05-halw-00-01|text: Whether cosplay or anything else, I'll turn it into fuel for LizNoir's future. Keep sending work.
data.home-action-rio-05-halw-00-cos-01|text: Aoi and Ai said they wanted to try this costume. It's quite popular, so shall I make three more?
data.home-action-rio-05-halw-00-cos-02|text: What are you looking at? Do you want me, the Underworld Nurse, to cure your very soul?
data.home-action-rio-05-halw-00-cos-03|text: My, that expression means the charm of Kanzaki Rio from LizNoir has gotten through?
data.home-action-rio-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: This outfit looks simple, but the jewels at the chest and the gloves are quite delicate.
data.home-action-rio-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: As expected, wearing the costume sharpens my resolve. When's the next live?
data.home-action-rio-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: I don't usually wear earrings like these, but I quite like them. ...Do they suit me?
data.home-action-rio-05-kait-00-01|text: The movie we watched together was just the beginning. The viewing sessions continue until you grasp Katie's appeal.
data.home-action-rio-05-kait-00-cos-01|text: This costume was acknowledged by the one I admire. It will surely become my battle outfit.
data.home-action-rio-05-kait-00-cos-02|text: Today, to celebrate a successful job, I'll eat pancakes then go to my favorite bar. Care to join?
data.home-action-rio-05-kait-00-cos-03|text: It was my first movie promotion, but this is just a milestone. I look forward to more exciting work.
data.home-action-rio-05-kiok-00-01|text: I wonder if I can sing with Kotono again? My, yes. I like that. Her strong spirit, for one.
data.home-action-rio-05-kiok-00-cos-01|text: Singing that song in this costume brings back many memories. Of course, Mana's memories too.
data.home-action-rio-05-kiok-00-cos-02|text: I'm a little envious of a relationship like that child and yours. ...Just a little, mind you.
data.home-action-rio-05-kiok-00-cos-03|text: It was my first time really seeing Hoshimi City... It wasn't bad. Could you take me again someday?
data.home-action-rio-05-mizg-02-01|text: I've always wanted to go higher and come this far, but sometimes I wonder how far is enough.
data.home-action-rio-05-mizg-02-cos-01|text: I've organized the shoot materials. Learn to delegate to others a little.
data.home-action-rio-05-mizg-02-cos-02|text: ...Being at the office in this outfit is a bit embarrassing.
data.home-action-rio-05-mizg-02-cos-03|text: Entertainment agency work really is so diverse. I need to be more grateful to all of you.
data.home-action-rio-05-newy-00-01|text: Aren't you overworking? If you don't rest sometimes, it'll be less efficient in the end.
data.home-action-rio-05-newy-00-cos-01|text: This outfit has a nice Japanese feel. The design was unexpected, but... yes, I like it.
data.home-action-rio-05-newy-00-cos-02|text: Kokoro loved this costume and tried to go to the shrine in it. Of course I stopped her.
data.home-action-rio-05-newy-00-cos-03|text: Last time I couldn't show you around my hometown... Next time, I'm sure I can.
data.home-action-rio-05-pajm-00-01|text: We've known each other a long time. More like comrades in arms than manager, I'd say.
data.home-action-rio-05-pajm-00-cos-01|text: These pajamas aren't bad. What? My usual pajamas? ...I'd never tell you.
data.home-action-rio-05-pajm-00-cos-02|text: ...Hey. What are you looking at? Don't stare so intently. ...It's embarrassing.
data.home-action-rio-05-pajm-00-cos-03|text: Achoo! This outfit—don't you think there's a bit too much skin?
data.home-action-rio-05-past-00-01|text: If I had met you at BanPro instead of Saegi-san... No, never mind.
data.home-action-rio-05-past-00-cos-01|text: It's been a while since I wore this. ...Hey, it doesn't look odd on me now, does it?
data.home-action-rio-05-past-00-cos-02|text: The fights from debut days? That's old news. I-I have nothing to hide!
data.home-action-rio-05-past-00-cos-03|text: Sometimes I think your sense is a little strange. ...Not that I dislike it.
data.home-action-rio-05-trbl-00-01|text: Generating enough energy to cross time and space—the feelings of fans who support their oshi are truly remarkable.
data.home-action-rio-05-trbl-00-cos-01|text: Christmas is approaching and it's getting cold... Ah, you thought it was cold because of this outfit?
data.home-action-rio-05-trbl-00-cos-02|text: Lala helped with cooking, but for some reason the finished dish had a poisonous color to it.
data.home-action-rio-05-trbl-00-cos-03|text: Kokoro and Momo hit it off and planned a prank together. I've learned 'do not mix.'
data.home-action-rio-05-wedd-00-01|text: Want to eat my cooking again? If you cook for me too, I might consider it.
data.home-action-rio-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: Being at the office dressed like this is strange, even for me. I hope no one sees me...
data.home-action-rio-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: A wedding dress is every girl's dream... but I'm also intrigued by a shiromuku.
data.home-action-rio-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: A job wearing a wedding dress? I'll pass. Because next time I want to wear one for myself.
data.home-action-rio-2nd-anniv-01|text: Manager, got a moment? Could you tell me your favorite LizNoir song?
data.home-action-rio-2nd-anniv-02|text: Yawn... Sorry, I've been sleep- deprieved. But it won't affect work, so don't worry.
data.home-action-rio-2nd-anniv-03|text: If you have something to consult, just say so. Why the sudden question? Did Kokoro and the others slip up?
data.home-action-rio-basic-01|text: Good work. Today was... a live battle, wasn't it? Are you coming with?
data.home-action-rio-basic-02|text: I try making pancakes myself, but eating them at a shop is still the best.
data.home-action-rio-basic-03|text: Lately I've been teaching running form to Tsukisto and Sunny Peace kids too. My track experience still comes in handy.
data.home-action-rio-basic-04|text: Did I have studio all day? Then I need to make a bento. There should be leftovers from yesterday...
data.home-action-rio-basic-05|text: Since coming to this agency, live battles have become fun. They used to make me tense.
data.home-action-rio-basic-06|text: A pancake shop I'm curious about opened. It gets crowded, so could you give me a weekday off?
data.home-action-rio-basic-07|text: I still keep in touch with friends from middle school. They cheer for me when I go to Tokyo too.
data.home-action-rio-basic-08|text: I suggested SNS to Aoi, but she doesn't quite get how to use it. It's a bit worrying...
data.home-action-rio-basic-09|text: Rui? We're not on bad terms. Her nutritional balance talk is quite helpful, so I listen often.
data.home-action-rio-basic-10|text: It's wonderful, isn't it? Being with Kotono and Sakura shows me LizNoir gaining new sides.
data.home-action-rio-basic-51|text: I might not be suited for video posts. I shouldn't do things I'm not used to.
data.home-action-rio-basic-52|text: Aoi talked me into spending a fortune at the arcade. Don't tell Kokoro or Ai.
data.home-action-rio-basic-53|text: My, it seems my curry is quite delicious. If the chance comes, I'll make some for you.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-ai-01|text: Today is Ai's birthday. She said she wanted LizNoir goods, but would that be enough?
data.home-action-rio-birthday-aoi-01|text: Today is Aoi's birthday. It's not the type for a big celebration, so I'll congratulate him quietly later.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-chs-01|text: I heard it's Chisa's birthday. I want to say something, but... she's not afraid of me, is she?
data.home-action-rio-birthday-hrk-01|text: Haruko's birthday, isn't it? She's been surrounded by everyone all morning. Such personal charm.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-kan-01|text: It's kana-san's birthday. Kokoro has been on SNS since morning bothering her—I hope she's not tiring her out...
data.home-action-rio-birthday-kkr-01|text: I've prepared a simple party. It's Kokoro's birthday. She seems like she'll be happy.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-kor-01|text: Today is Fran-san's birthday. I wish she'd look happier at least when being congratulated.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-ktn-01|text: Come to think of it, today is Kotono's birthday. I should prepare something. Just a token, though.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-mei-01|text: Mei was running around at incredible speed... Is it because of her birthday? She seems normal.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-mhk-01|text: Today seems to be miho-san's birthday. She looked a little happy being congratulated.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-mna-01|text: Today is Mana's birthday. I'll bloom so brightly she can see it from anywhere.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-ngs-01|text: Nagisa, today's your birthday, right? I just saw you walking happily with Kotono.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-rei-01|text: Today is Rei's birthday. She was training as hard as always. Very like her.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-rio-01|text: I feel like I got a year's worth of sweets. Birthdays are something else. I'm grateful.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-rui-01|text: It's Rui's birthday. When I saw her, she was clutching a mountain of gummies. Everyone thinks alike.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-ski-01|text: Saki... it's her birthday. She always seems stressed, so I feel a bit of kinship...
data.home-action-rio-birthday-skr-01|text: Today is Sakura's birthday. She was so happy you could tell just by looking.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-smr-01|text: It's Sumire's birthday. She's responsible but still a child. We need to celebrate properly.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-suz-01|text: Suzu's having a birthday? She's rather like a harmless Kokoro, that child.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-szk-01|text: I hear it's Shizuku's birthday. Would she be happy if I gave her early LizNoir goods?
data.home-action-rio-birthday-user-01|text: My, happy birthday... for what it's worth.
data.home-action-rio-birthday-yu-01|text: Today was Yu's birthday. Shall we all from LizNoir go congratulate her?
data.home-action-rio-christ-01|text: Perhaps I should send a present to my family.
data.home-action-rio-halw-01|text: If I have time for pranks, I'll be practicing...
data.home-action-rio-love-01-true-01|text: Hey! I absolutely told you not to play Moshikoi at the office, didn't I!? What are you doing!
data.home-action-rio-love-01-true-02|text: If I were to marry, I'd choose someone who supported me all along. Ah, that's purely hypothetical!
data.home-action-rio-love-01-true-03|text: You're the only one who knows my views on love. If the chance arises, I'd like to hear yours too.
data.home-action-rio-newy-01|text: Another year has begun. I'll renew my resolve and do my best.
data.home-action-rio-newyeve-01|text: I need to check the year-end specials.
data.home-action-rio-transit-card-portal-top|: I wonder what we'll do today.
data.home-action-rio-trust-01-01|text: In the great outdoors is a bit... You know, there are bugs... Even small ones are no good for me...
data.home-action-rio-trust-01-02|text: I miss our family cafe... There's no place more relaxing than that.
data.home-action-rio-trust-01-03|text: With this many people, it must be difficult. Thank you always. Tell me if I can help.
data.home-action-rio-trust-02-01|text: We're having a LizNoir party tomorrow. Could you buy the ingredients? I'll reward you, of course.
data.home-action-rio-trust-02-02|text: My family home? Didn't I tell you? It's Okayama. The scenic town and nature make it lovely.
data.home-action-rio-trust-02-03|text: Being suddenly given a day off puts me in a bind. Since it's a rare chance, shall we go get pancakes?
data.home-action-rio-trust-03-01|text: Hey... Has anything changed about me? I've actually gained a kilo...
data.home-action-rio-trust-03-02|text: I made stuffed peppers today. There are leftovers, so if you'd like... would you eat them?
data.home-action-rio-trust-03-03|text: If I wore a school uniform... No, never mind. I'm sorry. Forget I said that.
data.home-action-rio-trust-04-01|text: What are you looking at? Bed head? H-Hey! You should tell me sooner!
data.home-action-rio-trust-04-02|text: Do I smell like sweat? Good. I haven't showered yet. I perspire easily...
data.home-action-rio-trust-04-03|text: C-Call me Rio-Rio! W-Why are you there...! Kokoro told me to try it!
data.home-action-rui-05-casl-04-01|text: If I go to Italy next time, I'd like to visit Rome and Milan too. Someday... please take me.
data.home-action-rui-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: The gondola in Venice was wonderful. You really do glide leisurely through the city's canals.
data.home-action-rui-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: Wearing these clothes reminds me of our trip through Italy. They've become very special to me.
data.home-action-rui-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: I found a gelato shop near the agency. Want to go together sometime?
data.home-action-rui-05-date-00-01|text: If I hit a wall again, please stay and practice with me.
data.home-action-rui-05-date-00-cos-01|text: Sumire told me my everyday walk has become cool too. That's the result of my special training!
data.home-action-rui-05-date-00-cos-02|text: {user}, what do you think of someone who dresses like this?
data.home-action-rui-05-date-00-cos-03|text: The streets of Yokohama were beautiful. I'd be happy if we could go again together someday.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-01-01|text: Becoming a great idol is the greatest way to repay everyone who has supported me.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-01-cos-01|text: I don't dislike solo work, but I feel most fulfilled when performing as the three of us in TRI-ALL.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-01-cos-02|text: I make mistakes too. That's why I practice daily so I have no regrets and can give my best.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-01-cos-03|text: les plumes' new MV seems to be getting good reviews. I'm glad. All the hard work paid off.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-03-01|text: To express my gratitude to Yu and Sumire... A handmade hot pot, I suppose?
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-03-cos-01|text: When we all wear matching costumes, the visual impact is tremendous. It broadens our staging possibilities.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-03-cos-02|text: I hear this costume is inspired by space and planets. It's perfect for Hoshimi Pro.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-03-cos-03|text: When I put on this costume, a feeling wells up to soar even higher.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-04-01|text: Even I have moments when I want to be selfish. I've just decided to stop holding back.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-04-cos-01|text: My poems... no, my songwriting notebook... I will never show it to anyone. It stays locked away. It's embarrassing.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-04-cos-02|text: Truly, this is a beautiful costume. New wings for us... With these, we can go anywhere.
data.home-action-rui-05-fest-04-cos-03|text: We're having another hot pot party. Would you like to join? Rather, please come. Hehe.
data.home-action-rui-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: This reminds me of the Bump Up days. We got through the Grand Prix in this, so it's unforgettable.
data.home-action-rui-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: It's no exaggeration to call this costume the formal attire of us TRI-ALL. It steels my resolve.
data.home-action-rui-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: It feels fresh every time I wear it. The design must be exceptional enough to never grow old.
data.home-action-rui-05-idol-04-01|text: If there are hot spring buns and hot spring eggs, surely there should be hot spring gummies too... What do you think?
data.home-action-rui-05-idol-04-cos-01|text: When I put on this costume, my resolve tightens more than usual. It's strange somehow.
data.home-action-rui-05-idol-04-cos-02|text: Thank you for the costume. Every time I receive something new, I feel like I've gained powerful wings.
data.home-action-rui-05-idol-04-cos-03|text: I can't forget the lingering feeling of that pleasant hot spring. It really was a wonderful day off.
data.home-action-rui-05-miku-00-01|text: The tension before a live feels good. When I was a rookie, I couldn't say the same, though.
data.home-action-rui-05-miku-00-cos-01|text: Wearing this costume reminds me of her. Someday I'd like to sing with her again.
data.home-action-rui-05-miku-00-cos-02|text: There's going to be a Miku live soon! Yu and Sumire and I are going to go watch!
data.home-action-rui-05-miku-00-cos-03|text: I wonder if Miku is singing somewhere again... It makes me want to see her.
data.home-action-rui-05-mizg-01-01|text: They let us take on jobs we've never experienced before... Hoshimi Pro is truly a wonderful agency.
data.home-action-rui-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: Honestly, I haven't gotten used to the revealing nature yet, but I think this costume's design is beautiful.
data.home-action-rui-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: From the manager's perspective, what are the good points of this costume? Ah! No staring!!
data.home-action-rui-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: Do girl fans think this kind of costume is cute too, I wonder?
data.home-action-rui-05-newy-00-01|text: 'If you don't give me fried tofu, I'll trick you, kon!' I'd love to appear in that CM again.
data.home-action-rui-05-newy-00-cos-01|text: Tying an obi seems harder than tying a yukata. I need to learn to dress myself.
data.home-action-rui-05-newy-00-cos-02|text: Walking through town, a little child called me 'the udon and soba onee-chan.' It warmed my heart a little.
data.home-action-rui-05-newy-00-cos-03|text: I've grown fond of these fox ears. I find myself wishing I could move them freely... just a little.
data.home-action-rui-05-sucu-00-01|text: Spread your devil wings and fly to the demon realm -- 'Sweet Rouge' ...It surprisingly fits.
data.home-action-rui-05-sucu-00-cos-01|text: Draped in this costume chosen by our fans, I feel even more resolute than usual.
data.home-action-rui-05-sucu-00-cos-02|text: If I had horns like these, I'd probably snag them on trains and buses. ...Ah, maybe that's why they fly.
data.home-action-rui-05-sucu-00-cos-03|text: I often wear white-based costumes, so a black one that looks cool feels refreshing on its own.
data.home-action-rui-05-trbl-01-01|text: I explored a delicious taiyaki shop with Yami. Would you like to go next time?
data.home-action-rui-05-trbl-01-cos-01|text: These clothes are easier to move in than they look, lightweight, yet durable... What fabric are they?
data.home-action-rui-05-trbl-01-cos-02|text: Hm... mm... No, wearing the same clothes as Yami won't change my hair.
data.home-action-rui-05-trbl-01-cos-03|text: That kunai wasn't an invention after all. It was a toy from the 'Neighbor Ninja' manga... It was Yu's personal item.
data.home-action-rui-05-vlnt-00-01|text: At the live I heard lots of 'I saw the CM!' calls. It makes me happy but also a bit shy.
data.home-action-rui-05-vlnt-00-cos-01|text: Nagisa and Mei keep begging me to 'show them a kiss face!' Everyone at Hoshimi Pro likes this kind of thing...
data.home-action-rui-05-vlnt-00-cos-02|text: When I met Kokoro after the CM aired, she said, 'Whoa! So sweet! It's sickeningly sweet!'
data.home-action-rui-05-vlnt-00-cos-03|text: During the CM shoot, Sumire was so adorable fussing about being 'classmates.' The staff couldn't stop smiling.
data.home-action-rui-05-xmas-00-01|text: How was the Christmas live? Did our feelings reach everyone?
data.home-action-rui-05-xmas-00-cos-01|text: Christmas is a special day, isn't it? Getting to wear such a wonderful costume makes me truly happy.
data.home-action-rui-05-xmas-00-cos-02|text: I like this costume with its subdued reds -- very mature. I hope the fans will be pleased too.
data.home-action-rui-05-xmas-00-cos-03|text: I asked Kotono her thoughts on the costume and she said, 'It's red.' Doesn't it have more character than that?
data.home-action-rui-05-yukt-00-01|text: I was studying how to look beautiful in a yukata from period dramas and films and ended up staying up late.
data.home-action-rui-05-yukt-00-cos-01|text: Why aren't there gummy candy stalls? Is it because most festivals are in summer and they'd melt?
data.home-action-rui-05-yukt-00-cos-02|text: TRI-ALL is usually white wings, but for a yukata, cool wings like a butterfly or dragonfly would suit us.
data.home-action-rui-05-yukt-00-cos-03|text: I had no idea it took so long to put on a yukata.
data.home-action-rui-2nd-anniv-01|text: Dear, as the summer heat approaches... Hmm, this is stiff... I suppose just 'good work' will do...
data.home-action-rui-2nd-anniv-02|text: Excuse me, could you keep this time slot on this day clear? I have a bit of business to attend to.
data.home-action-rui-2nd-anniv-03|text: fran is truly gifted, isn't she? Seeing it up close, you really feel it.
data.home-action-rui-basic-01|text: Good work today. For our fans' sake, I'll aim for the best live possible.
data.home-action-rui-basic-02|text: There's apparently lettuce-flavored gummy candy overseas. Gummies are already delicious, and they keep making them even better.
data.home-action-rui-basic-03|text: I'm often asked in interviews if I have any cute hobbies. Should I have one? I can't think of anything.
data.home-action-rui-basic-04|text: I got first place in the side-step test. But it's not very cute, so don't put it in my profile.
data.home-action-rui-basic-05|text: I have a goal for the next live. Yu always gets the laughs, so I'll try to get one too.
data.home-action-rui-basic-06|text: There's a restaurant I really want to visit. They have spicy soy sauce chocolate monja. Care to go with me?
data.home-action-rui-basic-07|text: I just ran 10 kilometers and my body is still buzzing. Want to go for another run? I'll keep you company.
data.home-action-rui-basic-08|text: Even in the same agency, Sakura and Kotono are rivals, so I can't help but keep an eye on their moves during lessons and lives.
data.home-action-rui-basic-09|text: I feel someone watching me from the agency, and it turns out to be Suz far away. Did I do something?
data.home-action-rui-basic-10|text: Being at Hoshimi Pro, I feel like I can somehow see what TRI-ALL was missing.
data.home-action-rui-basic-51|text: I asked about the next hot pot party date in the TRI-ALL group chat, but I accidentally sent it to Rio...
data.home-action-rui-basic-52|text: I've discovered something! Macaroni gratin flavored gummies are delicious on top of any food!
data.home-action-rui-basic-53|text: Running is perfect for a change of pace. It clears the head too. Want to go for a 10k now? I'll join.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-ai-01|text: It's Ai's birthday. She'd probably be interested in my training menu or something like that...
data.home-action-rui-birthday-aoi-01|text: It's Aoi's birthday. A birthday dance battle planning... He'd probably enjoy that, actually?
data.home-action-rui-birthday-chs-01|text: It's Chisa's birthday. Saki has been super excited for the past few days.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-hrk-01|text: I went to congratulate Hiroko on her birthday. I admire composed women like her.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-kan-01|text: kana said she wants something that'll go viral on SNS for her birthday... That's tough... a new song?
data.home-action-rui-birthday-kkr-01|text: I hear it's Kokoro's birthday. Will they have a big celebration with LizNoir?
data.home-action-rui-birthday-kor-01|text: Even on her birthday, fran was absorbed in stock investments. Truly relentless.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-ktn-01|text: I heard they celebrated Kotono's birthday in the dressing room. It sounds cozy and nice.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-mei-01|text: The three of us went to congratulate Mei just now. She was very happy, which made us happy too.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-mhk-01|text: I prepared a present for miho's birthday. After all, we're rivals at the same agency.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-mna-01|text: It's Mana Nagase's birthday. I find myself wishing I could have seen her real live once...
data.home-action-rui-birthday-ngs-01|text: Nagisa seemed so cheerful. When I asked, it was her birthday. I want to give her something too.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-rei-01|text: Today is Rei's birthday. A joint practice session as a gift... Is that weird?
data.home-action-rui-birthday-rio-01|text: Today is Rio's birthday. Casually saying congrats might be my first time since coming to Hoshimi Pro...
data.home-action-rui-birthday-rui-01|text: To receive so many congratulations... Hoshimi Pro really is the best place!
data.home-action-rui-birthday-ski-01|text: It's Saki's birthday. The Moon Tempest everyone seems busy with preparations.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-skr-01|text: Today is Sakura's birthday. I'll go congratulate her later.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-smr-01|text: I was able to tour Tokyo with Sumire today. I hope it made for a good birthday celebration.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-suz-01|text: I heard it's Suz's birthday. I want to give her something, but do you know what she'd like?
data.home-action-rui-birthday-szk-01|text: It's Shizuku's birthday today. I'd love to have a deep conversation about idol history with her.
data.home-action-rui-birthday-yu-01|text: Do I look more excited than usual? That's... probably because it's Yu's birthday.
data.home-action-rui-christ-01|text: Christmas... What should I do to make our fans happy?
data.home-action-rui-halw-01|text: On Halloween, do pumpkin ghosts come out?
data.home-action-rui-newy-01|text: Happy New Year. This year I'll aim even higher!
data.home-action-rui-newyeve-01|text: Thank you for everything this year. I'll do my best next year too.
data.home-action-rui-trust-01-01|text: It's not that I dislike it. It's just that variety show segments are tricky. I don't dislike it. Really.
data.home-action-rui-trust-01-02|text: The Hoshimi Pro dorm is relaxing. Yu used to be next door, but mostly I've been alone...
data.home-action-rui-trust-01-03|text: I can only feel gratitude toward Hoshimi Pro. They saved us, they support us. Thank you truly.
data.home-action-rui-trust-02-01|text: Would you scold me? The truth is... I overslept today. I'm ashamed of myself. Go ahead, scold me.
data.home-action-rui-trust-02-02|text: Having my father run another agency feels strange. Our relationship is fine though...
data.home-action-rui-trust-02-03|text: What a mysterious person. Different agency, yet I opened my heart right away. The sense of peace is remarkable...
data.home-action-rui-trust-03-01|text: Once on the bullet train, I was supposed to get off in Osaka but I fell asleep... and ended up in Kyushu. It's our secret.
data.home-action-rui-trust-03-02|text: Want to get dinner with the three of us in TRI-ALL? Well... Yu and Sumire really want to.
data.home-action-rui-trust-03-03|text: I doze off sometimes, don't I? But here I feel at ease. Because you're here, Manager.
data.home-action-rui-trust-04-01|text: The other day I saw you in a meeting at the venue. The atmosphere was different from usual. Very mature.
data.home-action-rui-trust-04-02|text: Do you think I'm strong? Please don't forget I'm just a normal girl like everyone else.
data.home-action-rui-trust-04-03|text: So you're equally nice to everyone. Yu told me to watch out for people- pleasers, you know?
data.home-action-ski-05-casl-04-01|text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven... {user}, what time is it?
data.home-action-ski-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Asakusa has that hamburger shop that's in Hoshimi City too. That's one of my recommended spots.
data.home-action-ski-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: {user}, want to take another day off together? There's a place I'd like to visit.
data.home-action-ski-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: Asakusa's melon bread is truly delicious. Crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy within.
data.home-action-ski-05-chsk-00-01|text: Just wearing this fills me with happiness. Thanks to Chisa, I have a lifetime treasure.
