data.home-action-skr-birthday-ngs-01|text: The Moon Tempest crew was preparing for Nagisa-chan's birthday party!
data.home-action-skr-birthday-rei-01|text: Rei-chan brought new wear looking happy. Is it a birthday present?
data.home-action-skr-birthday-rio-01|text: Rio-chan, even though it's your birthday you look busy. She seems to have a message for fans!
data.home-action-skr-birthday-rui-01|text: It's Rui-chan's birthday! I want to congratulate her but I can't seem to catch her!
data.home-action-skr-birthday-ski-01|text: Today's Saki-chan's birthday! I told her happy birthday first thing in the morning!
data.home-action-skr-birthday-skr-01|text: The surprise birthday celebration really made me so, so happy... Thank you so much!!
data.home-action-skr-birthday-smr-01|text: Today is Sumire-chan's birthday! She's younger but also a senior... It feels a bit mysterious!
data.home-action-skr-birthday-suz-01|text: These sweets? They're a birthday present for Suz! I can't wait to give them!
data.home-action-skr-birthday-szk-01|text: Today! It's Shizuku-chan's birthday! Everything is ready to celebrate. All that's left is to execute!!
data.home-action-skr-birthday-yu-01|text: Yu-chan's birthday present is so hard to pick~ What does she like~? I've been worrying and still can't decide...
data.home-action-skr-christ-01|text: Merry Christmas! So fun and happy~
data.home-action-skr-halw-01|text: Trick or... Can I have this candy?
data.home-action-skr-newy-01|text: Happy New Year! Here's to a great year!
data.home-action-skr-newyeve-01|text: It's already the end of the year! Next year, let's keep it up!
data.home-action-skr-trust-01-01|text: I'm drowning in homework! They gave us an impossible amount! I'll have to ask Saki-chan for help!
data.home-action-skr-trust-01-02|text: I like the current dorm, but I also want to visit the Hoshimi City dorm sometimes~ It's packed with memories.
data.home-action-skr-trust-01-03|text: I've been thinking lately that it's important to put 'thank you' into words!
data.home-action-skr-trust-02-01|text: I haven't been in a while! Yakiniku! Let's all go together for a change!
data.home-action-skr-trust-02-02|text: I went to the Hoshimi Festival once. It was so fun, if our days off match up, I'd love to go with everyone next time!
data.home-action-skr-trust-02-03|text: A staff member gave me famous French toast! Wanna eat it together?
data.home-action-skr-trust-03-01|text: It's still a secret, but I might get recommended to the student council. This is my first time hearing something like this and I'm a little excited!
data.home-action-skr-trust-03-02|text: I took photos of school, so I'll show you sometime. By the way, I don't think we've talked much before!
data.home-action-skr-trust-03-03|text: Could we go to the convenience store or something, even just for a bit? I kind of wanted to just chat with you.
data.home-action-skr-trust-04-01|text: I just nailed a tricky choreo move in self-practice! I wanted to tell someone first, so I was looking for you!
data.home-action-skr-trust-04-02|text: Let's walk home together today! No particular reason, but... I used to walk with you a lot before, that's all!
data.home-action-skr-trust-04-03|text: When Manager is nearby, I feel at ease. It's like you're protecting me or something!
data.home-action-smr-05-casl-04-01|text: The flower crown onii-chan gave me will wilt someday, but until then I'll treasure it!
data.home-action-smr-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Please keep booking work in Yamagata! I want lots and lots more!
data.home-action-smr-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: This outfit is a total favorite! It's packed with memories...!
data.home-action-smr-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: Whenever you crave Yamagata food, just say the word! I'll have it shipped right over!
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-00-01|text: Why are coffee names so fancy? I need to practice ordering or I'll stumble over the words.
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-00-cos-01|text: It's so elaborate yet still easy to move in! I can't wait to show the fans!
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-00-cos-02|text: Chisa-senpai saw this outfit and praised me lots! I'm invincible today~!
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-00-cos-03|text: How's this outfit? Dressing like a princess makes me feel a bit shy.
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-03-01|text: Okonomiyaki, kushikatsu... Butaman was delicious too... I wanna go to Osaka again~.
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-03-cos-01|text: I'll work hard so I don't lose to the outfit! I'll become the number one idol in the universe!
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-03-cos-02|text: Ehehe, matching outfits with everyone make me so happy! We took tons of photos!
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-03-cos-03|text: After the national tour, I want to do a world tour! Let's deliver our songs across the globe!
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-04-01|text: I wonder if that person chasing the ad truck fell or not... They were running so desperately, I'm worried.
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-04-cos-01|text: {user}-san, what kind of payback makes you happy? Tell me for reference!
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-04-cos-02|text: Wearing this outfit, I feel power surging through me! Right now I could handle anything!
data.home-action-smr-05-fest-04-cos-03|text: When we're on talk shows with comedians, I always laugh so much my stomach hurts... Ehehe.
data.home-action-smr-05-frut-00-01|text: Chisa-senpai was staring at me while I was munching cherries, so we ate a bunch together~.
data.home-action-smr-05-frut-00-cos-01|text: This outfit has cherries all over it! Ehehe, it's making me hungry.
data.home-action-smr-05-frut-00-cos-02|text: Working in my hometown in this was like a dream! I hope we can do it again next year!
data.home-action-smr-05-frut-00-cos-03|text: Please taste the cherries in the fridge soon! Everyone's gonna eat them all if you wait~.
data.home-action-smr-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: I really respect the people who make costumes! How do they come up with these designs? I'm so curious!
data.home-action-smr-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: Chisa-senpai helps with costume creation too, right? I'd love to wear one of her designs someday!
data.home-action-smr-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: Of course I like the new outfits, but wearing this one just makes me feel like, yeah, this is it. Ehehe.
data.home-action-smr-05-idol-04-01|text: I'd love to try hopping between open-air baths. Are you interested, Manager?
data.home-action-smr-05-idol-04-cos-01|text: I'm so happy the three of us can take on new challenges in this outfit!
data.home-action-smr-05-idol-04-cos-02|text: They're both so reliable that I have to make sure I'm not just leaning on them all the time.
data.home-action-smr-05-idol-04-cos-03|text: Since we wear this for tourism ambassador work too, I want even people not into idols to remember it.
data.home-action-smr-05-jwel-00-01|text: They said it's too early for a kid, but I'd love even just one real gemstone...
data.home-action-smr-05-jwel-00-cos-01|text: The scenes with Rui-chan and Yu-chan talking together need no acting at all. It's easy.
data.home-action-smr-05-jwel-00-cos-02|text: For TriAile's next live, how about trying wire action?
data.home-action-smr-05-jwel-00-cos-03|text: Don't be swayed by sweet words or big money! Bad things are a no-go!
data.home-action-smr-05-magi-00-01|text: I have to play a magical girl who meets everyone's expectations! I'll do my best!
data.home-action-smr-05-magi-00-cos-01|text: I think if you practice enough, you can cast magic even in real life!
data.home-action-smr-05-magi-00-cos-02|text: Anyone can tell I'm a magical girl! Fufu. I'll blast the evil succubus away with my magic!
data.home-action-smr-05-magi-00-cos-03|text: Magical girls need a magic wand, right? It's everyone's dream!
data.home-action-smr-05-maid-00-01|text: Since appearing in that movie, people of all ages call out to me now.
data.home-action-smr-05-maid-00-cos-01|text: Acting is interesting, isn't it? You get to experience a life that isn't your own.
data.home-action-smr-05-maid-00-cos-02|text: I wonder how they'd react if I served tea in this outfit... Eh, you could hear me?
data.home-action-smr-05-maid-00-cos-03|text: I kind of envy shops with cute uniforms. I'd love to try one on.
data.home-action-smr-05-mizg-01-01|text: In a way, to Manager, Rui-chan and Yu-chan are like imoutos too... so I'm the youngest!
data.home-action-smr-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: When the three of us wore this with Rui-chan and Yu-chan, I didn't mind being looked at.
data.home-action-smr-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: In the end, nobody said I looked sexy... But someday I'll make them say it in this outfit!
data.home-action-smr-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: Since we can go in the sea, the material is swimsuit-like, right? This outfit.
data.home-action-smr-05-mizg-02-01|text: Yu-chan said she wanted to play with us too. Should I have woken her up?
data.home-action-smr-05-mizg-02-cos-01|text: This outfit is packed with su~mmer memories!
data.home-action-smr-05-mizg-02-cos-02|text: I want to eat rainbow shiratama anko special again... Chomolungma-sized, of course...
data.home-action-smr-05-mizg-02-cos-03|text: Fufu, Rui-chan was worried that I got too excited in front of {user}-san.
data.home-action-smr-05-newy-00-01|text: When we ran the marathon on the show, so many people cheered on the course! I got so much energy!
data.home-action-smr-05-newy-00-cos-01|text: I pushed too hard in the marathon. Both legs are shaking~!
data.home-action-smr-05-newy-00-cos-02|text: Running by the sea feels great. Someday I want to run along the beach with everyone at Hoshimi Pro~.
data.home-action-smr-05-newy-00-cos-03|text: How about new goods with a banner that says 'Hoshimi Pro, rulers of the world'?
data.home-action-smr-05-nurs-00-01|text: Hey, is your face a little red? Let me check your forehead for a fever. Hmm, let's see~.
data.home-action-smr-05-nurs-00-cos-01|text: "Give me a break..." I tried acting like {user}-san. Does it look right?
data.home-action-smr-05-nurs-00-cos-02|text: Even as a child actor, work was fun. All the staff treated me so well.
data.home-action-smr-05-nurs-00-cos-03|text: Come to think of it, I rarely catch colds. My energy's my strong point.
data.home-action-smr-05-pajm-00-01|text: Imoni~ imoni~ Ehehe, I got a can of imoni from home for the first time in ages and I was so happy I sang.
data.home-action-smr-05-pajm-00-cos-01|text: Getting matching outfits made really makes it feel like we're active as one unit.
data.home-action-smr-05-pajm-00-cos-02|text: This outfit is super cute, and above all it's so fluffy it makes me sleepy.
data.home-action-smr-05-pajm-00-cos-03|text: Can I use this eye mask on the bullet train too? It feels amazing no matter what.
data.home-action-smr-05-seik-00-01|text: Onii-chan said this outfit was cute too. Ehehe... I'm so happy.
data.home-action-smr-05-seik-00-cos-01|text: Standing on a beautiful stage in this calm-colored outfit makes me feel grown-up.
data.home-action-smr-05-seik-00-cos-02|text: Performing with onii-chan is like a dream...! It was truly a wonderful surprise.
data.home-action-smr-05-seik-00-cos-03|text: Oshiruko Warrior Sumire-chan appears! How about a tokusatsu show? A Yamagata local hero!
data.home-action-smr-05-xmas-00-01|text: Christmas is a day to spend with precious people. I hope TriAile can be that for our fans.
data.home-action-smr-05-xmas-00-cos-01|text: Shizuku-san and Satomi-san were secretly taking photos when I wore this, going 'treasure treasure' as they left!
data.home-action-smr-05-xmas-00-cos-02|text: Did you see Rui-chan and Yu-chan in this? Even though I see them daily, my heart went kyunkyun~
data.home-action-smr-05-xmas-00-cos-03|text: {user}-san, I'll put a sock by my pillow, so please fill it with presents!
data.home-action-smr-2nd-anniv-01|text: Can you tell me {user}-san's work schedule? If there's free time I want to hang out~.
data.home-action-smr-2nd-anniv-02|text: Renting a live venue must cost a fortune, right? I wonder how much...
data.home-action-smr-2nd-anniv-03|text: Hmm hmm. Available days are... This one or maybe this one.
data.home-action-smr-basic-01|text: I slept tons on the bullet train so I'm super energetic! Let's do our best today too!
data.home-action-smr-basic-02|text: Hypothetically, okay!? If Hoshimi Pro got an oshiruko commercial offer, let me do it!
data.home-action-smr-basic-03|text: I pick fruit super fast, so farmers keep telling me to marry into their families!
data.home-action-smr-basic-04|text: Yu-chan was surprised, but I can tell if wild plants and mushrooms are edible!
data.home-action-smr-basic-05|text: Next time it's at the same venue as Sunny Peace! I can't wait to see Chisa-senpai perform!
data.home-action-smr-basic-06|text: I'm heading back to Yamagata tomorrow, so please tell me next week's schedule. I'll read the script on the train!
data.home-action-smr-basic-07|text: Lots of fruit was harvested in my hometown, so I had some sent to the office! One box each!
data.home-action-smr-basic-08|text: Chisa-senpai shows me cute clothes and shops that don't exist in Yamagata. She's my fashion leader!
data.home-action-smr-basic-09|text: Keeping up with Rui-chan and Yu-chan's lessons is tough. But I won't grow otherwise.
data.home-action-smr-basic-10|text: It's amazing! All the semifinalist groups are together! Looking around gets me excited!
data.home-action-smr-basic-51|text: Someone who looked like kana-san near the dorm? No no, I must've imagined it!
data.home-action-smr-basic-52|text: Wanna play kendama together, {user}-san? Ken-ken! Ken-pappa!
data.home-action-smr-basic-53|text: I stopped bringing nerikeshi to school because I couldn't focus on class...
data.home-action-smr-birthday-ai-01|text: It's Ai-san's birthday! Working on your birthday is pretty tough, isn't it!?
data.home-action-smr-birthday-aoi-01|text: It's Aoi-san's birthday! His dance is so cool! I told him!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-chs-01|text: I wanted to give Chisa-senpai a horror movie for her birthday but I was too scared to buy one...
data.home-action-smr-birthday-hrk-01|text: It's Haruko-senpai's birthday! I just went to say happy birthday!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-kan-01|text: It's kana-san's birthday. What should I give? Something that looks great on SNS... Imoni soup...?
data.home-action-smr-birthday-kkr-01|text: Kokoro-chan's birthday is today! As my senior in life, I have to celebrate properly!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-kor-01|text: It's Fran-san's birthday, but the IIIX members don't seem to do anything. Is that what being adults is?
data.home-action-smr-birthday-ktn-01|text: Kotono-senpai, today is your birthday! I said happy birthday and she got a bit shy~!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-mei-01|text: Mei-senpai, I gave her an imoni can for her birthday! She said it looked delicious!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-mhk-01|text: It's miho-senpai's birthday, so I decided to send her sake from my family's brewery! I hope she likes it~
data.home-action-smr-birthday-mna-01|text: It's Mana-san's birthday. She's such an important person to Hoshimi Pro.
data.home-action-smr-birthday-ngs-01|text: I told Nagisa-senpai happy birthday! She was so happy and that made me happy too!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-rei-01|text: Today's Rei-chan's birthday! I bet she wants macarons, right?
data.home-action-smr-birthday-rio-01|text: Today is Rio-senpai's birthday! I went to congratulate her and she was cool and thankful as always!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-rui-01|text: Rui-chan's! Birthday! Today! I'll tell her all my gratitude!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-ski-01|text: It's Saki-senpai's birthday. It feels like everyone's onee-chan's birthday. Amazing!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-skr-01|text: It's Sakura-senpai's birthday! I want to celebrate too!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-smr-01|text: I got the most wonderful celebration ever! I can never thank everyone enough!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-suz-01|text: Today is Suzu-chan's birthday! I'll go congratulate her later!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-szk-01|text: Shizuku-san's birthday had everyone at Sunny Peace so excited! You're all so close~
data.home-action-smr-birthday-user-01|text: Oh, it's your birthday! Happy birthday!
data.home-action-smr-birthday-yu-01|text: Today is Yu-chan's long-awaited birthday! I prepared the ultimate celebration plan!
data.home-action-smr-christ-01|text: I want to go see a big Christmas tree.
data.home-action-smr-halw-01|text: Halloween, huh... The city is really something~
data.home-action-smr-newyeve-01|text: Another year is ending... See you next year!
data.home-action-smr-trust-01-01|text: When they offer me coffee at work, is it okay to ask for sugar? It's hard to bring myself to say it...
data.home-action-smr-trust-01-02|text: When I'm working in Tokyo for a long stretch, I get homesick sometimes. Is that homesickness~?
data.home-action-smr-trust-01-03|text: This is the first manager who treats me like family! I really love it!
data.home-action-smr-trust-02-01|text: I wanted to go somewhere hard to suggest to the other two in TriAile... Could you come to a beef bowl place with me?
data.home-action-smr-trust-02-02|text: I helped at my family's sake brewery on my day off and got sore muscles... Different muscles than idol work...
data.home-action-smr-trust-02-03|text: I got chosen for the three-legged race at sports day! Could you help me practice in your free time?
data.home-action-smr-trust-03-01|text: Actually, I keep a kendama in my bag. People'd think I'm always playing, so it's a secret!
data.home-action-smr-trust-03-02|text: I brought cherries from home, so let's eat them together! There aren't many this time, so let's be sneaky!
data.home-action-smr-trust-03-03|text: There's a school open house, but my family is busy... I know it's a big ask, but could you possibly come?
data.home-action-smr-trust-04-01|text: Onii-chan! Onii-chaaan!! ...Sorry... I can't say it normally and it just came out. Ehehe.
data.home-action-smr-trust-04-02|text: You always see me off to the station and I'm so grateful! But you could visit Yamagata once a year, you know?
data.home-action-smr-trust-04-03|text: Onii-chan used to pat my head. I wish my Tokyo onii-chan would do that sometimes too.
data.home-action-stm-2nd-anniv-01|text: You might say it's my imagination, but when the idols are restless, I get restless too...
data.home-action-stm-2nd-anniv-02|text: Um, senpai. The idols have been acting strange lately... Should I hear them out a bit?
data.home-action-stm-birthday-user-01|text: Ah, senpai, what are you doing~! Today's your birthday, right!? Happy birthday!
data.home-action-suz-05-alic-00-01|text: It is because of the former me that the Alice in me exists today! Do watch closely, my performance!
data.home-action-suz-05-alic-00-cos-01|text: Please do look! This is the Alice costume I have long wished for! Does it suit me?
data.home-action-suz-05-alic-00-cos-02|text: Achoo, achoo! Do not worry, it is part of Alice's act. Did I do it cutely enough?
data.home-action-suz-05-alic-00-cos-03|text: Ever since I played Alice, I often dream of her world. What sort of dream shall I have tonight?
data.home-action-suz-05-angl-00-01|text: Kokoro caught me holding potato chips stacked like a duck's beak in my mouth! How mortifying…
data.home-action-suz-05-angl-00-cos-01|text: Mei keeps poking at my halo with great curiosity. She is truly like a cat.
data.home-action-suz-05-angl-00-cos-02|text: Saki heard my ad-lib and said, 'How were the potato chips you ate in secret?' With a smile…!
data.home-action-suz-05-angl-00-cos-03|text: That romance drama has become even more popular… Rei was watching it quite seriously the other day.
data.home-action-suz-05-anml-00-01|text: You may absolutely schedule me for a prank job next. I am always prepared, you see.
data.home-action-suz-05-anml-00-cos-01|text: These ears are not merely cute, you know. I shall not let a single compliment slip by.
data.home-action-suz-05-anml-00-cos-02|text: Falling behind in solo jobs is simply unacceptable. I am a top idol, after all!
data.home-action-suz-05-anml-00-cos-03|text: My jobs have been increasing lately. I shall not let Mother say another word!
data.home-action-suz-05-casl-04-01|text: We shall go see the okapi together. A 'lady of the forest'— that is quite like me, is it not?
data.home-action-suz-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: Unlike Sumire, I shall never act spoiled toward a Tokyo gentleman. An equal relationship is what I prefer.
data.home-action-suz-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: I gave Kotono and the others panda keychains from Chinatown and they were quite pleased.
data.home-action-suz-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: It was only a single day, but it may have been even more fun than going to Australia.
data.home-action-suz-05-fest-02-01|text: The period of performing as four had its hardships… but surely it was a necessary time for us.
data.home-action-suz-05-fest-02-cos-01|text: I shall handle every job flawlessly, worthy of the BIG4 name! Just watch me!
data.home-action-suz-05-fest-02-cos-02|text: Even as five, we shall continue to cherish and sing 'Most Beloved, Reach You.'
data.home-action-suz-05-fest-02-cos-03|text: Switching between this costume and our first one within a single live sounds delightful, does it not?
data.home-action-suz-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: Ah, this outfit truly befits me… It shines as brightly as my own radiance.
data.home-action-suz-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: I do wish the heels were a bit higher, but taller heels make dancing difficult… How vexing.
data.home-action-suz-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: Changing has become much quicker. In the beginning, it took me a full thirty minutes…
data.home-action-suz-05-kion-00-01|text: Someone called me 'Suzu-nyan' and I answered naturally. The power of habit is terrifying…
data.home-action-suz-05-kion-00-cos-01|text: Following the light music club's example, holding a tea party during lesson breaks is not a bad idea.
data.home-action-suz-05-kion-00-cos-02|text: Wearing a different school's uniform gives me quite a thrill.
data.home-action-suz-05-kion-00-cos-03|text: Even if my pace is slow like a turtle's, steady effort will lead to victory in the end.
data.home-action-suz-05-mizg-01-01|text: Was it out of kindness that you let me play at the summer sea? Or did you want to play too, Manager?
data.home-action-suz-05-mizg-01-cos-01|text: This costume reminds me of the sea! Ahh~, I want to play to my heart's content again!
data.home-action-suz-05-mizg-01-cos-02|text: A design that accentuates my beauty—wonderful. The only problem… it cannot be worn in winter.
data.home-action-suz-05-mizg-01-cos-03|text: Was this costume tailored to fit me perfectly? It suits me almost frighteningly well!
data.home-action-suz-05-msic-00-01|text: Lady Mana… thank you truly for letting me dream an endless dream…
data.home-action-suz-05-msic-00-cos-01|text: Festival stall food has a charm all its own compared to eating at a restaurant…
data.home-action-suz-05-msic-00-cos-02|text: The spring festival mini-live— we shall go again next year! Fufu, I look forward to it already.
data.home-action-suz-05-msic-00-cos-03|text: Like Lady Mana, I too must keep shining to become someone's brightest star.
data.home-action-suz-05-onep-00-01|text: Those hot gazes… surely not… No, it cannot be. Do not try to deceive this pure and lovely me!
data.home-action-suz-05-onep-00-cos-01|text: I wish Lady Mana could have tried on this costume. It would surely have suited her!
data.home-action-suz-05-onep-00-cos-02|text: Ah, ei, ue, eo, ao. I have been subjecting myself to harsh training to never stumble at crucial moments.
data.home-action-suz-05-onep-00-cos-03|text: If Rei sees me at this live and thinks of Lady Mana, treating me as a rival… what should I do?
data.home-action-suz-05-pair-00-01|text: Mei pats my head so much that I have grown accustomed to it. It no longer bothers me.
data.home-action-suz-05-pair-00-cos-01|text: Do you not find this costume's dog ears and tail cute? You may touch them. As a special favor.
data.home-action-suz-05-pair-00-cos-02|text: Mei tries to put cat ears on me at every opportunity! Please do something about it!
data.home-action-suz-05-pair-00-cos-03|text: It is not that I am lonely, but when Mei is not here, it feels strangely quiet and lacking.
data.home-action-suz-05-seik-00-01|text: I shall become a first-rate idol. And you shall aim to become a first-rate manager worthy of me!
data.home-action-suz-05-seik-00-cos-01|text: Fuh… I can wear any costume charmingly… I am frightening even to myself…!
data.home-action-suz-05-seik-00-cos-02|text: As a great actress, I am always mindful of my demeanor and conduct.
data.home-action-suz-05-seik-00-cos-03|text: Your necktie is crooked. You are my manager, so do mind your appearance properly.
data.home-action-suz-05-wedd-00-01|text: What? I look like a quiet girl from a good family? I AM a girl from a good family!
data.home-action-suz-05-wedd-00-cos-01|text: This dress is hard to walk in. Hold my hand firmly and support me so I do not fall.
data.home-action-suz-05-wedd-00-cos-02|text: As the Narumiya family's daughter and a super-idol beauty, it is inevitable that I become the happiest bride!
data.home-action-suz-05-wedd-00-cos-03|text: My photo book sales are soaring. You may praise me for being photogenic, you know?
data.home-action-suz-05-xmas-00-01|text: We ought to start preparing for next year's Christmas already. There is no such thing as too early.
data.home-action-suz-05-xmas-00-cos-01|text: Burn the sight of idol Santa Suzu Narumiya into your eyes!
data.home-action-suz-05-xmas-00-cos-02|text: Christmas spent happily with everyone. I have always longed for this sort of thing.
data.home-action-suz-05-xmas-00-cos-03|text: Ahh… Thinking that Christmas will be over makes me feel rather lonely.
data.home-action-suz-2nd-anniv-01|text: Gnununu… Unununu… W-what are you looking at?!
data.home-action-suz-2nd-anniv-02|text: Hm hm hm~hm… I am~ as~ usual~ …What was 'usual' again…
data.home-action-suz-2nd-anniv-03|text: …Huh? Me? Something's off? N-no, no, no, what on earth are you t-talking about…
data.home-action-suz-basic-01|text: Good work! Now, Manager, announce today's schedule!
data.home-action-suz-basic-02|text: My potato chips~ they have disappeared~ Could you please buy more~
data.home-action-suz-basic-03|text: Manager! This is a crisis! There is no longer enough space for Lady Mana's goods!
data.home-action-suz-basic-04|text: Please listen! I have created a new catchphrase! Come hear it later when I perform it!
data.home-action-suz-basic-05|text: Fuh-hun. Do watch tomorrow's live battle. I shall unveil a brand-new technique for you.
data.home-action-suz-basic-06|text: I recently achieved first place in my grade on a test. Academics and arts—both are my forte!
data.home-action-suz-basic-07|text: Why did no one tell me Lady Mana's autograph was fake?! I was made a complete fool!
data.home-action-suz-basic-08|text: Please help me! Mei keeps chasing after me! What on earth does she want?!
data.home-action-suz-basic-09|text: Come to think of it, somehow Kokoro started calling me 'Suzu-nyan' without my permission…
data.home-action-suz-basic-10|text: There is no plan to make me the center… is there. Yes, I am well aware.
data.home-action-suz-basic-51|text: Fuaah~. Rei and I were gaming until late at night and now I am sleep-deprived… She never let me win…
data.home-action-suz-basic-52|text: Do Rei and I really look that alike? There are even online articles claiming we are sisters.
data.home-action-suz-basic-53|text: Rei apparently forgot her gym uniform so I brought it to her classroom, but she turned me away…
data.home-action-suz-birthday-ai-01|text: It was Ai's birthday. I have been searching but cannot find her… Ah, she was working.
data.home-action-suz-birthday-aoi-01|text: I hear today is Aoi's birthday. I wonder if the LizNoir members are planning some sort of gathering?
data.home-action-suz-birthday-chs-01|text: Today is Chisa's birthday. I heard they are doing something spectacular… How intriguing.
data.home-action-suz-birthday-chs-02|text: I-I will celebrate Chisa's birthday, but being subjected to horror films and ghost stories is terrifying!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-hrk-01|text: Today is Haruko's birthday. As Hoshimi's most senior idol, we must celebrate in grand style!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-kan-01|text: So today is kana's birthday, is it? She just demanded a present… I must prepare one…
data.home-action-suz-birthday-kkr-01|text: Is it not Kokoro's birthday! Her usual teasing, I suppose I can allow it just for today.
data.home-action-suz-birthday-kor-01|text: It is fran's birthday. I suppose the ⅢX members do not hold birthday parties… do they?
data.home-action-suz-birthday-ktn-01|text: The look on Kotono's face when we started celebrating in the dressing room… quite something!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-mei-01|text: Today is Mei's birthday. She seemed delighted, but then she always seems delighted.
data.home-action-suz-birthday-mhk-01|text: Today is miho's birthday. I was hoping to give her a lovely gift, but she just said 'how predictable.'
data.home-action-suz-birthday-mna-01|text: It is Lady Mana's birthday! Oh, Lady Mana! I shall become an idol worthy of being her successor!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-ngs-01|text: Today is Nagisa's birthday! The Monthly Idol members will give it their all to liven up this day!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-rei-01|text: It is Rei's birthday, is it not. Perhaps I ought to give her a box of macarons?
data.home-action-suz-birthday-rio-01|text: It is Rei's birthday… is it not. As the face of Monthly Idol, I must properly offer my congratulations!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-rui-01|text: What should I give Rui for her birthday… A mountain of gummy candy, perhaps?
data.home-action-suz-birthday-ski-01|text: Saki's birthday party preparations are not finished. We must hurry!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-skr-01|text: It is Sakura's birthday. The Sunny Peace members threw her a surprise. How enviable!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-smr-01|text: It is Sumire's birthday. We are the same age but I am the onee-san at Hoshimi… I shall celebrate properly.
data.home-action-suz-birthday-suz-01|text: A memorable day of birth! Yes! It is MINE! You may celebrate to your heart's content!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-szk-01|text: It is Shizuku's birthday. Today only, I shall concede the title of #1 idol otaku! Today... only!
data.home-action-suz-birthday-user-01|text: Fufu, it was your birthday, wasn't it. Manager.
data.home-action-suz-birthday-yu-01|text: Today was Yu's birthday. As fellow refined ladies, we ought to enjoy a lovely chat!
data.home-action-suz-christ-01|text: I expect a gorgeous present worthy of me, of course.
data.home-action-suz-halw-01|text: Must I really wear a costume…?
data.home-action-suz-newy-01|text: It is the new year. Now, let us go to the shrine!
data.home-action-suz-newyeve-01|text: It was a wonderful year. You agree, do you not?
data.home-action-suz-trust-01-01|text: What is the point of homework?! I do not need to do homework to excel in my studies.
data.home-action-suz-trust-01-02|text: I wish to turn the old Hoshimi City office site into a Lady Mana museum. It is, after all, hallowed ground. Is that not acceptable?
data.home-action-suz-trust-01-03|text: T-thank you for everything. A-ah, thank you. …Mei told me to say that!
data.home-action-suz-trust-02-01|text: If I win the next live battle… will you treat me to a meal? Yakiniku, of course!
data.home-action-suz-trust-02-02|text: My mother and father have been sneaking into my lives, it seems. They could just be honest about it.
data.home-action-suz-trust-02-03|text: Th-that is… Lady Mana's?! May I? May I really?! Thank you ever so much!
data.home-action-suz-trust-03-01|text: Actually, I forgot my homework so many times I ended up in remedial class. Keep it secret from Saki!
data.home-action-suz-trust-03-02|text: It seems so many fan letters have arrived. At last the world is recognizing my worth!
data.home-action-suz-trust-03-03|text: Eh, I am amazing? What is this all of a sudden? You have finally realized how wonderful I am. Praise me more!
data.home-action-suz-trust-04-01|text: W-would you like to have a meal together? …I-I only asked because you seemed lonely, that is all!
data.home-action-suz-trust-04-02|text: An idol going out with a man is dangerous… is it not. {user}, would you come to my room instead?
data.home-action-suz-trust-04-03|text: Do you dislike short women? D-do not misunderstand! I merely wish to understand male fans' tastes!
data.home-action-szk-05-alic-00-01|text: …I was thinking about the next performance's program. …Time flew. How about a story about a time thief next?
data.home-action-szk-05-alic-00-cos-01|text: We had to change costumes mid-performance, so… I practiced a lot. Quick changes are my specialty now.
data.home-action-szk-05-alic-00-cos-02|text: I love this costume. But… I want to try wearing something cool like fran's someday.
data.home-action-szk-05-alic-00-cos-03|text: Suzu and I. Our fashion tastes are usually quite different… So I'm happy we can wear matching costumes.
data.home-action-szk-05-angl-00-01|text: I practiced hard so I could fly with beautiful form… I can't show the fans anything embarrassing…
data.home-action-szk-05-angl-00-cos-01|text: It was my first time flying in the sky. I was nervous… but it felt good.
data.home-action-szk-05-angl-00-cos-02|text: I was ego-searching on SNS and found someone making an altar with my goods. Embarrassing… but happy.
data.home-action-szk-05-angl-00-cos-03|text: All idols are angels… or maybe gods… I understand the urge to worship them.
data.home-action-szk-05-casl-04-01|text: With {user}, I'd want to go anywhere… fishing or otherwise. Lots of places…
data.home-action-szk-05-casl-04-cos-01|text: This outfit was at my parents' house. I'd been saving it for a day like this… Does it look okay…?
data.home-action-szk-05-casl-04-cos-02|text: When my onee-chan recommended it, I couldn't imagine when I'd wear it… but I'm glad it was useful.
data.home-action-szk-05-casl-04-cos-03|text: Working with my oshi was a huge success. A total catch. Thanks to scouting together beforehand.
data.home-action-szk-05-chna-00-01|text: …I might have gained a little confidence. Thanks to {user} and the fan letters.
data.home-action-szk-05-chna-00-cos-01|text: This costume was from my first… solo gravure shoot. It holds a lot of meaning for me.
data.home-action-szk-05-chna-00-cos-02|text: Conversation lessons. At first they were really hard… but now they're getting fun.
data.home-action-szk-05-chna-00-cos-03|text: First time wearing it for a shoot. These costumes are cute too. Feels comfy enough for pajamas.
data.home-action-szk-05-goch-00-01|text: What sound does a rabbit make? Pyon pyon…? Ah, pyon is just onomatopoeia. Forget it.
data.home-action-szk-05-goch-00-cos-01|text: I dreamed Cocoa and the others were doing a live. It got pretty hyped. …When I woke up, my arms were waving.
data.home-action-szk-05-goch-00-cos-02|text: The 'Pajama Party' costumes… both the old one and this one are really cute. The others were jealous.
data.home-action-szk-05-goch-00-cos-03|text: The Christmas feast was delicious but… this costume is white, so the cranberry sauce… was scary.
data.home-action-szk-05-idol-00-cos-01|text: Always shiny when I wear it… Thank you for keeping it clean. I'll take good care of it too.
data.home-action-szk-05-idol-00-cos-02|text: Colors and shape both cater perfectly to idol fans. No complaints.
data.home-action-szk-05-idol-00-cos-03|text: It suits me… right? No matter how many times I wear it, I never get tired of it. I love this costume.
data.home-action-szk-05-link-00-01|text: With Chisa, I can overcome any wall.
data.home-action-szk-05-link-00-cos-01|text: Chisa called me her best friend. I was truly happy. She's my proud best friend too.
data.home-action-szk-05-link-00-cos-02|text: The matching ribbons with Chisa are proof of our friendship. I want to show them off to everyone.
data.home-action-szk-05-link-00-cos-03|text: I tried making a bear plushie with Chisa. Learning to sew stitch by stitch was surprisingly fun.
data.home-action-szk-05-mizg-03-01|text: I helped a little so Chisa could go to the sea. She's scared but she works so hard.
data.home-action-szk-05-mizg-03-cos-01|text: The fireworks on the uninhabited island… looked more beautiful than usual. Unforgettable.
data.home-action-szk-05-mizg-03-cos-02|text: My recommended videos on the app… have become half idol and half survival content before I knew it…
data.home-action-szk-05-mizg-03-cos-03|text: The number of swimsuit-style costumes equals the number of summer memories… that makes me happy.
data.home-action-szk-05-pajm-00-01|text: An idol who brings dreams. Dreamy and sleepy… Shizuku Hodo… bui…
data.home-action-szk-05-pajm-00-cos-01|text: I made plans to play kendama with Sumire… She says she'll show me an amazing trick.
data.home-action-szk-05-pajm-00-cos-02|text: I need to get better at pillow fights… Kokoro, Suzu, and Sumire are all serious rivals…
data.home-action-szk-05-pajm-00-cos-03|text: Does this outfit make you sleepy? Maybe {user} just isn't sleeping enough.
data.home-action-szk-05-rock-00-01|text: Trying an ad job changed how I see things… I want to see more new scenery.
data.home-action-szk-05-rock-00-cos-01|text: The cool me felt fresh… I want to keep challenging different versions of myself.
data.home-action-szk-05-rock-00-cos-02|text: Costumes can completely change the mood… wearing something cool tightens my expression.
data.home-action-szk-05-rock-00-cos-03|text: I went to watch Slixx's lesson… My oshi is precious today too…
data.home-action-szk-05-sail-00-01|text: Had Haruko-san fillet the fish I caught at dawn… Grilled, simmered, in soup… so good.
data.home-action-szk-05-sail-00-cos-01|text: On the way to work I found a 'fishing pond cafe'… really catching my interest…
data.home-action-szk-05-sail-00-cos-02|text: I talked a lot about the appeal of fishing for a magazine interview… satisfied…
data.home-action-szk-05-sail-00-cos-03|text: I was lounging in my swimsuit with the AC cranked up at the dorm… Saki scolded me really hard.
data.home-action-szk-05-snro-00-01|text: Cinnamon-kun, hungry? Should I ask {user} to prepare some food?
data.home-action-szk-05-snro-00-cos-01|text: Chisa and I made this costume. Would Cinnamon-kun be happy if he saw it?
data.home-action-szk-05-snro-00-cos-02|text: Hey, did you notice? This costume's colors are actually inspired by Cinnamon-kun.
data.home-action-szk-05-snro-00-cos-03|text: I need to introduce Cinnamon-kun to my onee-chan soon.
data.home-action-szk-05-yukt-00-01|text: Yukata, stalls, fireworks… This costume holds so many memories just for me.
data.home-action-szk-05-yukt-00-cos-01|text: Summer evening, standing by a mountain stream in a yukata… so elegant. I'll recommend it to everyone.
data.home-action-szk-05-yukt-00-cos-02|text: Hoshimi Festival was fun. I want to do a live in Hoshimi again.
data.home-action-szk-05-yukt-00-cos-03|text: All of Sunny Peace in matching yukata… could we go to a festival wearing those?
data.home-action-szk-05-yuru-00-01|text: Rui-san, are there extra posters from our unit? I'd like one as a lifetime memento.
data.home-action-szk-05-yuru-00-cos-01|text: This costume holds memories of Rui-san. Just putting it on fills me with overwhelming emotion.
data.home-action-szk-05-yuru-00-cos-02|text: Wearing this brings back the live with Rui-san, all those lesson days… every memory resurfaces.
data.home-action-szk-05-yuru-00-cos-03|text: Any chance we do another limited unit? It was tough but really fun. I'm always OK with it.
data.home-action-szk-2nd-anniv-01|text: Standing up, sitting down, swaying a little… I'm fidgety today. That happens sometimes.
data.home-action-szk-2nd-anniv-02|text: There are times when talking more means more slips, right? So today I'm choosing not to say anything.
data.home-action-szk-2nd-anniv-03|text: I've decided to live out 'see no evil, speak no evil, hear no evil.' I am Shizuku Hodo, who knows nothing.
data.home-action-szk-basic-01|text: Good work. Can I hear the schedule? Today's, of course.
data.home-action-szk-basic-02|text: When I go to an idol live, I really look forward to the merch… just looking at it makes me happy.
data.home-action-szk-basic-03|text: Finding a fishing pond made my heart race. I liked fishing more than I realized.
data.home-action-szk-basic-04|text: If I know the catalog number of a favorite idol's Blu-ray, I can tell what era it's from. Cool, right?
data.home-action-szk-basic-05|text: Can I win this upcoming live…? The group is ranked pretty high. Please come cheer for us.
data.home-action-szk-basic-06|text: For the top-ranked groups, I can tell you their shoe size just from their names. Try asking.
data.home-action-szk-basic-07|text: I might have found a new hidden spot at school. The gym storage room. Quiet, calming… perfect for idol videos.
data.home-action-szk-basic-08|text: Watched a horror movie with Chisa. Ended up doing a 6-hour marathon. Nearly died so many times…
data.home-action-szk-basic-09|text: Triel and LizNoir at the office… I'm still not used to it. Any idol fan would be in tears.
data.home-action-szk-basic-10|text: Sunny Peace is in good form now. I can tell from everyone's faces. How about me, I wonder?
data.home-action-szk-basic-51|text: I know a side of Sakura-chan that even {user} doesn't… fufu.
data.home-action-szk-basic-52|text: I lose track of time at the idol shop… Sunny Peace goods are increasing, I'm happy…
data.home-action-szk-basic-53|text: I wonder if there's a safe big enough for a fishing rod. What for? …Better safe than sorry.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-ai-01|text: Today is Ai-chan's birthday… I went to congratulate her and she invited me to train… I gave up in 3 minutes.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-aoi-01|text: Aoi-chan… birthday. I said congratulations. She was breezy as usual…
data.home-action-szk-birthday-chs-01|text: Chisa-chan… the birthday surprise… I'm so glad she liked it. I'm really… happy.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-chs-02|text: It's Chisa-chan's birthday so I want to have a party… everyone dressing up as ghosts or something…
data.home-action-szk-birthday-hrk-01|text: Haruko-san, birthday. Her charm has leveled up again… ah no, it's… nothing.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-kan-01|text: It's kana-san's birthday and she wants something that'll go viral on SNS. A fishing rod would… get me yelled at?
data.home-action-szk-birthday-kkr-01|text: It's Kokoro-chan's birthday… For her present… I bought her favorite pudding.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-kor-01|text: It's fran-san's birthday but ⅢX was fighting as usual. I guess fighting means you're close.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-ktn-01|text: Today is Kotono-chan's birthday… She'll grow into an even sharper Kotono-chan than before.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-mei-01|text: Mei-chan… birthday today. I asked what she wanted as a gift and she said 'anything'… tough.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-mhk-01|text: Should I get miho-san a birthday present? Would it be rude not to?
data.home-action-szk-birthday-mna-01|text: Mana-san's birthday… isn't it. A heartfelt congratulations to the legendary idol…
data.home-action-szk-birthday-ngs-01|text: Nagisa-chan… it's her birthday. Today I'm a full-on Nagisa-chan fan. Specifics are… secret.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-rei-01|text: Rei-chan always gives me advice… so I want to use her birthday to say thank you.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-rio-01|text: Rei-san is all about pancakes… but that's hard to wrap as a present. What should I do.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-rui-01|text: Today is Rui-san's birthday. I prepared the ultimate gummies worthy of the absolute idol!
data.home-action-szk-birthday-ski-01|text: It's Saki-chan's birthday… I want to give her something that won't overlap with Chisa's, so I consulted someone.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-skr-01|text: Sakura-chan's birthday… right. The surprise worked… bui. All that prep paid off.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-smr-01|text: For Sumire-chan's birthday I'm thinking of a kendama… but I don't know which one to buy.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-suz-01|text: It's Suzu-chan's happy birthday… I'm thinking of giving her my rare idol DVD.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-szk-01|text: I'm really… happy. I'm getting excited.
data.home-action-szk-birthday-yu-01|text: It's Yu-chan's birthday so I said 'Happy Birthday to you' and she laughed.
data.home-action-szk-christ-01|text: Merry Christmas… I hope it's a white one…
data.home-action-szk-halw-01|text: If I don't have candy… I'll get pranked…?
data.home-action-szk-newy-01|text: Happy new year… want to draw fortune slips?
data.home-action-szk-newyeve-01|text: This year is ending. Thank you… very much.
data.home-action-szk-trust-01-01|text: Talk shows are hard to get used to. Being suddenly given a topic… I can't respond well at all…
data.home-action-szk-trust-01-02|text: When I go to the idol shop my sense of money breaks. I can't blame Suzu-chan.
data.home-action-szk-trust-01-03|text: Thank you for always bringing fun work. I've been meaning to say that since yesterday.
data.home-action-szk-trust-02-01|text: Should we grab a meal with Sunny Peace sometime? That came up during a break.
data.home-action-szk-trust-02-02|text: Sometimes I think… if I hadn't been brave enough to aim for idol, would my days not have been this fun…
data.home-action-szk-trust-02-03|text: We haven't talked in a while… I want to chat about anything, together.
data.home-action-szk-trust-03-01|text: Chisa-chan is surging in popularity among idol fans right now… Her trade cards are going for crazy prices. I have one.
data.home-action-szk-trust-03-02|text: Do we have the same job this week? No real reason… just thought maybe I could talk a bit more.
data.home-action-szk-trust-03-03|text: I left a daifuku on your desk. Take the bigger one… your cheeks will probably drop.
data.home-action-szk-trust-04-01|text: I want to talk about our favorite idols with {user}. At least 8 hours…
data.home-action-szk-trust-04-02|text: {user}, somehow I can't just leave you alone. Even though you're older… strange.
data.home-action-szk-trust-04-03|text: You haven't started to dislike Sunny Peace, right? I want you to come watch lessons more and more.
data.home-action-ymk-05-miku-04-cos-01|text: They design new costumes for me every year. This year's lovely too.
data.home-action-ymk-05-miku-04-cos-02|text: The Snow Festival is amazing. You can see ice sculptures and snow statues. They even make one of me!
data.home-action-ymk-05-miku-04-cos-03|text: I hope you'll come watch my stage next time! I'll be waiting in Hokkaido!
data.home-action-ymk-basic-01|text: Festivals, anniversaries, sports... I cheer for Hokkaido in everything!
data.home-action-ymk-basic-02|text: The night view from Mt. Hakodate is truly beautiful. I love it!
data.home-action-ymk-basic-03|text: Performing with LizNoir was so much fun! I want to sing together again.
data.home-action-yo-05-sush-00-01|text: I'll do my best to have a strong core in my heart just like Chisa-chan!
data.home-action-yo-05-sush-00-cos-01|text: If SunaPi everyone comes to Uchiura, I want them to eat Yokisoba! I'll make a ton!
data.home-action-yo-05-sush-00-cos-02|text: Chisa-chan has such a cute vibe but she suddenly wanted to come to my house... surprisingly assertive?
data.home-action-yo-05-sush-00-cos-03|text: To think Sunny Peace would wear costumes I made... As a creator, there's no greater joy!
data.home-action-yo-basic-01|text: Full of energy today too! Full speed ahead, yo-ho!
data.home-action-yo-basic-02|text: The sea in Hoshimi City must be beautiful too~.
data.home-action-yo-basic-03|text: Wouldn't it be great if we could do a "Kon-Chisa!" at a SunaPi live?
data.home-action-yo-basic-04|text: From Uchiura's sea to Hoshimi City's sea, I wonder how far I'd have to swim.

data.home-action-yu-05-ster-00-01|text: Come to think of it, I haven't heard your thoughts on this outfit yet. What do you think of my sister outfit?
data.home-action-yu-05-ster-00-cos-01|text: Rui-chan in her sister attire was wonderful... I almost accidentally ascended to heaven...
data.home-action-yu-05-ster-00-cos-02|text: Next time, I'd love to do a musical again with Sumire-chan and everyone else from Hoshimi.
data.home-action-yu-05-ster-00-cos-03|text: Visiting another school's festival is a neat experience. The atmosphere was totally different from our school.
